title: Trainee Recruitment Coordinator
description:
You like to be productive and looking for the opportunity to fast track your HR career.



You’ve already proven you can get results. You regularly meet and exceed quotas in previous businesses.



You’ve worked in some sort of phone-based customer service or sales role, communicating to English speaking customers.



We’ll give you full training to become established in all your functions and responsibilities.



Once established, the product of your role is to have clients’ who are established, re-newing and getting great results on their hiring projects because of their great implementation of Performia tools in-house.



Performia is a Swedish company with offices in 27 countries. You will be working for the Australian business, helping Australian business owners build teams that produce results. 



At Performia, we train owners to hire productive people and then embed our proven system into their business so hiring is no longer hit and miss, and hiring productive people who are great to work with and self-managing becomes the status quo. We work with the clients through regular one-on-one meetings and calls, giving them as much support as they need, whenever they need it. The result is a more rewarding business and a team they love — productive, fun, and safe.



You will go through the exact same training as our clients so you can deliver our hiring services plus support our clients who have our system inside their business. 



You’ll help across 5-10 hiring projects at a time; handling everything from creating the role description, writing ads the Performia way, screening and reference checks, plus supporting around 10 clients in correctly implementing our system in their business and quality checking their hiring process.



The role will be busy and challenging. There will be a lot to learn.



We are investing heavily in our marketing and growth, and more growth requires a great delivery team ready to onboard, establish and support our clients to win.



This is a WFH position, typically Monday - Friday, working full time between the hours of 8 am - 6 pm Melbourne timezone.



In return for your great results and willingness to learn, you will have many opportunities to prove yourself and advance with our team just like everyone else in our business who started with no experience and is now leading a key role.



If this sounds like the role for you - apply now via

We will only consider candidates who submit their application to our candidate management system.

title: Video Editor for Premium Product & E-Commerce Videos
description:
### DaVinci Resolve Preferred | $35 per Video | Long-Term Opportunity



Hi!



We are a growing European media & e-commerce agency looking for a **creative, reliable and highly detail-oriented Video Editor** for ongoing product video production.



## Payment



### **$35 USD per completed and approved standard video**



Videos are usually **15–30 seconds long, maximum 45 seconds**.





### Paid Trial



Shortlisted candidates will create **one paid trial video**:



* **$20** if the video reaches our quality standard and is client-ready

* **$10 trial compensation** if it is completed seriously and technically correctly but does not reach the required professional/creative standard



We are looking for a **long-term editor with regular assignments**, not one-time or free trial work.



---



## The Job



We create short **product explanation, e-commerce and advertising videos** for products from many different industries.



For a typical project, you will receive approximately **10–15 prepared and pre-selected clips**, which may include real product footage, photography, AI-generated scenes, animations, demonstrations, comparisons and stock footage.



A lot of the production work is therefore already prepared.



However, **you are not simply assembling clips.**



Your job is to understand the product and turn the available material into a **professional, persuasive and visually strong product story**.



The provided clips are source material – not a mandatory shot list. If only 8 out of 15 clips are good enough, use the 8. If something important is missing, you should be able to **research suitable licensed stock footage yourself**.



---



## Product Understanding & Sales Psychology



Before editing, you should understand:



* Who is the target customer?

* What problem does the product solve?

* What makes it different?

* What are its strongest features and benefits?

* What is the main selling point?

* Why should someone want to buy it?



Products can come from completely different industries – from cleaning products and household goods to kitchen tools or products designed to make everyday tasks easier for elderly people.



You must be able to **quickly understand a new product and translate its benefits into visual language.**



We also expect a good understanding of **sales psychology and persuasive storytelling**.



A strong video might follow:



**Hook ? Problem/Desire ? Solution ? Demonstration ? Benefit ? Proof/Comparison ? Result**



You should understand how to create curiosity, build tension, demonstrate benefits and maintain attention.



Our goal is not simply to create beautiful videos.



### We want beautiful videos that help sell products.



---



## Independent Thinking & Attention to Detail



Some provided material may be AI-generated. AI footage can look excellent while containing subtle errors.



You must notice problems such as:



* Changing or incorrect product labels

* Unreadable text or changing logos

* Packaging, colors or proportions changing

* Product parts appearing/disappearing

* Strange hands or unrealistic movement

* Incorrect product functionality

* Continuity errors

* Incorrect before/after comparisons

* AI artifacts



**Never use a clip simply because it was provided.**



If something is wrong, independently d
 whether to **remove, shorten, crop, correct or replace it**, find better stock footage, or tell us that new material is required.



You are one of the final quality-control steps before the video reaches our client.



---



## Skills



**DaVinci Resolve is strongly preferred.**



You should have experience with:



* Professional video editing

* Product/commercial storytelling

* Pacing, composition and visual hierarchy

* Music & sound design

* Basic titles/graphics

* Basic color correction

* Professional exports

* Stock footage research

* Advertising / sales psychology



Basic **Adobe Photoshop** knowledge is highly desirable.



Experience with **Adobe Firefly or other professional AI image/video tools** is a strong advantage.



The final result should feel:



**Clean. Modern. Premium. Persuasive. Intentional.**



---



## Portfolio Required



Please send examples of work that **you personally edited**.



We are especially interested in:



* Product videos

* Commercials

* E-commerce / social media ads

* Product explainers

* Direct-response creatives

* Before/after content



We care about both **visual quality and the ability to communicate why someone should want a product.**



---



## Paid Trial



For the trial, you will receive product information, prepared footage and other available assets. Please add stock footage that you researched specificall for this video.



Your task is to:



**Understand the product ? identify the main selling point ? develop the story ? select the best material ? research missing stock ? edit ? add music/sound ? quality-check ? deliver the final video.**



We will mainly evaluate:



**Product understanding • Sales psychology • Storytelling • Editing & pacing • Aesthetic quality • Material selection • Attention to detail • Product accuracy • Independent thinking**



The final question is simple:



### Would this video be good enough to send directly to a paying client?



---



## How to Apply



Please send:



* Your portfolio

* Your main editing software

* DaVinci Resolve experience

* Photoshop experience

* Adobe Firefly / AI experience, if applicable

* Product/commercial editing experience

* Weekly availability

* Confirmation that you accept the paid trial



Please also answer these **4 short questions in your own words**:



**1.** You receive 15 clips, but only 8 are strong enough for the final video. What do you do?



**2.** An impressive AI-generated clip contains a product label that changes slightly during the shot. What do you do?



**3.** Before editing a product you have never seen before, what do you need to understand about the product and its customer?



**4.** You have 20 seconds to sell a product that solves an annoying everyday problem. How would you structure the video to create curiosity and purchase desire?



Please keep your answers **short, practical and personal**.



Start your application with:



### **PRODUCT EDITOR**



If the trial goes well, we offer **regular paid projects and long-term cooperation** across different products, brands and industries.



We look forward to seeing your work!

title: Amazon FBA Online Arbitrage Sourcing VA (Canada) — Immediate Start
description:
We are a high-volume Amazon Canada FBA Online Arbitrage business looking for an experienced, self-motivated OA Sourcing VA to join our team full-time. This is not a training role — we are looking for someone who already knows what they are doing and can hit the ground running with minimal supervision. We already have VAs on the team performing well. We are expanding due to business growth and need additional sourcing capacity.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Source profitable Online Arbitrage leads for ---------- using Direct Retailer Browsing and Storefront Stalking methods

- Validate all leads using Keepa (CA marketplace) and SellerAmp/SAS before submission

- Log all qualified leads into our Lead Tracker with complete and accurate data, respecting our cooldown/gating rules (no re-submitting recently reviewed ASINs)

- Minimum 10 qualified leads per day once fully ramped — target is 15+



REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



Do not apply if you do not meet ALL of the following:



- Proven experience using Keepa for Amazon sourcing — subscription provided by employer

- Proven experience using SellerAmp/SAS set to Canada FBA — subscription provided by employer

- Minimum 1 year of hands-on Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcing experience

- Demonstrated knowledge of Keepa graphs: BSR history, Buy Box history, price history, seller count trends

- Understanding of FBA fee structure, ROI calculation, and Buy Box dynamics

- Minimum 20 Mbps download internet speed — stable and dedicated connection

- Dedicated, quiet workspace with backup internet (mobile data)

- Google Chrome as primary browser

- Computer with minimum 8GB RAM

- Strong written English communication



NICE TO HAVE



- Previous experience sourcing specifically for ---------- (not just ----------)

- Familiarity with Canadian retailers: ----------, Canadian Tire, London Drugs, Shoppers Drug Mart, SportChek, ----------

- Experience with Hubstaff or similar time-tracking software



COMPENSATION & HOURS



- Pay: $4 USD per hour

- Hours: Full-time, 40 hours per week. Complete 8 productive hours per day, Monday to Friday

- Performance bonus structure in place, paid per qualified lead tier above target — full details shared with shortlisted candidates

- Payment: Weekly via Wise (USD)

- Tools: Keepa and SellerAmp/SAS subscriptions fully covered by employer

- Time Tracking: Hubstaff (passive background tracking, no micromanagement)



HIRING PROCESS



1. Answer all pre-screen questions below in your application (required)

2. Shortlisted candidates sign a Confidentiality Agreement

3. Paid trial (Stage 1): 2–3 hours, work at your own pace, evaluated on lead quality and Keepa accuracy — paid at the standard $4 USD/hr rate

4. Top-performing candidate(s) from Stage 1 will be invited to a second, longer paid trial (Stage 2), also paid at the standard $4 USD/hr rate, to confirm consistency over a full shift

5. Hire decision based on combined trial output

APPLICATION QUESTIONS

Q3. What computer setup do you use? Device type, RAM, operating system, and confirm you use Google Chrome as your primary browser.



Q4. How long have you been doing Amazon Online Arbitrage sourcing? Have you sourced specifically for Amazon Canada (----------)? Describe your experience in detail — marketplaces, categories, methods used.



Q5. What is your daily lead quota in your current or most recent position and have you consistently hit it? Give a specific number. What methods do you use to source leads (storefront stalking, direct retailer browsing, Keepa Product Finder, etc.)?



Q6. Are you currently providing sourcing services to any other Amazon sellers? If yes, list how many, which marketplaces, and in what capacity.



Q7. Describe specifically how you use Keepa and SellerAmp in your sourcing process. What are you looking for in each tool before d
 to submit a lead?



Q8. If shortlisted, you will be sent a Keepa graph screenshot and asked to provide a 4–5 sentence analysis before moving to the paid trial. This is a required step — no exceptions.

title: Senior Java Developer (E-commerce)
description:
Summary:

We are seeking an accomplished Senior Java Developer to drive the development and optimization of our e-commerce platform. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in Java, microservices architecture, and performance tuning, along with the leadership skills to mentor a growing development team and steer complex projects to success.



Key Responsibilities

Application Design & Development



Architect, design, and develop high-performance, scalable Java-based e-commerce applications.

Implement microservices and event-driven architectures to ensure modular and resilient systems.

Performance Optimization & Scalability



Monitor, analyze, and optimize system performance, memory usage, and throughput.

Troubleshoot concurrency, threading, and performance bottlenecks using advanced profiling tools and techniques.

Technical Leadership



Mentor junior and mid-level developers, setting best practices in coding, testing, and deployment.

Drive architectural decisions and technology choices aligned with business needs and industry standards.

System Integration



Integrate third-party APIs, payment gateways, and services to enhance platform capabilities.

Implement caching solutions (e.g., Redis, Memcached) and messaging systems (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka) for efficient data handling.'



Quality Assurance & Testing



Champion test-driven development (TDD) and continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD).

Write and maintain robust unit, integration, and end-to-end tests using frameworks such as JUnit, TestNG, and Mockito.

DevOps & Deployment



Collaborate with DevOps teams to automate builds, deployments, and monitoring (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).

Ensure high availability, fault tolerance, and seamless scalability in production environments.

Security & Compliance



Enforce secure coding practices, including data encryption, OAuth/JWT-based authentication, and compliance with PCI-DSS/GDPR where applicable.

Continuously monitor and mitigate security vulnerabilities and threats.

Documentation & Collaboration



Produce clear, comprehensive technical documentation and architectural diagrams.

Work cross-functionally with product managers, QA, UX designers, and other engineers to deliver robust solutions within agile sprints.



Continuous Improvement



Stay current with emerging trends, tools, and technologies to evolve and enhance our software development lifecycle.

Propose and implement improvements to optimize code quality, productivity, and operational efficiency.



Note: Please send a link to your updated CV, no uploaded CV will not be entertained.



Qualifications:



5+ years of professional Java development experience, ideally on large-scale e-commerce or SaaS platforms.

Demonstrated success in building and deploying microservices, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures.

Technical Expertise



Java Proficiency: Strong command of Java 8+ features (Streams, Lambdas), concurrency, memory management, and JVM internals.

Frameworks & Libraries: Advanced experience with Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security, Hibernate/JPA.

API & Integrations: Experience creating RESTful APIs, integrating third-party services, and working with GraphQL (preferred).

Database Systems: Hands-on experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB; adept at writing complex queries and optimizing database performance.

Messaging & Caching: Practical knowledge of message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka) and caching systems (Redis, Memcached).

Build & CI/CD: Proficiency in Maven/Gradle, Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, Docker, and Kubernetes for seamless development and deployment.

Testing: Expertise in TDD, unit testing, integration testing, and test automation frameworks like JUnit, TestNG, and Mockito.

Performance Monitoring & Profiling: Familiarity with tools like VisualVM, YourKit, or New Relic for troubleshooting and tuning.

Soft Skills



Leadership: Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and influence technical direction.

Collaboration: Excellent communication skills, capable of working effectively with product owners, designers, and cross-functional teams.

Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced, agile environment, reacting quickly to changing requirements.

Problem-Solving: Proven analytical mindset and a pragmatic approach to solving complex challenges.

This is a full-time, hands-on leadership role for someone who can take ownership of website projects from start to finish and help establish the technical standards for our website operations.



-----------------------------------------------



THE ROLE



You will work closely with our internal team to build, maintain, troubleshoot, secure, and improve client websites, Shopify stores, landing pages, and funnels.



You will be responsible for WordPress websites, Shopify stores, GoHighLevel landing pages and funnels, domain connections, DNS configuration, hosting environments, SSL certificates, website security, integrations, tracking setup, and general technical support.



You will also serve as the lead technical resource for all website-related work and help guide future developers, contractors, or tea
mbers as the department grows.



You should be able to receive a website-related request, understand what needs to happen, identify potential risks, and complete the work correctly without disrupting the client’s existing website, store,
, domain, tracking, or other systems.



-----------------------------------------------



RESPONSIBILITIES



* Build, edit, and maintain WordPress websites

* Build, edit, maintain, and troubleshoot Shopify stores

* Build and update landing pages, funnels, forms, and websites inside GoHighLevel

* Manage Shopify themes, apps, products, collections, navigation, pages, and store settings

* Troubleshoot Shopify theme issues, app conflicts, checkout issues, tracking problems, and mobile usability concerns

* Troubleshoot website errors, broken pages, plugin conflicts, form issues, redirects, and performance problems

* Connect domains and subdomains to websites, Shopify stores, funnels, and landing pages

* Configure and troubleshoot DNS records, including A records, CNAME records, TXT records, MX records, and nameservers

* Make DNS changes carefully without disrupting client
 or other existing services

* Install, configure, renew, and troubleshoot SSL certificates

* Handle website and store migrations between hosting providers, domains, and platforms

* Coordinate website and store launches across WordPress, Shopify, and GoHighLevel

* Set up staging websites, backups, and safe deployment processes

* Maintain website and store security using proper technical best practices

* Identify and resolve malware, suspicious files, unauthorized users, outdated plugins, vulnerable apps, and other security concerns

* Manage WordPress themes, plugins, users, permissions, updates, and backups

* Manage Shopify users, permissions, themes, apps, integrations, and store settings

* Improve website and store speed, mobile responsiveness, usability, and overall performance

* Connect forms, calendars, CRMs, payment systems,
 platforms, analytics platforms, and third-party tools

* Install and troubleshoot Meta Pixel, Google Tag Manager, GA4, Google Ads tracking, and other tracking scripts

* Verify conversion tracking across websites, landing pages, forms, and Shopify stores

* Work with designers, media buyers, account managers, and other internal tea
mbers

* Review completed work for functionality across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices

* Perform quality assurance before website, store, or landing page launches

* Document important domain, hosting, website, Shopify, security, and technical configurations

* Communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to non-technical tea
mbers

* Help onboard new client websites, Shopify stores, hosting accounts, domains, and technical platforms

* Respond to website-related requests and technical issues in a timely manner

* Establish technical standards and best practices for WRK’s website operations

* Review and guide the work of future web developers, contractors, or technical support tea
mbers



-----------------------------------------------



REQUIREMENTS



* Strong hands-on experience with WordPress

* Strong hands-on experience with Shopify

* Experience building landing pages and funnels inside GoHighLevel

* Experience with Shopify themes, apps, products, collections, navigation, and store configuration

* Experience troubleshooting Shopify themes, apps, tracking, checkout issues, and integrations

* Strong understanding of domains, subdomains, DNS records, MX records, and nameservers

* Experience working with website hosting platforms and hosting control panels

* Strong understanding of SSL certificates and HTTPS

* Knowledge of website security, backups, malware prevention, user permissions, and safe update practices

* Experience safely migrating websites and stores between domains, platforms, or hosting providers

* Ability to troubleshoot technical website and eCommerce problems independently

* Experience with WordPress themes, page builders, plugins, and custom configurations

* Familiarity with Elementor or similar WordPress page builders

* Basic understanding of HTML and CSS

* Understanding of JavaScript and PHP is a plus

* Familiarity with Shopify Liquid is a strong plus

* Familiarity with Cloudflare is preferred

* Familiarity with Google Tag Manager, GA4, Meta Pixel, Google Ads tracking, and conversion tracking

* Experience connecting websites and Shopify stores to CRMs and third-party platforms

* Understanding of forms, webhooks, APIs, payment gateways, and platform integrations is preferred

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Reliable, proactive, organized, and comfortable working remotely

* Ability to manage multiple website projects and technical requests

* Ability to research unfamiliar technical issues and find reliable solutions

* Ability to take ownership of projects without constant supervision

* Agency experience is strongly preferred

* eCommerce experience is strongly preferred

* Basic website design ability and a good eye for clean layouts are preferred

* Experience leading developers, contractors, or technical projects is a plus



-----------------------------------------------



THE IDEAL CANDIDATE



The ideal candidate is someone who understands the full technical environment surrounding a website or eCommerce store.



You should know that changing a domain or DNS record can affect more than the website. You should understand how hosting,
 records, SSL certificates, redirects, integrations, plugins, Shopify apps, security, tracking, and payment systems work together.



We are looking for someone who checks existing configurations before making changes, creates backups before completing major work, tests everything after implementation, and takes responsibility for ensuring the final result works correctly.



You should understand both the development and operational sides of managing websites, stores, landing pages, and funnels.



You should be comfortable saying, “I understand the issue, I know what needs to be done, and I can handle it.”

title: Personal Assistant – Restoration Company
description:
I own a busy restoration company and am looking for a **dependable, organized, and highly responsive Personal Assistant** to help manage my day-to-day workload.



I need someone who is proactive, communicates professionally, follows through on tasks, and keeps me updated throughout the day. The goal of this position is to help keep me organized and make sure important
s, calls, appointments, deadlines, and follow-ups do not fall through the cracks.



### Responsibilities



* Check and monitor
s throughout the day

* Identify urgent
s and matters requiring my attention

* Draft and send professional
s on my behalf

* Respond to clients and follow up as needed

* Make business-related phone calls

* Schedule appointments, meetings, inspections, and other events

* Maintain my calendar and provide reminders

* Track outstanding tasks and follow-ups

* Remind me of deadlines and important items

* Follow up with clients, vendors, insurance companies, and other parties

* Keep me updated on **completed, pending, and overdue tasks**

* Respond quickly during working hours

* Help keep my daily workload organized and prioritized



### Required Schedule



**Monday–Friday**

**9:00 AM–6:00 PM HST (Hawai?i Standard Time)**

**1-hour lunch**



You must be consistently available and responsive during these hours.



### English Fluency – Required



**You must speak, read, and write English fluently.**



This position involves regular communication with clients, insurance companies, contractors, vendors, and other professionals by **phone,
, and text**.



You must be able to:



* Speak English clearly and confidently on professional phone calls

* Write professional
s with strong grammar and spelling

* Understand detailed verbal and written instructions

* Communicate naturally and professionally with clients

* Take accurate notes and relay information clearly



### What I'm Looking For



I need someone who is **organized, dependable, responsive, and takes initiative**.



I do not want to continually ask whether something was completed. When you are assigned a task, I expect you to **track it, follow up when necessary, and keep me informed until it is completed**.



Experience in **restoration, construction, roofing, insurance claims, or a similar industry** is a major plus.



You must also be comfortable handling confidential client and business information professionally.



**Most importantly, I am looking for someone reliable who can help reduce my workload, keep me organized, and stay one step ahead of what needs to be done.**

Research what's trending in short-form video and audio across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts, and flag what's relevant to our clients before it's played out. Keep an eye on what competitors in our clients' spaces are posting and pull out gaps we could fill. Build shot lists from direction and reference material we give you, so we walk into a shoot ready instead of planning it live. Manage posting schedules and captions across client accounts. Handle day-to-day community management: replying to comments and DMs in the client's voice. Keep our Milanote client boards current with fresh reference material and trend notes. Organize raw and edited content into a clean, findable system. Light admin support: tracking contract deliverables and deadlines, keeping a simple paperwork log, occasional scheduling. 



What we're looking for:



Someone who actually uses TikTok and Instagram like a real person, not just professionally. You should be able to spot a trending sound or format within a day or two of it taking off. Comfortable writing captions in a brand's voice, not your own. Organized enough to run a content calendar without being told twice. Good written English. Experience with Canva or basic short-form editing is a plus but not required, our editor handles the heavy lifting. Familiarity with Milanote, Notion, or similar tools is a plus.

title: Amazon SEO Manager
description:
We are looking for: AMAZON SEO MANAGER

Reports To: CEO / Amazon Operations Manager

Work Hours: Philippines Daytime Work Hours



ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.



Company Vision:

We want to work with you to grow our company while helping you to become a superstar in your field. We value problem solvers, go getters, people with opinions who want to make an impact. You will be on the leading edge of Amazon and online strategies and will be continually improving your knowledge in the pursuit of helping us grow our business.



At the same time, you will be working with a company that values community & family in both our internal and customer facing sides. Our mission is to delight kids & parents with creative craft kits and related products. We are 100% focused on that mission and want you to be there on the ride with us!



That’s where you come in as our next Amazon SEO Manager



Role Purpose

The Amazon SEO Manager owns the organic discoverability and conversion performance of our Amazon catalog by building and executing a disciplined SEO system. This role ensures our listings are consistently optimized with the right keywords, content, and structure, so we rank higher, earn more organic traffic, and convert more shoppers - reducing reliance on paid ads over time.



This person translates keyword research, search query data, and competitor insights into prioritized listing actions (titles, bullets, backend terms, images, A+ content), and ensures SEO work is delivered on a reliable cadence aligned with seasonality, pricing strategy, and key retail events.



What Success Looks Like

A successful Amazon SEO Manager consistently increases organic visibility and conversion by keeping keyword strategy, listings, and metadata current and intentional. This person owns the SEO engine that compounds: better indexing, better rankings, higher CTR, higher CVR, and a stronger organic share of sales—without sacrificing brand quality or compliance.



They run a disciplined cadence of keyword research and refresh, systematically improve listings (titles/bullets/A+/images/backend), and translate data (DR/DD/SQP/SI) into prioritized action. They partner closely with PPC and creative to ensure keyword targets, positioning, and content work together—especially during seasonality, deal events, and pricing shifts.



ONE THING: Drive organic ranking, discoverability, and conversion through consistent keyword research, listing optimization, and SEO execution.



Primary Objectives

Keyword Research & Keyword Refresh System

Listing Optimization That Moves CTR + CVR

SEO + Pricing + Event Alignment

Competitive Advantage



Regular Work Activities

Organize and refresh keyword sets (roots + long-tails)

Identify indexing/ranking opportunities; improve keyword organization and tracking

Update keyword clusters for PPC alignment and indexing strategy

Maintain MKL setup/expansion and competitor set updates

Update Data Rova + Data Dive projects (add ASINs, add keywords, track)

General Listing Optimization (Images, Title, Bullets, A+ Content)

Daily spot checks on priority ASINs

Weekly analysis and seasonal updates

Maintain seasonal/event folders + flat files for themed updates

Update keyword focus on listings based on performance and ranking goals

Price Strategy Support (PED, BD, STP, BTP)

Weekly/as-needed price strategy collaboration

STP action reviews after reports; implement improvements tied to velocity + CVR

Ensure consistent lowest 30D price logic where required

Support deal site strategy when applicable (drive off-Amazon traffic into deals)

SQP/SI review weekly/as needed; identify actions and implement

Competitor analysis weekly/as needed (price/listing/keywords/PPC targets)

Manage Experiments monthly/as needed (title/image/A+ testing)

Product classification review monthly (category alignment, item type)

FAQ seeding weekly/as needed

Target: 30+ FAQs added per month (based on ASIN priority list)

Special projects as assigned by leadership (catalog cleanups, large refreshes, launches)

Emergency fixes (suppressed listings, indexing drops, attribute issues)

Weekly SEO/Optimization sync (priority list + actions + blockers)

Weekly PPC alignment (keyword harvesting + targeting coordination)

Weekly creative coordination (assets needed, deadlines, tests)



Key Skills

Amazon SEO strategy + execution (keyword research, indexing, rank growth)

Strong copy + conversion thinking (CTR/CVR-focused content decisions)

Data literacy (SQP/SI/keyword tools) and action orientation

Organized project management across many ASINs

Experimentation mindset (testing, learning, iterating)

Detail-oriented: clean data, labeled projects, tracked changes

Cross-functional collaboration (PPC, creative, ops)



People Contacts and Interactions

PPC Manager: weekly (keyword harvesting + alignment)

Creative: weekly/as needed (images/A+ needs + seasonal themes)

Inventory/Sourcing (China) Team: weekly (priorities + performance actions)

Ops/Leadership: weekly/monthly reporting and priority alignment



Role Requirements

3+ years Amazon SEO / listing optimization experience (high-SKU preferred)

Strong proficiency with keyword tools (Data Dive, SellerSprite, Data Rova or equivalent)

Experience with Amazon reporting and insight tools (SQP/Scale Insights or equivalents)

Proven ability to increase rankings and improve CTR/CVR through listing work

Strong spreadsheet skills and operational discipline

High ownership: “owns the result,” doesn’t give the job back



How to Apply:

Click the link - 
/o/JB-EG02TR292/landing

ONLY APPLICANTS WHO WILL APPLY THROUGH THE LINK WILL BE ENTERTAINED.

title: Full-Time Web Developer – Shopify to Cloudflare Migration
description:
We are looking for an experienced full-time web developer to migrate our existing Shopify website (approximately 4,000 pages) to a modern website hosted on Cloudflare Pages.



Our website is primarily a digital showroom for our local furniture store. We do not rely heavily on Shopify’s e-commerce features. We use Lightspeed in-store, and our goal is to build a faster, more flexible website that we own and can easily update using AI tools such as Claude and OpenAI Codex.



Responsibilities



* Migrate our existing Shopify website (approximately 4,000 pages) to Cloudflare Pages.

* Preserve SEO rankings by maintaining URLs where possible and implementing proper 301 redirects.

* Export and migrate all products, collections, pages, blog posts, images, and metadata.

* Build reusable templates so products and landing pages can be generated automatically instead of manually.

* Configure Cloudflare Pages, DNS, SSL, caching, security, and deployment.

* Set up GitHub for version control and automated deployments.

* Build a fast, mobile-friendly website with excellent Core Web Vitals.

* Create an easy-to-maintain system for adding new products and landing pages.

* Implement product search, filtering, and category navigation.

* Build inquiry forms and optional “Request Information” or “Reserve This Item” functionality.

* Optionally integrate a third-party shopping cart (such as Snipcart) if required in the future.

* Optimize all pages for SEO, including structured data, XML sitemaps, metadata, image optimization, and internal linking.

* Ensure Google Search Console and Google Analytics are properly configured.

* Test the site thoroughly before launch and monitor SEO performance after launch.



Required Skills



* Strong experience with Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Workers.

* Experience migrating websites away from Shopify.

* Excellent understanding of technical SEO and SEO migrations.

* Experience with Git and GitHub.

* Experience with modern web frameworks such as Astro, Next.js, Nuxt, or Eleventy.

* Strong HTML, CSS, and JavaScript skills.

* Experience generating websites from structured data (CSV, JSON, Markdown, or CMS).

* Ability to build fast, responsive, accessible websites.

* Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude, OpenAI Codex, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot to accelerate development.



Nice to Have



* Experience with static site generators.

* Experience with Algolia or another search solution.

* Experience with Cloudflare Workers for custom functionality.

* Local SEO experience.

* Experience building high-performance e-commerce catalog websites without relying on Shopify.



What Success Looks Like



* Website loads significantly faster than the current Shopify site.

* Existing Google rankings are maintained or improved.

* Products and pages are easy to update without hiring a Shopify developer.

* New landing pages can be created quickly using AI-assisted development.

* Hosting costs are dramatically reduced.

* The website is fully owned by us and is no longer dependent on Shopify.



Please include examples of similar Shopify migrations, Cloudflare projects, and SEO migrations you have completed. Explain your approach to preserving SEO during a large website migration and how you would automate the migration of approximately 4,000 pages.

title: Project Manager
description:
Build the systems that keep meaningful, high-impact client work moving.



We are a U.S.-based strategic communications and marketing agency serving clients in public health, government, education, and social impact. We are seeking an experienced, highly structured Project Manager to lead multiple client engagements, strengthen our project management systems, and help cross-functional teams deliver excellent work on time and within scope.



This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the pace and complexity of a service-based agency. You should be comfortable creating order from ambiguity, anticipating risks, holding contributors accountable, and giving leadership a clear view of project status, capacity, and profitability.



What You’ll Own



Client Project Leadership



• Lead multiple concurrent client projects from kickoff through completion.

• Translate client goals and scopes of work into clear project plans, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables.

• Build and maintain detailed timelines, task plans, and resource allocations.

• Coordinate work across strategy, creative, communications, and operations teams.

• Identify risks and bottlenecks early, then implement practical mitigation plans.

• Keep projects moving while maintaining quality and strong client service.



Scope, Budget, and Resource Management



• Monitor project scope and address potential scope creep before it affects delivery.

• Track budgets, billable hours, and actual performance against projections.

• Partner with leadership on staffing, capacity, profitability, and resource planning.

• Document changes to timelines, deliverables, budgets, and responsibilities.

• Escalate concerns with clear options and recommended next steps.



Asana and Workflow Management



• Own and continuously improve the agency’s Asana environment.

• Build scalable project templates, dashboards, workflows, and reporting systems.

• Establish clear task ownership, dependencies, deadlines, and approval processes.

• Maintain strong accountability and deadline discipline across the team.

• Train and support team members in effective workflow and Asana practices.

• Identify opportunities to simplify processes and improve operational efficiency.



Communication and Reporting



• Lead organized internal project meetings and follow-up.

• Provide concise, structured weekly project updates.

• Proactively communicate risks, delays, decisions, and resource needs.

• Maintain accurate project documentation and decision records.

• Prepare executive-ready summaries that give leadership a clear view of progress and priorities.



What We’re Looking For



• At least five years of project management experience in an agency, consultancy, professional-services firm, or other service-based business.



• Experience managing multiple complex projects in a billable-hours environment.

• Proven success coordinating cross-functional, remote teams.

• Strong working knowledge of Asana, 
, or a comparable project management platform.

• Experience building project plans, workflows, timelines, and reporting systems.

• Strong understanding of scope, budget, resource, and risk management.

• Excellent written and verbal English communication.

• Exceptional organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.

• Ability to hold team members accountable with clarity, professionalism, and good judgment.

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.



Preferred Qualifications



• PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or another recognized project management certification.

• Asana certification, such as Advanced Workflow Specialist, or equivalent advanced Asana expertise.

• Experience in marketing, strategic communications, public relations, advertising, consulting, or a creative agency.

• Experience supporting clients in public health, government, education, or social impact.

• Formal training in project management, operations, or process improvement.



You’ll Thrive in This Role If You



• Naturally bring structure, clarity, and momentum to complex work.

• Anticipate problems instead of waiting for deadlines to slip.

• Communicate directly and respectfully, even when priorities compete.

• Balance attention to detail with awareness of broader business goals.

• Take ownership and follow through without constant supervision.

• Enjoy improving systems and not just maintaining them.

• Understand that strong project management protects client relationships, team capacity, and agency profitability.



Why Join Us



You will have a meaningful role in strengthening how our agency operates and delivers client work. Your systems, leadership, and judgment will directly influence project quality, team effectiveness, client satisfaction, and sustainable growth.

This is a long-term opportunity for a Project Manager who wants ownership, visibility, and the ability to improve processes and not simply update task lists.



Work Structure



• Location: Remote

• Schedule: Full-time

• Time-zone requirement: At least four working hours of daily overlap with U.S. Pacific Time

• Engagement: Long-term



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your updated CV.

2. A video of you to discuss a brief summary of your experience managing projects in an agency or service-based business.

3. A specific example of a workflow, project system, or Asana process you created or improved.

4. A list of relevant project management or Asana certifications.

5. Your availability, location, and expected compensation

title: ONBOARDING MANAGER (Tech-Focused) - $900 p/m + Bonuses
description:
We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend team meetings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field, write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Shopify Conversion, Checkout & Tracking Audit Specialist
description:
# Shopify Conversion, Checkout & Tracking Audit Specialist



### Independent End-to-End Funnel Audit | $350 Fixed Price



Hi!



We are looking for an experienced **Shopify Conversion & Checkout Audit Specialist** to independently investigate the complete purchase journey of an existing e-commerce store.



We are currently seeing a **significant difference between website traffic and completed purchases** and want to understand exactly where and why customers are dropping out.



We do **not** want you to assume that the checkout is broken.



The cause could be:



* Storefront or technical issues

* Cart or checkout issues

* Payment issues

* Tracking/data-quality issues

* Mobile/browser-specific issues

* Traffic quality

* Product/offer/conversion issues

* Or a combination of several factors



Your job is to **investigate this independently and provide evidence for your conclusions.**



This is primarily an **audit and diagnosis project**, not a redesign or development project.



---



## 1. Independent Purchase Journey Test



Before receiving detailed information about our previous technical suspicions, we would like you to perform your own independent test of the complete customer journey:



**Website Entry ? Landing Page ? Product Page ? Add to Cart ? Cart ? Checkout ? Payment ? Order Confirmation**



Please test the journey across relevant combinations of:



* Mobile and desktop

* Chrome / Safari and other relevant browsers

* Different products / variants

* Relevant countries / Shopify Markets

* Available payment methods

* Express checkout options where available



We want you to document anything unusual you discover independently.



A **real test purchase** should be performed to verify the complete payment and order process.



The agreed test purchase will be reimbursed separately.



---



## 2. Technical Store & Checkout Audit



Please investigate potential technical problems including:



* Product page functionality

* Product variants

* Add to Cart

* Cart behavior

* Cart ? Checkout transition

* Checkout initialization

* Discount codes

* Shipping calculation

* Taxes where relevant

* Shopify Markets

* Payment methods

* Express payments

* Failed payment behavior

* Successful payment

* Order creation

* Confirmation / Thank-you page

* Shopify apps and extensions

* JavaScript errors

* Browser console errors

* Failed network requests

* Third-party scripts

* Mobile-specific issues

* Browser-specific issues



We are particularly interested in **intermittent problems** that may not occur during every purchase attempt.



---



## 3. Performance Audit



Please investigate whether technical performance could negatively affect conversion.



This should include where relevant:



* Page speed

* Core Web Vitals

* LCP

* INP

* CLS

* JavaScript execution

* Heavy third-party scripts

* Shopify apps

* Network requests

* Mobile performance

* Loading behavior during the purchase journey



Please use appropriate diagnostic tools such as **Chrome DevTools and Lighthouse** rather than relying only on visual inspection.



---



## 4. Tracking & Customer Events Audit



We also need to determine whether our analytics accurately represent what customers are actually doing.



Please inspect where applicable:



* Shopify Customer Events / Web Pixels

* Meta Pixel

* Meta Conversions API

* TikTok Pixel

* Consent / cookie behavior



Please verify the customer journey events:



**Page View ? View Content ? Add to Cart ? Checkout Started ? Purchase**



and additional relevant events where available.



Please specifically look for:



* Missing events

* Duplicate events

* Events firing at the wrong stage

* Incorrect values

* Incorrect currencies

* Purchase events without real purchases

* Real purchases without Purchase events

* Browser vs. server-side discrepancies

* Consent-related tracking problems



Where possible, please compare tracking data against actual Shopify orders.



---



## 5. Funnel Analysis



A very important part of this project is identifying **where the measurable drop-off actually occurs**.



Using the available data, please reconstruct the funnel as accurately as possible:



**Sessions / Visitors**



?



**Product Views**



?



**Add to Cart**



?



**Reached / Started Checkout**



?



**Payment / Purchase**



?



**Successful Shopify Orders**



We want to understand whether the primary problem occurs:



**Before Add to Cart**



**Add to Cart ? Checkout**



or



**Checkout ? Successful Purchase**



Please provide the conversion/drop-off rates between the relevant stages where reliable data is available.



---



## 6. Data Quality & Internal Testing



Our historical analytics may not be perfectly clean.



There have been internal tests and test purchase journeys by team members in the past, and some historical data may therefore contain activity that did not come from real customers.



We will provide known information where available.



Please:



* Identify obvious test/internal activity where reasonably possible

* Separate test activity from genuine customer activity where reliable

* Identify inconsistencies between platforms

* Flag historical data that should not be considered reliable

* Clearly state when available data is insufficient to reach a reliable conclusion



Please **do not make assumptions simply to complete the analysis.**



If something cannot be determined from the available data, tell us.



---



## 7. Historical Issues



After your initial independent investigation, we will provide information about **previous technical issues we observed and changes that were made to the store**.



We would then like you to verify:



* Whether these issues are actually resolved

* Whether they can still be reproduced

* Whether they occur only under specific conditions

* Whether the implemented fixes were technically correct

* Whether related problems may still exist elsewhere



We intentionally want the initial investigation to happen **before giving you our own technical theories**, so that your first assessment remains independent.



---



# Required Final Report



We do not want a simple:



**“Everything seems to work.”**



And we also do not want someone to search for problems simply because we suspect that problems exist.



We want an **evidence-based conclusion.**



For every relevant finding, please provide:



**Issue ? Evidence ? Reproduction Steps ? Severity ? Likely Cause ? Conversion/Business Impact ? Recommended Fix**



Please classify findings as:



???? **CRITICAL**

May prevent purchases or seriously corrupt important data.



???? **HIGH**

Likely significant impact on conversion or measurement.



???? **MEDIUM**

Should be improved.



???? **LOW**

Optimization / nice-to-have.



Please clearly distinguish between:



**Confirmed technical problems**



and



**CRO hypotheses / recommendations.**



---



# Final Diagnosis



At the end of the project, please provide a short executive conclusion.



Based on the available evidence, evaluate each of the following potential causes:



**A. Storefront / technical issue**



**B. Cart / checkout issue**



**C. Payment issue**



**D. Tracking / data-quality issue**



**E. Traffic quality**



**F. Product / offer / conversion issue**



**G. Multiple factors**



**H. Insufficient evidence**



For relevant categories, briefly provide:



**Evidence supporting the hypothesis**



and



**Evidence contradicting the hypothesis**



We especially want your answer to these questions:



1. Is the complete purchase journey technically working?

2. Did you find anything that could prevent customers from purchasing?

3. Are there intermittent or device/browser-specific problems?

4. Is payment processing functioning reliably?

5. Is purchase/conversion tracking trustworthy?

6. Where is the largest measurable funnel drop-off?

7. Are the available historical analytics reliable?

8. What are the **three highest-priority actions** you recommend?



If your conclusion is that the checkout works correctly, that is completely acceptable — but we expect the conclusion to be supported by your tests and data.



---



# Access & Security



You will receive only the access required for the audit.



Depending on what is required, this may include limited access to relevant Shopify and analytics/advertising data.



Please **do not make significant changes to the live store without our explicit approval.**



Diagnosis and documentation come first.



Any larger fixes or implementation work identified during the audit will be discussed and quoted separately.



---



# Required Experience



Please apply only if you have strong hands-on experience with several of the following:



* Shopify

* Shopify Checkout

* Shopify Checkout Extensibility

* Shopify Liquid / Theme Development

* Shopify Customer Events / Web Pixels

* Shopify Markets

* Payment troubleshooting

* JavaScript debugging

* Chrome DevTools

* Core Web Vitals / Lighthouse

* Meta Pixel / Conversions API

* TikTok Pixel

* Consent / cookie tracking

* Conversion tracking

* E-commerce funnel analysis / CRO



We are looking for someone who is **analytical and technically strong**, not simply a Shopify page designer.



---



# Questions When Applying



Please answer briefly and based on your own experience:



**1.** Tell us about a Shopify checkout or payment problem you personally diagnosed. What was wrong and how did you identify the cause?



**2.** A store has healthy traffic and Add to Carts but very few completed purchases. What would you investigate first, and why?



**3.** How would you verify that a Purchase event fires correctly, contains the correct value and fires only once?



**4.** Which tools do you personally use when debugging Shopify storefront, checkout and payment problems?



**5.** How would you determine whether low sales are caused by a technical checkout problem versus poor traffic quality or a weak offer?



**6.** How would you investigate an issue that customers report only occasionally but that you cannot reproduce during your first test?



**7.** What hands-on experience do you have with Shopify Customer Events/Web Pixels, Meta Pixel/CAPI and TikTok Pixel?



**8.** Have you previously performed an end-to-end Shopify conversion/funnel audit? If yes, briefly describe what you discovered.



Please provide relevant Shopify projects, audits or examples if available.



---



# Budget



### Fixed Project Price: **$350 USD**



The $350 covers the complete audit and final report described above.



The agreed real test purchase will be **reimbursed separately** and is not included in the $350.



Any larger implementation or fixes discovered during the audit will be quoted and approved separately.



Please start your application with:



### **SHOPIFY AUDIT**



so we know you have read the complete description.



We value **independent thinking, evidence, clear communication and technical honesty**.



We are not looking for someone to confirm our suspicions. We are looking for someone who can tell us, based on evidence, **what is actually happening and what we should do next.**



If the collaboration works well, there is potential for additional Shopify and e-commerce work with our agency.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Virtual Appointment Setter — Commercial Trucking Insurance
description:
About Us



 White Glove Partners is a Texas-based commercial insurance agency specializing in coverage for trucking companies — owner-operators and small fleets. We prospect newly registered trucking businesses and help them get the right coverage at the right price. We're a small, growing shop with a modern toolset: you'll

 work from a simple web dashboard built specifically for this job. No spreadsheets, no dialing from a list, no CRM gymnastics.



 The Job



 You make outbound phone calls to small trucking business owners. This is NOT a reading-a-script-to-1000-numbers-a-day job. You'll make 40–60 quality calls per day, each one logged in our system. Quality beats volume — we'd rather you have five real conversations than burn through fifty hangups.



Your day looks like



 - Log into your dashboard and click "Give me my next call" — the system hands you the next best prospect with their name, business, phone number, fleet size, and talking points already on screen

 - Dial, talk, and log the outcome — one click: interested, voi
, no answer, callback, not interested, bad number, or do-not-contact

 - Voi
 and no-answer? The system automatically schedules the retry. You don't manage call-backs by hand — they appear in your queue at the right time

 - When someone's interested, you hand them off — the lead moves to a quoting specialist who takes it from there. Your job ends at "interested"

 - Brief notes on every meaningful call so the specialist knows the context before they reach out



 What you're actually doing on a call



 1. Ask for the owner by name (we give it to you)

 2. Introduce WGP in one sentence — no lengthy pitch

 3. Qualify lightly: how many trucks, what they're hauling, what they have now (if anything)

 4. If they're open to a quote ? mark Interested, the specialist takes over

 5. If they have questions you can answer ? answer them; if not ? note it, the specialist follows up

 6. If they say no ? log it politely and move on. No pressure tactics, ever.



 Must-Haves



 - Clear, friendly, unaccented-or-easily-understood spoken English (our prospects are Texas truckers — rapport matters)

 - Comfortable with basic web tools — if you can use Gmail and a web form, you can use our dashboard

 - Reliable internet + quiet workspace for calls

 - Honesty in logging. Our whole system runs on accurate outcomes. Marking a "no answer" as a callback to look busy poisons the data and will be noticed

 - Thick-ish skin — some people hang up. That's fine; the next call is one click away

 - Available during US Central business hours (8am–6pm CT window; we'll agree your shift)



 Nice-to-Haves



 - Experience in insurance, trucking, logistics, or any B2B appointment-setting role

 - Familiarity with trucking terms (DOT numbers, MC authority, bobtail, cargo coverage) — or willingness to learn a short glossary we provide

 - Spanish (a meaningful share of Texas owner-operators prefer it)



 What Success Looks Like (first 90 days)



 1-30        Learn the system + the industry basics. 40+ calls/day, accurate logging
+ calls/day; connect with ~30% of answered calls; 8–12 genuine "interested" handoffs per week 

 60-90      Consistent performance + a feel for which leads are worth a second push                         



 You'll see your own daily numbers on your dashboard — calls made, connects, callbacks due. Complete transparency, no mystery metrics.



 Compensation & Details



 - $5-7/hour base (with future bonus structure based on call quality/lead generation)

 - Full Time

 - Remote — anywhere with good internet and a quiet room

 - You never use your own phone number; calls go through system.



 The Honest Pitch



 This is a real job with real small-business owners on the other end, at a company that invests in good tooling and doesn't ask people to lie or pressure anyone. If you like talking to people, can handle a "no" without flinching, and want a seat at a growing shop where your feedback shapes how we work — apply.

Wedding Video Editor – Long-Term Position

-Selecting the strongest shots and moments

title: Business Development Coordinator
description:
Help us win meaningful work with foundations, private enterprises, and leading institutions.



We are a growing strategic communications and consulting firm seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Business Development Coordinator. You will help identify promising contract opportunities and coordinate clear, compliant, and compelling proposals from initial research through final submission.



This role is ideal for an excellent writer and project coordinator who has hands-on experience with RFPs, RFQs, and institutional proposals. You should be comfortable managing multiple deadlines, organizing input from contributors, and ensuring that every submission requirement is addressed.



What You’ll Do



Research and Evaluate Opportunities



• Identify relevant RFPs, RFQs, and other contract opportunities.

• Monitor industry listservs, B2B networks, and opportunity databases.

• Summarize each opportunity’s scope, eligibility requirements, deadlines, evaluation criteria, and submission process.

• Provide clear recommendations to support bid/no-bid decisions.



Coordinate Proposals from Start to Finish



• Build proposal outlines, work plans, timelines, and internal task assignments.

• Manage proposal schedules and milestones in Asana.

• Coordinate contributors and follow up to keep deliverables on track.

• Maintain compliance checklists and verify that all requirements are met.

• Communicate with issuing organizations regarding questions, clarifications, and submission logistics when appropriate.



Support Proposal Writing and Production



• Draft and edit selected narrative, technical, and organizational sections.

• Turn contributor input into clear, persuasive, and consistent proposal content.

• Format proposals in accordance with solicitation requirements.

• Coordinate forms, signatures, resumes, project descriptions, attachments, and supporting documents.

• Proofread and quality-check final packages.

• Manage final packaging and on-time submission.



Strengthen Business Development Operations



• Maintain an accurate pipeline of active and upcoming opportunities.

• Organize proposal templates, content libraries, and reusable materials.

• Keep staff resumes, case studies, project descriptions, and qualifications current and proposal-ready.

• Track submissions, outcomes, debriefs, and follow-up actions.



Maintain Vendor Readiness



• Track business certifications, licenses, and renewals required for eligibility.

• Maintain company registrations in vendor and partner portals.

• Organize access credentials and compliance records needed for submissions.



What We’re Looking For



• Experience coordinating proposals or responses to RFPs and RFQs.

• Familiarity with institutional proposal processes and vendor portals.

• Strong proposal, technical, or professional writing skills.

• Excellent written English, editing, and proofreading abilities.

• Strong research and analytical skills.

• Exceptional organization and attention to detail.

• Ability to interpret complex solicitation instructions and translate them into actionable requirements.

• Ability to manage competing deadlines and coordinate multiple contributors.

• Proficiency with Google Docs, Microsoft Word, and PDF formatting tools.

• Experience using project management software; Asana experience is strongly preferred.

• A proactive, dependable working style with strong follow-through.



Preferred Qualifications



• US experience is preferred but not required.

• Experience supporting large-scale B2B bids or institutional proposals.

• Experience in consulting, strategic communications, marketing, or another professional-services environment.

• Experience drafting proposal narratives or technical sections.

• Advanced experience formatting resumes, proposals, and submission packages.



You’ll Thrive in This Role If You



• Take ownership without needing constant direction.

• Stay calm and methodical when deadlines are tight.

• Communicate clearly and follow up consistently.

• Enjoy bringing structure to complex projects.

• Catch small details while keeping the larger strategy in view.

• Understand that compliant, polished, on-time submissions are essential to winning work.



Why Join Us



You will play a visible role in the firm’s growth and contribute directly to high-impact opportunities. You will work across research, writing, project coordination, and business development while helping improve the systems and resources behind our proposal process.



How to Apply



Please submit:



1. Your CV

2. A video of you describing your proposal or business development experience.

3. One relevant writing or proposal sample, with confidential information removed.

4. Your availability and desired compensation.

title: Social Media & Marketing Virtual Assistant (Content Calendar, Canva, AI)
description:
Hi! We're Willing Law, a premium boutique family law and real estate firm in Ontario, Canada. We help people through hard moments — divorce, separation, parenting, and property — with calm, clear, professional guidance.



We're growing our brand online and need a sharp, organized Social Media & Marketing VA to own our content calendar and keep our marketing running consistently across Instagram,
, and LinkedIn.



This is a content-calendar and marketing role first. You'll plan what we post and when, design clean graphics in Canva, write captions in our brand voice using AI tools (like Claude), schedule and publish, and engage with our audience. You'll work directly with our founder and marketing lead. We're not looking for someone to just push buttons — we want someone who takes ownership, plans ahead, and treats our brand like their own. This is a long-term role with room to grow your hours and pay as you prove yourself.



What you'll do:



Own and maintain our monthly content calendar — plan themes and campaigns, and keep posts scheduled ahead so we're never scrambling



Design on-brand graphics and carousels in Canva using our colours and templates



Write hooks and captions in our brand voice (plain English, warm, professional — never salesy or full of legal jargon), using AI tools to work faster



Schedule and publish consistently on Instagram,
, and LinkedIn, YouTube, frim website



Make routine updates to our website (pages, blog posts, images)



Handle basic on-page SEO (titles, meta descriptions, keywords, internal links) and keep our Google Business Profile active.



Send a simple monthly summary of what went out, what performed, and what you recommend next



Must-haves:



2+ years managing social media and content marketing for a business, brand, or agency

Proven experience building and running a content calendar independently

Strong Canva skills — you design clean, on-brand graphics without hand-holding

Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to draft and speed up content

Solid experience posting and growing accounts on Instagram,
, and LinkedIn

Excellent written English — your copy sounds human, warm, and professional

Familiar with a website platform (Wix, Mailchimp)

Working knowledge of on-page SEO

Reliable internet, your own computer, and the software you need

Organized, self-directed, and communicative — you flag problems early and hit deadlines



Nice-to-haves:



Experience marketing for lawyers, professional services, or a regulated industry

Familiarity with Meta and LinkedIn Ads

 marketing experience (Mailchimp or similar)

Understanding of North American audiences and tone



Why work with us:



Long-term, stable role with a firm that values good work

Real ownership and room to grow your hours and pay

A clear brand and voice to work within — no guessing

Respectful, organized leadership — we don't micromanage and we don't ghost



HOW TO APPLY (please follow every step — we skip applications that don't):



Start your message with the words "FRESH START" so we know you read this whole post.

In 3–4 sentences, tell us about a brand or account whose content calendar you ran, and one result you're proud of.

Send links to 2–3 social accounts or websites you've worked on, plus 1–2 Canva designs you created.

Tell us how you use AI tools (like Claude or ChatGPT) in your content workflow.

List the scheduling, design, website, and SEO tools you use.



We read every application that follows these steps. We're excited to meet you!

title: Level 3 MSP Support Engineer
description:
Beanstalk Computing is a growing Managed Services Provider (MSP) dedicated to delivering exceptional IT support, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, and strategic technology guidance to businesses across the United States. We pride ourselves on building long-term relationships with our clients by combining technical excellence with outstanding customer service.



As a Level 3 MSP Support Engineer, you'll be more than just a ticket resolver. You'll serve as a trusted technical expert, working with modern Microsoft 365, Azure, networking, security, and cloud technologies while helping mentor junior engineers and solve complex challenges for a diverse client base. We value initiative, continuous learning, and people who take ownership of their work.



At Beanstalk Computing, you'll join a collaborative team that respects your expertise, encourages professional growth, and provides opportunities to work on meaningful projects that directly impact our clients' success. If you're passionate about technology, enjoy solving difficult problems, and want to be part of a company that values both technical skill and customer relationships, we'd love to hear from you.



What you’ll be doing

Provide remote and phone-based support to Beanstalk Computing clients during US business hours (Pacific Time), serving as a senior escalation resource and technical owner for assigned customer environments.

• Act as the technical SME for your assigned client environments; maintain stability, security, and a great end-user experience.

• Assist and mentor junior engineers by handling escalations, pairing on troubleshooting, and improving team runbooks and documentation.

• Communicate clearly with clients and end users—set expectations, provide timely updates, and translate technical findings into business impact.

• Support Microsoft-based environments including Windows Server, Active Directory, Azure, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 (Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, Intune).

• Work across core MSP platforms (RMM, ticketing, backup/DR, endpoint security/EDR,
 security) and follow security best practices.

• Resolve complex Level 2/3 issues across a broad stack (networking, Windows, M365, identity, virtualization) with strong troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

• Collaborate with project and security resources to standardize and improve customer environments, participate in onboarding/offboarding, and reduce recurring i
.

• Document thoroughly in the ticketing system and knowledge base; create clear notes, diagrams, and runbooks, and use automation/AI responsibly to work efficiently.



Additional responsibilities (Level 3)

• Own escalations end-to-end: triage, troubleshoot, coordinate vendors/ISPs, and drive issues to resolution.

• Perform root-cause analysis (RCA) for recurring i
 and propose corrective actions.

• Lead or support client changes (patching, upgrades, migrations) using good change-control and rollback planning.

• Improve service quality by identifying automation opportunities (PowerShell, Intune policies, RMM scripting) and contributing to standardization.

• Support security fundamentals: MFA/Conditional Access alignment, endpoint hardening, vulnerability remediation, backup verification, and i
 containment.



Hours: 8am -5pm Pacific Time, USA
