title: Project Campaign Manager (PCM)
description:
The Project Campaign Manager is responsible for the successful day-to-day implementation and delivery of client digital marketing campaigns. Each PCM may manage up to 20 active client accounts, executing the strategy prescribed by the CMO while coordinating internal marTech and development resources.



Core Responsibilities

- Manage implementation and delivery for up to 20 active client campaigns/accounts.

- Serve as the primary point of accountability for campaign delivery from strategy handoff through execution.

- Implement campaign strategies and priorities as prescribed by the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO).

- Translate CMO strategy into clear tasks, deadlines, deliverables, and assignments for internal teams.

- Coordinate work between marTech, paid media, automation, creative, and development teams.

- Ensure all assigned client deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule.

- Identify delays, blockers, missing assets, or performance concerns and escalate them quickly when necessary.

- Maintain ownership of campaign timelines and follow up with team members to prevent tasks from falling behind.

- Provide clients with daily status communication through Slack, including progress, completed work, upcoming priorities, and items requiring client input.

- Maintain professional, proactive, and clear client communication without requiring the CMO to manage routine campaign updates.

- Manage client requests and ensure new requests are properly documented, prioritized, and assigned.

- Maintain ClickUp as the central project-management system for every assigned account.

- Create, assign, update, and close ClickUp tasks for marTech, Dev, and other team members.

- Ensure ClickUp accurately reflects current deadlines, priorities, task owners, dependencies, and campaign status.

- Conduct regular quality-control reviews before client-facing deliverables are considered complete.

- Verify that campaigns are being implemented according to the approved strategy, scope, and client expectations.

- Coordinate campaign launches, automation deployments, website changes, landing pages, tracking, CRM updates, and other digital initiatives.

- Monitor outstanding client approvals, assets, credentials, and information needed by the delivery team.

- Maintain organized client documentation, campaign notes, approvals, and implementation history.

- Keep the CMO informed of major campaign developments, risks, strategic questions, and opportunities.

- Participate in internal campaign and production meetings as required.

- Help maintain a high standard of speed, accountability, communication, and execution across all War Horse Agency client accounts.



Primary Accountability

The PCM is the final person responsible for ensuring assigned client campaigns get delivered. While marTech specialists, developers, creatives, and other team members may perform individual tasks, the PCM owns the coordination, follow-up, communication, documentation, and successful completion of the overall campaign.



Success in this role means clients always know what is happening, team members always know what they are responsible for, ClickUp always reflects reality, and campaigns move forward without unnecessary delays.

title: Construction Project Manager & Operations Assistant
description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive, and tech-savvy Construction Project Manager & Operations Assistant to help manage our active real estate development and construction projects, while improving the systems that support the business.



This is a high-autonomy role for someone who can take ownership of multiple projects, keep multiple parties accountable, and communicate clearly with stakeholders and leadership. Strong attention to detail is necessary for success. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable coordinating a contractor in the field, reviewing a project budget, maintaining ClickUp project tasks, or figuring out how automation can enhance operations.



Construction Project Management & Coordination (85%)

- Own active projects end-to-end, keeping timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders on track.

- Coordinate and communicate with GCs, subcontractors, vendors, designers, architects, accounting, and lenders. Proactively identify and resolve issues, delays, and blockers; keep leadership informed.

- Maintain ClickUp as the project 'source of truth' and continuously improve project workflows.

- Track project budgets and upcoming costs as part of overall project management. Work with Accounting to ensure project expenses, construction draws, and supporting financial documentation are properly tracked and organized.



Operations (15%)

- Develop and improve SOPs, workflows, and templates as the business scales.

- Identify opportunities and implement AI solutions to improve operational efficiency

- Draft business documents and handle ad-hoc operational tasks, research, and special projects as needed.



The ideal candidate will have the following skills / background:



Required

- Prior construction project management experience, ideally in residential construction.

- Prior remote project management experience with the ability to independently manage projects and stakeholders.

- Experience using ClickUp to manage projects, tasks, timelines, and workflows.

- Experience with CAD and the ability to review and work with basic drawings/plans.

- Experience using AI tools, automation platforms, or other technology to improve business processes.

- Highly proactive; able to identify what needs to happen next without being told.

- Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines independently.

- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

Preferred

- Experience in US/Canada residential real estate development

- Experience working directly with general contractors and subcontractors.

- Experience with residential design, material lists, finish schedules, or installation guides.

- Experience with permitting and working with architects / consultants.

- Experience developing SOPs and operational workflows.





The ideal person is an operator, not just an administrator.



You are someone who sees a problem and figures out how to solve it. You don't wait to be told what to do when the next obvious step is clear. You keep projects moving, follow up with people, organize information, catch mistakes, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.



You are comfortable moving between high-level project management and detailed execution. One hour you may be coordinating with a contractor; the next you may be comparing material bids, reviewing a project expense, updating ClickUp, or figuring out how to automate a repetitive process.



As the company grows, we expect this role to evolve with it. Someone who demonstrates strong judgment, ownership, and operational ability will have the opportunity to take on significantly greater responsibility.

title: Fractional Controller / Senior Bookkeeper - Real Estate Development & Construction
description:
Fractional Controller / Senior Bookkeeper (Part-Time, Remote)



About Us

We are a growing real estate development and construction company seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Fractional Controller to oversee bookkeeping, accounts payable, cash management, and financial reporting. This is not a simple bookkeeping role - we need someone who understands cash flow, project-based businesses, and working capital management. You will work directly with the owner and serve as the primary financial operations lead for the company.



This is a long-term, part-time remote position, that has potential to become a full-time role.



Expected commitment: 5–15 hours per week initially.



## Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Accounting

* Maintain accurate books and financial records for each division and project

* Manage monthly reconciliations

* Review and categorize transactions

* Maintain general ledger integrity

* Prepare monthly financial statements

* Coordinate year-end reporting and tax support



Accounts Payable & Payments

* Manage vendor and contractor payments

* Prepare ACH payments and wire transfers

* Track invoices and payment schedules

* Maintain vendor records

* Ensure timely payment of obligations

* Coordinate with ownership for payment approvals



Cash Management & Forecasting

* Maintain rolling cash flow forecasts

* Project cash needs over 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons

* Monitor working capital requirements

* Identify upcoming cash constraints before they become issues

* Provide recommendations regarding timing of draws, funding events, and major expenditures



Project Financial Management

* Track project budgets vs actual spending and create project retro analyses

* Monitor project-level profitability and cash usage

* Compare actual costs against scopes and budgets

* Assist ownership in understanding project cash requirements



Reporting & Analysis

* Produce monthly reporting packages

* Track key financial metrics

* Provide ad hoc financial analysis

* Help ownership make informed decisions regarding capital allocation and project timing



Required Qualifications

* 5+ years of bookkeeping, controller, or accounting experience, ideally for a construction and/or real estate company

* Strong understanding of cash flow forecasting

* Experience managing accounts payable and vendor payments

* Advanced QuickBooks Online experience

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

* Excellent written and verbal English communication

* High attention to detail and organizational skills



Strongly Preferred

* Experience managing multiple projects simultaneously

* Experience with job costing

* Experience preparing lender, investor, or ownership reporting

* Controller-level experience at a small or mid-sized company



Important Notes About Authority & Controls

This role will prepare payments, ACH transfers, wires, and cash forecasts. However, all payment releases and bank approvals will remain subject to company approval policies and internal controls. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating within a controlled financial environment and understands the importance of segregation of duties and financial controls.



To Apply



Please include:

1. A summary of your bookkeeping/controller experience

2. Industries you have worked in

3. Your experience with cash flow forecasting

4. Your experience with construction or real estate businesses

title: Business Development Representative – Consumer Brands & Retail
description:
About the Role



We're looking for a highly motivated Business Development Representative (BDR) to drive outbound sales efforts and generate qualified meetings for our leadership team. This role is responsible for identifying high-potential prospects, building targeted lead lists, executing personalized outreach campaigns, and nurturing relationships until opportunities are ready to engage.



Success in this role isn't about sending the highest volume of
s — it's about building genuine relationships, delivering thoughtful outreach, and consistently booking qualified meetings. The ideal candidate has experience selling agency or professional services, understands the nuances of outbound prospecting, and is comfortable testing new outreach strategies to continuously improve performance.



Work Structure & Requirements



Location: Remote / Virtual

Schedule: Part-time (20 hours per week), with opportunity to increase as the business grows

Compensation: 7 USD per hour with 20 USD per qualified attended meeting

1. Prospect Research & Lead Generation

Build and maintain targeted prospect lists using LinkedIn, industry publications, databases, and market research

Monitor buying signals such as fundraising announcements, product launches, and retail expansions to identify new opportunities

Continuously refine lead lists to ensure a healthy and qualified sales pipeline



2. Outbound Sales & Relationship Building



Execute personalized outbound outreach via
, LinkedIn, and where relevant, cold calling

Craft thoughtful, relevant messaging tailored to each prospect rather than relying on generic templates

Manage follow-up sequences and nurture prospects over time

Ensure all sales activities are documented and opportunities remain organized and up to date

Report on outreach performance, meetings booked, and pipeline activity



4. Continuous Improvement



Share learnings and recommendations to improve outbound strategy and campaign performance

Leverage AI tools and sales technology to improve efficiency, research, and outreach quality

Collaborate with leadership to refine messaging, targeting, and sales processes as the business grows



Required Skills & Experience

Experience: Minimum 2 years in a BDR, SDR, or similar outbound sales role; experience selling services within an agency environment is essential

Communication: Strong written and verbal English communication skills with excellent copywriting and relationship-building abilities

We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team—not just another freelancer.



ALSO IMPORTANT***  -- IDEALLY WOULD PREFER SOMEONE WHO IS NOT WORKING ANOTHER JOB AT THE SAME TIME OR OVERLAPPING HOURS.

s to customers.

title: Long-Term Etsy Product Creator & Listing Manager. Gamified Google Sheets & Excel Spreadsheets + Full Listing Management
description:
Looking for a long-term Etsy Product Creator. Gamified Google Sheets and Excel Spreadsheets + Full Listing Management. I am working on a growing Etsy shop, selling digital debt payoff and budgeting products for women. I'm looking for a long-term creative partner who can handle the FULL product pipeline — from concept to launch — on an ongoing basis.



This is NOT a one-time gig. I'm building a product line and need someone who can produce 2-4 new products per month, consistently, with the quality and creativity to make each one stand out in a crowded niche.



WHAT YOU'LL DO (Full Pipeline):



1. Product Creation

- Design and build gamified Google Sheets and Excel spreadsheets

- Gamification themes

- Each product must include: branded dashboard, data entry logs, auto-calculating formulas, visual progress elements, charts, and an instructions tab written in my brand voice

- All products use my brand colors and typography (I'll provide the full brand guide)

- Products must be mobile-friendly (most buyers check on their phone)



2. Product Mock-Ups

- Create visual mock-ups of each spreadsheet for the Etsy listing images

- Mock-ups should show the spreadsheet on desktop and mobile

- Must look premium — not screenshots pasted on a white background

3. Thumbnail / Product Videos

- Create short product demo videos (15-30 seconds) showing the spreadsheet in action

- These go on the Etsy listing as video thumbnails

- Should highlight the gamification features, visual elements, and how the spreadsheet works

- Can be screen recordings with text overlays, transitions, and brand styling



4. SEO-Optimized Etsy Listings

- Write keyword-rich titles (140 characters, following Etsy SEO best practices)

- Write descriptions that sell — not just describe (I'll provide templates and brand voice guide)

- Research and select 13 tags per listing based on current Etsy search trends

- Create listing images (up to 10 per product) — mock-ups, feature callouts, instruction screenshots, lifestyle shots

- Set pricing based on my strategy (I'll provide the framework)



5. Pinterest Pins (for traffic)

- Create 2-3 Pinterest pin designs per product

- Pinterest is a major traffic source for Etsy digital products

6. Keyword Research

- Research trending keywords in the debt payoff / budgeting / finance planner niche before each product

- Identify gaps — what's NOT being offered that should be

- Analyze competitor listings (top 10) for each product category

- Provide keyword recommendations for titles, tags, and descriptions



7. Listing Optimization

- Monitor listing performance and suggest updates

- A/B test thumbnail images and titles

- Refresh tags and keywords based on seasonal trends

8. Review Response Templates

- Write templates for responding to 5-star reviews, critical reviews, and common customer questions

- Templates should match my brand voice (blunt, warm, relatable — not corporate)



9. Sales & Competitor Tracking (monthly)

- Monthly report: which products are selling, which aren't, what to adjust

- Track top 5 competitors — new products, pricing changes, review themes

- Suggest new product ideas based on market gaps and trends





WHO I'M LOOKING FOR:



Required:

- Proven experience creating Google Sheets and Excel spreadsheet templates

- Strong understanding of Google Sheets/Excel formulas, conditional formatting, data validation, sparklines, and charts

- Experience with Etsy SEO — keyword research, title optimization, tag strategy

- Can create product mock-ups and demo videos (Canva, Photoshop, or equivalent)

- Portfolio showing at least 5 digital products you've created and listed on Etsy

- Understands gamification in digital products (visual progress, interactive elements)

- Responsive communicator



Preferred:

- Familiar with Pinterest marketing for Etsy products

- Can write in a conversational, relatable tone (not corporate or AI)

- Experience with Notion templates (future product line)

- Graphic design skills for thumbnails and pins



NOT a fit if:

- You only do data entry or basic spreadsheet formatting

- You can't show a portfolio of actual Etsy products you've created

- You're looking for a one-time project (this is ongoing)

title: Full-Stack Developer – API Integrations & Analytics Web Platform
description:
Hi!



We are a growing European media & e-commerce agency looking for a **talented and reliable Full-Stack Developer** to build a custom API-based web application with us.



This starts as a focused project but has strong potential to become a **long-term development partnership** with ongoing work and new features.



We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical problems, thinks about architecture before coding, communicates openly, and takes responsibility for the quality of their work.



Full project details will be shared with shortlisted candidates.



## What You Should Be Good At



The project involves connecting multiple external platforms, synchronizing and storing data, and displaying it in a multi-client web application.



Strong experience in several of the following areas is important:



* REST APIs & third-party API integrations

* OAuth 2.0 & token refresh

* PostgreSQL

* Multi-tenant architecture

* Background jobs / scheduled data synchronization

* Data normalization & historical data storage

* Secure authentication

* Role-based access control

* API rate limits, retries & error handling

* React / Next.js

* Node.js / NestJS or Python / FastAPI

* Git / GitHub

* Cloud deployment



Experience with APIs such as **Shopify, Meta/Instagram, TikTok, Amazon, Pinterest or Google** is a strong advantage.



### Backend quality is more important than fancy design.



The frontend should initially be clean and functional. However, it must use **reusable components and a well-structured frontend architecture**, so that a professional Figma/UI design can easily be implemented later.



## How We Want the Application to Work



At a high level, we are looking for an architecture similar to:



**External APIs ? Background Synchronization ? Data Storage / Normalization ? PostgreSQL ? Backend ? Web Dashboard**



We do **not** want external APIs to be queried every time a user opens the dashboard.



The application will eventually contain multiple clients, so proper and secure **tenant separation** is essential from the beginning.



The architecture should also make it easy to add additional API connectors later without rebuilding the entire system.



## Technical Questions



Please answer the following questions **briefly and in your own words**.



Specific answers based on real experience are much more valuable to us than long textbook-style answers.



**1.** You need to collect analytics data from five different external APIs. Would you call all five APIs whenever a user opens the dashboard? If not, how would you structure the system?



**2.** A scheduled synchronization suddenly receives repeated HTTP 429 responses. What is happening and what would your application do?



**3.** An OAuth access token expires while a background synchronization is running. How would you handle this?



**4.** Twenty clients use the same application. How would you make sure Client A can never access Client B's data, even if someone manually modifies an API request?



**5.** API A calls a metric `spend`, API B calls it `cost`, and another API provides the value in cents. How would you design the data layer so the application can work with one consistent metric?



**6.** An API only provides the current follower count, but the application needs to show follower growth over the last 90 days. How would you solve this?



**7.** Tell us briefly about the most difficult third-party API integration you have personally built. What made it difficult and how did you solve it?



**8.** Which technology stack would you choose for this project and why?



We may discuss your answers during a short interview.



## Paid Technical Trial – $65 Fixed Budget



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete the same small **paid technical trial project**.



**Fixed trial payment: $65 USD**



The trial is intentionally limited in scope and should take an experienced developer approximately **6–8 hours**.



The trial will use a real e-commerce use case with restricted access to one of our own projects.



### Trial Task



Build a small web-based analytics prototype that:



* Connects to one external API

* Retrieves selected real business data

* Stores the retrieved data in PostgreSQL

* Uses a basic synchronization process

* Displays approximately 3–5 KPIs

* Includes basic 7-day / 30-day filtering

* Includes a manual **Sync Now** function

* Uses a clean connector structure that could support additional APIs later

* Includes basic error handling

* Stores credentials securely



The required basic architecture is:



**External API ? Synchronization ? PostgreSQL ? Backend ? Dashboard**



The dashboard must read stored data from the database rather than calling the external platform every time the dashboard is opened.



### Trial Deliverables



Please provide:



* Working prototype

* Source code in our Git repository

* Database schema / migrations

* Short README / setup instructions

* Brief explanation of your architecture

* Short section: **“What I would improve for production”**



Please **do not spend unnecessary trial time on visual design**.



A simple and clean interface is enough.



We are evaluating:



**API integration ? architecture ? data accuracy ? security ? code quality ? problem solving**



After submission, we may have a short call where we ask you to walk us through your implementation and explain some of your technical decisions.



We are completely comfortable with developers using modern AI-assisted development tools. What matters is that **you understand, verify, can explain and take responsibility for the code you deliver.**



## Working Together After the Trial



If the trial is successful, we would like to continue development through clearly defined **milestones**.



Our preferred model is:



* Agreed hourly rate

* Clear scope for each milestone

* Estimated hours before starting

* Agreed maximum hour/budget range

* Review and approval before moving to the next milestone



We value transparency. If something takes longer than expected or an API creates an unexpected limitation, we want you to tell us early rather than silently spending additional hours.



There is significant potential for **ongoing development work** if the cooperation works well.



## What We Value



Beyond technical skills, we appreciate someone who is:



* Reliable

* Honest

* Solution-oriented

* Organized

* Comfortable communicating technical limitations

* Able to work independently

* Interested in clean, maintainable code

* Open to feedback

* Interested in a long-term collaboration



If you think one of our technical ideas should be approached differently, **tell us**. We value developers who think with us rather than simply follow instructions.



## How to Apply



Please include:



1. Your answers to the 8 technical questions

2. Your **hourly rate in USD**

3. Your weekly availability

4. Years of professional development experience

5. Your preferred technology stack

6. APIs you have personally worked with

7. Relevant GitHub, portfolio or project examples

8. Confirmation that the **$65 paid trial** works for you



Please start your application with: **API Dashboard** so we know you have read the complete job description.



We are looking forward to meeting you and hopefully building something great together!

title: Top 1% Cold Email & Outbound Specialist
description:
Calling All Top 1% Cold
 & Outbound Specialists

Remote · Full-time · AEST overlap · US$650–900/mo base + commission on closed clients



We could've written "fast-growing company seeks motivated
 marketing specialist." We didn't — same reason we don't send
s like that. One seat, one job: fill the calendar with the right conversations. You own outbound and the copy behind it. Not funnels, not ads, not automations — someone else owns those.



If you "also do a bit of
," this isn't it. If you pull a 20% reply rate on a list of 200 while the market gets 3 — keep reading.



APPLICATION KEY: Start your application with the word "COLD OPEN" and one line — your best cold reply rate and the list size. No keyword, no read.



You are the pattern interrupt

In a market drowning in beige, the interrupt is specificity. The same moment, two ways.



What the market sends:

"Hi there! I hope this
 finds you well. I'm reaching out from [Company], a leading provider of lead generation solutions. We help businesses like yours scale revenue with our proven system. Open to a quick 15-minute call to explore synergies?"



What we send:

"Subject: your quote form

Hey Dave — quick one. Your battery ad drops people on the homepage instead of a matching page, and your quote form asks nine questions. Homeowners bail around four. Free tip, do what you like with it.

While I've got you: I place exclusive solar leads, one business per lead, and I'm working out where the next lot should go. Reckon you might suit. Half an hour this week — Tue 10 or Thu 2? — Sash"



One gets deleted. One gets a reply. If you feel why, you might be our person.



What you own



The list — signal-based and hand-built, every name has a reason. Apollo, Sales Nav, Clay, AI research.

The first line — one true, specific observation. Never "Hi {first_name}."

The copy — the bespoke cold open and the templated ladder behind it, and in time Closara's whole outbound voice. You write it; the tech operator wires it.

Deliverability — SPF/DKIM/DMARC, spam under 0.3%, warmed domains only. In 2026 a bad domain is rejected outright, not spam-foldered. Non-negotiable.

The replies — one objective: a booked call. You never quote price.



What you need



A real campaign you ran — tool, domain setup, sequence, actual reply rates. First thing we check.

Deliverability fluency — if warm-up and DMARC aren't second nature, this isn't your seat.

Genuine direct-response copy — short, specific, human. 2–3 samples.

AI-native — and able to make it not sound like AI.

Full-time, single focus, AEST-overlapping hours.



Two hard rules



Never quote price. Not a number, not a range. When they ask: "That's the call — I'll get you in with Sash." A miss here is disqualifying.

Approved verticals only. Solar and battery first. Regulated (mortgage, finance, insurance) needs written sign-off; legal injury leads never. Unsure? Ask before you send.



The test — do this with your application



Find a real AU solar & battery installer in the Meta Ad Library. Name the one signal you'd lead with.

Write the cold open — under 80 words, subject included.

Write the 3-touch templated ladder behind it.

How would you build and enrich a list of 200, what would you automate, and what spam-complaint rate would you never cross?



The money

Modest base, real money on closes. You're paid when a client you sourced signs and pays — not for a booking, not for a show.



Base: US$600–900/mo on proven depth

US$200 per committed, paying client

+US$100 if they're still paying at 90 days

+US$200 for landing 5 in a month

A steady month runs ~US$1,550 take-home; a strong one ~US$2,350. A strong operator clears US$25,000+ a year — before we open the next vertical and the next country, which is where this seat is heading.



How to apply

Send: the keyword "COLD OPEN" + your best reply rate and list size; a walkthrough of one real campaign (tool, domain, sequence, reply rate — redacted screenshots fine); 2–3 cold
s you wrote; the four-part test; a 60-second Loom in English; confirmation of full-time AEST-overlapping hours.



Nail the keyword, the campaign and the test — you're already ahead of almost everyone. Those things ARE the job.

mber who understands the current workflow

title: Sr. Platform Engineer-PH
description:
About the Role



Pandoblox delivers enterprise-quality data platforms to mid-market companies in weeks, not months — a lean team amplified by AI. We're hiring a Senior Platform Engineer to own the infrastructure the entire client-delivery pipeline runs on, and to evolve it so a small team can stand up and operate many concurrent, fully-isolated client environments without scaling headcount.





This is a senior IC role: ~70% hands-on platform/infra/DevOps, 20% architecture & security, 10% reliability. You live in Terraform, GCP IAM, CI/CD, and Cloud Run. The mandate isn't infrastructure for its own sake — it's infrastructure that gets client outcomes shipped faster, safer, and more repeatably.



This role goes deep on infrastructure, not up into the app layer. If you'd rather be shipping product features and UI, this is the wrong seat.



Responsibilities:



In this role you'll get to...



- execute and own the following:

   - IaC (signal-iac)— the Terraform/OpenTofu estate; provision a new client with a one-line flag flip. Every change is a PR with a plan diff; prod applies only through a gated workflow. Build the paved road so the delivery team onboards a client through a safe, gated path, not a ticket to you.

   - GCP multi-tenancy— a two-tier project model with one isolated project per client; physical, per-project isolation enforced by IAM.

   - Runtime isolation at scale— the shared services (signal-agents,signal-mcp, Supabase) serve every client at once, so one client's load can never degrade another: per-tenant quotas, fairness, noisy-neighbor protection.

   - Identity & secrets— the keyless model (Workload Identity Federation, impersonated service accounts). No long-lived keys, no secrets in Git, no path from laptop to prod.

   - CI/CD— GitHub Actions: build-once-promote, OIDC/keyless auth, trunk-based with environment promotion.

   - Observability & cost— SLOs, freshness/failure alerting, evidence-first i
 response, and per-client cost attribution so margin stays visible as clients stack up.

- collaborate with the project team 

- perform other duties or responsibilities  needed by the role



Requirements:



On day one, we'll expect you to...



- have 8+ years of platform / infra / DevOps / SRE, owning cloud architecture end-to-end

- have 3-4 years of experience in Terraform / OpenTofu — production modules, multi-env, gated apply

- have 3-4 years of GCP experience — IAM & SA design, WIF, Cloud Run, networking, Secret Manager, BigQuery admin

- have 3-4 yars of CI/CD experience — GitHub Actions (or equivalent), OIDC/keyless, build-once-promote, trunk-based

- have 3-4 years of experience in security & identity judgment — keyless, least-privilege, gated-prod posture you own

- have 3-4 years of experience in multi-tenant isolation at both the data and runtime tiers

- provide proactive observability & i
 response — alerting, SLOs, evidence-first debugging, on-call coverage

- have 3-4 years of experience in per-client cost attribution / FinOps instincts

- have worked with AWS alongside GCP (QuickSight reporting path, Secrets Manager) for 3-4 years

- possess a delivery-first mindset: infra right-sized to delivery outcomes, not over-engineered

- have excellent written and verbal English communication skills

- have a fully functional and up-to-date computer with which to perform duties

- be willing to install next generation end point protection on the computer

- be a current resident of the Philippines and can perform work from there

- be willing to work within US Pacific timezone (8am - 5pm PST, 12AM - 9AM Manila time) or during client hours as required

- be willing to undergo a 90-days probationary period upon initial hire



Required Stack: Terraform/OpenTofu, GCP (Cloud Run, BigQuery, IAM, WIF, Secret Manager), GitHub Actions, Supabase, Vercel,  AWS (Quick, Secrets Manager), Claude (Anthropic API), and modern, opinionated, no legacy click-ops.



These are preferred experiences:



Multi-client/consulting delivery pipelines

- Supabase/Vercel ops 

- Cloud Run cold-start & scaling tuning 

- AI-agent / LLM runtime infra (MCP, model APIs) 

- AI-augmented engineering workflows



This is a remote, work from home job.

title: SEO Growth Specialist – Permanent Part-Time
description:
SEO Growth Specialist – Permanent Part-Time



Hours: Approximately 20–25 hours per week

Starting salary: US$350 per month

Position: Permanent part-time

Paid practical test required for shortlisted applicants



I run an established local service website that already generates customers through organic Google search.



The website has a large amount of existing content covering specific customer problems and search queries. Some pages already rank in positions #1–#3, while many others are appearing further down Google and may have good potential to move higher.



I am looking for an experienced SEO person to work with me on a permanent part-time basis.



This is not freelance consultancy. It is not an agency role. And I am not looking for someone to spend two hours running Semrush and send me a PDF.



I want somebody who can become familiar with the website, understand what we are trying to achieve, find genuine opportunities and become more valuable to the business over time.



What I want you to work on



Your first priority will be working with Google Search Console to find SEO opportunities that already exist within the website.



In particular, I want you looking for:



* Search queries and pages ranking roughly positions 5–30

* Page 2 and page 3 rankings that may realistically be moved onto page 1

* Pages already receiving useful impressions but relatively few clicks

* Pages where Google is already showing strong relevance for a valuable search

* Opportunities where relatively small improvements may produce a worthwhile ranking improvement

* Internal-linking opportunities

* Pages that may be competing against each other

* Search queries Google is already associating with the website that we could target better

* Content gaps worth pursuing

* Opportunities that could result in real paying customers, rather than traffic simply for the sake of increasing traffic



I don't just want a spreadsheet containing hundreds of keywords.



I want you to find the opportunities worth spending our time on.



For an opportunity you recommend, I expect you to be able to show me the query, the ranking page, impressions, clicks, position and any other relevant evidence, explain why you selected it, and tell me what you believe we should do about it.



The website is already working



I'm not hiring somebody because the website is broken. It already ranks well for numerous searches and generates paying customers.



I have built and managed the site myself and have a reasonable working knowledge of SEO and Google Search Console. I know what I am trying to achieve.



I'm hiring because I want somebody with more SEO knowledge and experience than I have who can find opportunities I'm missing and spend the time analysing them properly.



If you recommend changing something, expect me to ask why.



If you know something, tell me.



If you don't know, say you don't know.



If something is a theory, tell me it's a theory.



Don't bluff me.



I have no interest in SEO work being done simply so somebody can fill in a weekly report and show me they have been busy.



You will not have free rein over the website



Initially, no significant changes will be made without my approval.



That includes major changes to content, URLs, titles, redirects, canonicals, plugins, site structure or anything else that could affect pages that are already performing.



I'm not interested in somebody arriving with their normal SEO checklist and changing everything because that's how they normally work.



Bring me the opportunity. Show me the evidence. Tell me what you recommend.



If it makes sense, we'll make a controlled change and measure what actually happens.



As we work together and build trust, I am happy for you to take more responsibility.



Important – a large amount of content is only just entering Google



There is an unusual situation with the website at the moment that you need to understand.



A substantial backlog of existing articles was previously not indexed by Google. I am currently working through these pages manually, and potentially 100+ existing pages may enter Google's index over a relatively short period.



These are not necessarily new articles. Many have existed for some time but are only now beginning to generate Search Console impressions and ranking data.



This means Search Console data may move around considerably over the coming weeks.



I need somebody who understands the difference between a page indexed five days ago that Google is still testing and an established page with months of data sitting at position 12 that may genuinely be a good candidate for improvement.



I do not want somebody rewriting newly indexed pages simply because their initial positions aren't good.



Likewise, I don't want somebody looking at the site's overall average position, seeing that it has changed after a large number of pages entered the index, and drawing conclusions without investigating the underlying data.



This is a long-term position



I am looking for a permanent part-time employee, approximately 20–25 hours per week.



The starting salary is US$350 per month.



If you prove that you are genuinely good at finding opportunities, making sensible recommendations and helping produce measurable improvements, I am happy to review the salary as the role develops.



I don't expect miracles. I do expect useful work.



I also operate another established website that may eventually require similar SEO work, so there is plenty of potential for this position to develop with the right person.



How to apply



Please do not send me a generic SEO proposal.



I don't need a list telling me you can do SEO audits, keyword research, backlinks, meta descriptions, competitor analysis, on-page SEO, off-page SEO and technical SEO. I already know what those things are.



Instead, answer these two questions in your own words:



1. You have access to my Google Search Console and find an existing page averaging position 14 for a relevant search query. How would you d
 whether that page is genuinely a good opportunity to push onto page 1? What would you investigate before recommending any changes?



2. Around 100 existing pages on the website have only recently entered Google's index. How would you analyse Search Console without allowing those newly indexed pages to distort your conclusions about the established part of the website?



Keep your answers practical.



If you don't answer both questions, I won't consider your application.



Shortlisted applicants



Shortlisted applicants will be offered a small paid practical test using real Search Console data.



The test will involve identifying a handful of genuine SEO opportunities from the existing website and explaining why you selected them.



I am interested in seeing how you think and how you prioritise, not how good you are at producing a generic SEO report.



If the paid test goes well, the successful applicant will be offered the permanent part-time position.

title: CS Retention Manager – $2,000 Base p/m + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.

- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Fractional Business Development & Strategic Partnerships Lead
description:
# Fractional Business Development & Strategic Partnerships Lead



**Civic Tech / GovTech / Enterprise Technology**

**Remote — UK / Europe preferred**

**Approx. 10 hours per week | 30-day paid trial**



Votari is not looking for a generic salesperson.



We are looking for an experienced **fractional business development and strategic partnerships operator** who can help turn an already-developed technology, existing relationships and emerging market opportunities into **pilots, partnerships and credible reference customers**.



If your approach to business development is primarily high-volume cold
, automated LinkedIn outreach, appointment setting or closing from a script, this role is probably not a fit.



We need someone who can understand a technically sophisticated product, identify where it genuinely solves an institutional problem, navigate complex organisations, develop relationships intelligently and bring the founder into the conversation at the right stage.



## About Votari



Votari is a mobile voting and governance platform designed around a simple principle:



**Trust the proof, not the platform.**



Rather than requiring participants to trust the voting operator, Votari is being built around cryptographic verifiability, privacy-preserving architecture and independently auditable election records.



The product is live on iOS and Android and is moving from product development into the next stage: **real-world pilots, institutional validation, partnerships and market evidence**.



Potential markets include:



* associations and membership organisations

* universities and student governance

* professional bodies

* corporate governance

* NGOs and civic organisations

* participation platforms

* public-sector and GovTech ecosystems

* technology and systems-integration partners



We are deliberately not starting with national government elections.



Our immediate objective is to establish credible organisational use cases and build a portfolio of successful deployments.



## The Role



You will work directly with Votari's founder for approximately **10 hours per week**.



Your primary responsibility is to build and progress a high-quality business-development and partnership pipeline.



This is not a traditional quota-carrying sales role.



The emphasis is on:



* identifying strong pilot opportunities

* qualifying organisations properly

* developing strategic relationships

* progressing existing warm opportunities

* creating partnerships and distribution channels

* converting conversations into pilots

* helping turn pilots into case studies and reference customers



You will own the commercial process between initial identification and the point where founder-level involvement is most valuable.



## What You Will Do



You will:



* Review and structure Votari's existing business-development pipeline.

* Identify organisations where Votari has a credible pilot use case.

* Research and qualify decision-makers.

* Initiate selective, high-quality outreach.

* Progress warm introductions and existing relationships.

* Hold introductory and qualification calls where appropriate.

* Develop pilot propositions with the founder.

* Prepare follow-up material, one-pagers and partnership proposals.

* Manage the commercial CRM and follow-up cadence.

* Identify partnership opportunities with civic-tech, participation and enterprise platforms.

* Help develop university, association and professional-body pilot opportunities.

* Coordinate pilots from the commercial side.

* Capture commercial feedback and recurring objections.

* Help turn successful pilots into case studies, testimonials and institutional references.

* Prepare the founder for important meetings with concise account briefs and recommended objectives.

* Maintain a disciplined pipeline rather than accumulating unqualified leads.



## What You Will Not Be Expected to Do



You will not be expected to:



* understand or explain Votari's full cryptographic architecture immediately

* act as a software engineer

* conduct mass cold-calling campaigns

* generate hundreds of low-quality leads

* operate from rigid sales scripts

* promise features or deployment capabilities without agreement

* negotiate sensitive technical or IP disclosures independently

* personally close every strategic account



Founder-level discussions, deep technical conversations, major strategic negotiations and sensitive partnerships will remain with Votari's founder.



## Who We Are Looking For



We are particularly interested in people with experience in one or more of:



* enterprise B2B technology

* GovTech

* civic tech

* digital identity

* RegTech

* governance technology

* public-sector technology

* SaaS partnerships

* systems integration

* association or membership technology

* cybersecurity or trust infrastructure

* early-stage enterprise software



You should have experience developing opportunities where the buyer is not making an impulsive purchasing decision.



You should be comfortable speaking with senior stakeholders and dealing with sales cycles involving multiple decision-makers, institutional trust, procurement or pilot evaluation.



Startup experience is strongly preferred.



## You Are Probably a Good Fit If



* You have personally developed strategic accounts or partnerships from an early stage.

* You can distinguish an interesting contact from a genuine commercial opportunity.

* You know how to run discovery rather than simply pitch.

* You are comfortable working closely with a technical founder.

* You can write strong follow-ups and commercial proposals.

* You are highly organised and disciplined with CRM.

* You are capable of working independently without needing a large sales organisation around you.

* You understand that the goal at this stage is **evidence and market credibility**, not vanity pipeline.

* You are willing to do both strategic work and the practical execution required to move deals forward.



## Engagement Structure



**Initial engagement:** approximately 10 hours per week.



**Initial period:** 30-day paid trial.



The first month is deliberately structured as a mutual evaluation period.



We will assess the engagement based on whether you can:



* understand Votari's market and positioning quickly

* bring structure to the existing pipeline

* identify credible opportunities

* progress conversations

* improve follow-up discipline

* reduce founder workload

* create measurable movement toward pilots and partnerships



If the trial is successful, the intention is to continue on a longer-term fractional basis, with the potential to increase hours as commercial activity grows.



## Compensation



This is a **paid fractional consulting role**, not an unpaid advisory position and not a commission-only sales role.



We are open to either:



* an agreed hourly/day rate; or

* a fixed monthly fractional retainer based on approximately 10 hours per week.



For the right person, we are also open to discussing **performance-related upside linked to meaningful commercial outcomes**, such as qualified pilots, partnerships or contracted business.



We are more interested in finding the right operator than the cheapest applicant.



Please include your expected rate or monthly retainer when applying.



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first 60–90 days, we would expect to see:



* a clean and prioritised commercial pipeline

* disciplined follow-up of existing relationships

* a qualified target universe

* several genuine institutional conversations

* multiple plausible pilot opportunities

* clear movement toward at least one reference deployment

* early strategic partnership conversations

* materially less founder time spent on commercial administration



The quality of the opportunities matters more than the volume.



## How to Apply



Please do **not** send a generic sales CV with a paragraph about exceeding quotas.



Instead, tell us briefly:



1. What type of organisations have you personally developed partnerships or enterprise opportunities with?

2. Give one example of a relationship you took from initial contact to a meaningful pilot, partnership or contract.

3. What would you do in your first 30 days at Votari?

4. Which part of the civic-tech / GovTech / governance market do you think would be the strongest initial route for a product like Votari?

5. What is your availability for a 10-hour-per-week fractional engagement?

6. What hourly rate or monthly retainer would you propose?



Applications demonstrating thoughtful understanding of the problem will be prioritised over generic sales applications.

We run a fast-growing Instagram brand in the dog health space for a US audience. **Remote / Virtual Role | Residential Construction | Project Builders, Dunedin NZ**



## About Project Builders



Project Builders is a residential building company based in Dunedin, New Zealand, specialising in renovations, extensions and new homes.



We’re a small, established team and place a big emphasis on planning, clear communication and running well-organised projects. We’re continually improving our systems and how we track projects, with the goal of giving both our team and our clients better visibility throughout a build.



We’re looking for someone to become part of that process and support our team with estimating, job costing, purchase orders and project tracking.



This isn't a general administration or bookkeeping position. We need someone who understands **construction** and can look at a set of plans, an invoice or a supplier order and understand what they're looking at.



## The Role



As our **Construction Cost & Project Coordinator**, you'll help us keep accurate, up-to-date information on each project from estimating through construction.



A big part of your role will be knowing:



**Where are we at? What have we spent? What have we committed to? Are we tracking against the estimate? What's coming up next? Is anything starting to go off track?**



You'll work alongside our Project Manager and Operations Manager, providing the information and support they need to make good project decisions.



## Key Responsibilities



### Job Costing & Financial Tracking



* Allocate supplier and subcontractor invoices to the correct job and cost category.

* Maintain accurate job costing throughout each project.

* Track estimated costs against actual and committed costs.

* Complete regular back costing and identify significant variances.

* Monitor how each job is tracking financially.

* Identify potential overruns, missing costs, incorrect allocations or unusual expenditure.

* Maintain accurate job cost information within our systems.

* Assist with regular job-specific financial reporting.



### Purchase Orders & Procurement



* Create and manage purchase orders for projects.

* Ensure POs are allocated to the correct job and cost category.

* Match invoices against POs, supplier quotes and agreed pricing.

* Follow up discrepancies between orders, invoices and quoted costs.

* Maintain visibility of committed costs that haven't yet been invoiced.

* Assist with supplier and subcontractor RFQs and quote comparisons.



### Estimating Support



* Read and understand residential construction plans and specifications.

* Assist with preparing and updating project estimates.

* Enter supplier, subcontractor and material pricing.

* Send RFQs and follow up outstanding pricing.

* Compare supplier and subcontractor quotes against the required scope.

* Assist with maintaining current supplier pricing and estimating information.

* Identify missing information, pricing or scope items and flag these for review.



### Project & Schedule Tracking



* Maintain project schedules and key dates based on information from the Project Manager.

* Track actual progress against the project programme.

* Keep project information and systems current as jobs progress.

* Monitor upcoming stages, orders and subcontractor requirements.

* Identify potential scheduling or cost issues early and bring them to the Project Manager's attention.

* Assist with keeping project documentation organised and current.



## What We're Looking For



You **must** have:



* Experience working within the construction industry.

* The ability to confidently read and understand residential building plans and specifications.

* A good understanding of construction terminology, sequencing, materials and subcontractor trades.

* Experience with purchase orders and job costing.

* Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.

* The ability to understand the relationship between an estimate, PO, invoice, committed cost and actual job cost.

* Strong written and spoken English.

* Confidence to question something when it doesn't look right rather than simply processing it.



Experience in **estimating, quantity surveying, construction administration or project coordination** would be particularly valuable.



We use **WunderBuild**, so previous WunderBuild experience would be fantastic, although we know this may be difficult to find. Experience using other construction estimating, job management or project management software will be highly regarded.



## What Success Looks Like



Our job costing is accurate and current. We can easily see estimated vs committed vs actual costs. Back costing happens throughout the project rather than after it's finished.



Our project schedules and information are kept up to date, and potential cost or scheduling problems are identified early.



Most importantly, our Project Manager can spend less time maintaining information and chasing pricing, costs and paperwork, and more time managing our projects.



## A Bit About You



We're a small team, so we're not just looking for someone who can tick off tasks.



We're looking for someone who is organised, curious and comfortable taking ownership of their area. You notice when something doesn't make sense. You ask questions. You like getting to the bottom of discrepancies and you enjoy creating order from a lot of moving pieces.



You don't need to know everything on day one, but you do need to understand residential construction and be willing to learn how **we** do things.



## How to Apply



**Your application must have the heading: BANANA MILKSHAKE**



Please also send us a **short video made specifically for this application to Project Builders**.



In your video, tell us:



* A little about yourself and your personality.

* Your specific construction experience.

* Your experience reading residential plans.

* What estimating, job costing, purchase order and project scheduling experience you have.

* What construction/project management software you've worked with.

* Which parts of this role you think you're particularly strong in.

* Why you think you'd be a good fit for this role at Project Builders.



**Please don't send us a general introduction video that you use for multiple job applications.** We want to hear from you specifically about this role, our business and the skills you have that relate to what we're looking for.



We're not looking for a highly produced video. A simple video recorded on your phone or computer is absolutely fine. We're interested in how you communicate, who you are and whether you've taken the time to understand the role.



Applications without the **BANANA MILKSHAKE** heading or a role-specific video will not be considered.

title: Short-Form Editor for UGC Creator Personal Brand
description:
Short-Form Video Editor Needed



I’m looking for a creative short-form video editor to help edit content for my UGC business.



The goal is to produce around one to three videos per day. Most videos will be under 60 seconds and posted on Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



I do not want every video edited the exact same way.



Some videos should be clean and organic with simple cuts, captions, and light zooms. Other videos should be more fast-paced and include B-roll, animations, screenshots, graphics, sound effects, or other creative elements.



We will provide examples and references for the general styles we want, but I also want to see your own creative style.



I want to know:



* How well can you edit?

* Can you make a basic talking-head video more engaging?

* Do you know when to keep an edit simple?

* Can you add B-roll, graphics, animations, or charts when needed?

* Can you match different editing styles?



There will be paid testing before anyone is hired. You will receive raw footage, instructions, and example videos to follow.



This is not a one-time project. I have generated hundreds of millions of views through UGC content, and I am now focused on growing this business even further. The right editor can expect consistent, long-term work and the opportunity to grow with the business.



## Requirements



* Experience editing short-form content

* Strong pacing and clean captions

* Good understanding of TikTok, Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Able to follow references and instructions

* Able to work independently and make creative decisions

* Reliable communication and turnaround times

* Comfortable editing both organic and more heavily edited videos



## How to Apply



Please send:



1. Your short-form editing portfolio

2. Your three best editing examples

3. The software you use

4. Your usual turnaround time

5. Your expected monthly rate for one video per day

6. A short explanation of what you would do to make a basic talking-head video more engaging



Somewhere in your application, include the phrase “organic first.” Do not put it at the beginning or end of your message.



Applicants who do not include relevant editing examples will not be considered.

description:

I'm Kama Newbry, RN and Nurse Coach, founder of Synergy Rising and host of the Dancing With Dementia™ & Caregivers Rising™ Podcast. I'm building real resources and a real community for young, young-at-heart, and atypical caregivers... and I'm looking for a WEB, FUNNEL & TECH wizard to rise alongside me as we grow.



The role in one line: website, funnel, automation, and social media support... the tech-and-systems magic that keeps our mission moving and growing.



A note on the team: this is a TEAM. You'll work closely with me AND with my executive/personal assistant VA, so collaboration and clear communication are part of the magic.



What you'll do:



~Build and maintain our websites, funnels, and landing pages

~Set up and manage AUTOMATIONS that make everything run smoother (this is a MUST-have skill, not a nice-to-have)

~Work inside FG Funnels as our home base... more on that below

~Take feedback and run with it... I love collaborators who hear a note, get it, and make it even better



The FG Funnels thing (please read closely):



We build in FG Funnels. FG Funnels is a white-label of GoHighLevel... so it is SIMILAR, but it is NOT the same, and I need someone who honors that. Even if you're a High Level expert, you must be willing to follow FG FUNNELS' OWN processes, tutorials, and live support... never assuming "this is how High Level does it, so this is how FG does it." Willingness to learn and follow OUR way is non-negotiable.

Part of this role touches our podcast and content, so knowing our heart and voice matters. For now, our trailer is a beautiful place to start (link below).



Who you are:



~AUTOMATION knowledge is a MUST... you understand workflows, triggers, and building systems that scale

 communication

 A short intro about you and your experience... especially with websites, funnels, & tech support.

Let's build something meaningful, heart-centered, and wildly impactful... together! And if you know someone who'd be a great fit, please send them our way. 



When one rises, we all rise.



~ Kama

title: Senior Project Manager - Scientific Software
description:
About Our Company



We are a life-sciences software company, founded in 2000, that builds and supports chemical inventory, laboratory safety, and R&D-workflow applications for global pharmaceutical and biotech customers. Our flagship platforms and companion products work together to give bench scientists and lab operations teams fast, compliant access to chemical inventory. Adjacent products that manage synthesis outsourcing workflow and instrument tracking extend our footprint deeper into pharma R&D operations.



We are also in the middle of significant technology modernization, moving from Oracle, IIS, 
 Framework toward an open-source PostgreSQL, Node.js, React, and Linux stack, while keeping legacy systems running for customers who currently depend on them.



The Role



We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to take direct, full-time ownership of our development team's execution — working closely with the Technical Director to turn technical priorities into a tracked, realistic delivery plan — alongside client coordination, delivery tracking across several concurrently active products, and vendor/contract administration. This role will coordinate multi-team customer engagements and drive consistent prioritization, tracking, and documentation practices across our product lines and engineering team, giving the founders and Technical Director room to focus on technical direction rather than day-to-day coordination.



This is a highly cross-functional role. You will be the connective tissue between our engineering team, our enterprise customers' business groups, IT stakeholders, and our external vendors. You will have the opportunity to build much of the process and structure for all coordination and touch points.



Ownership



Development process management



- Partner with the Technical Director to turn technical priorities into a tracked, realistic delivery plan across our concurrently active products.

- Own the engineering team's delivery cadence — tracking work in progress, maintaining backlog visibility, and escalating blockers — to ensure the team is executing against agreed priorities.

- Work with the Technical Director to set realistic timelines before they are committed to customers, and surface trade-offs between scope, timeline, and technical risk.



Client delivery coordination



- Own day-to-day coordination across our largest, most complex customer engagement — a multi-year, multi-product relationship spanning several internal teams and several concurrent workstreams (inventory management, safety/compliance reporting, synthesis-outsourcing workflow, and new product rollouts).

- Track and drive resolution of cross-organizational blockers — for example, our current integration with a customer's enterprise procurement platform requires coordination of definitive ownership and access processes to customer systems to support our own engineering efforts.

- Support delivery coordination for all active customer relationships and new-site/new-deployment rollouts as they arise.



Documentation governance and knowledge management



- Drive consistent, current project documentation across our product teams.

- Champion our documentation philosophy of a single source of truth per project, written in Markdown and version-controlled in GitHub, with integrated issue and project tracking. Own documentation-consolidation projects that bring all project documentation and associated technical details into a single, well-organized home.



Vendor & contract tracking



- Track and support renewal cycles for key third-party software licensing relationships.

Roadmap & status reporting

- Establish lightweight, sustainable status-reporting and roadmap-tracking practices across our concurrently active products, integrated with our GitHub Organization-based project and issue tracking.

- Create visibility for the founders and Technical Director into what is in process, what is blocked, and what needs escalation across the project portfolio.



What We Are Looking For



Required



- Significant professional project or program management experience — 7+ years is typical, but exceptional candidates with less experience who demonstrate strong ownership and leadership ability are encouraged to apply — ideally in B2B or enterprise software serving large customer organizations.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent client relationships and workstreams simultaneously, with strong prioritization instincts.

- Comfort operating inside large-enterprise customer IT and procurement processes — ticketing systems, security reviews, vendor-governance requirements — and the persistence to drive resolution when a customer-side process stalls.

- Strong documentation and process-discipline instincts, with real experience establishing and maintaining project documentation and tracking practices.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable translating between technical engineering detail and business/customer-facing stakeholders.



Preferred



- Experience in life sciences, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other scientific/regulated software industries.

- Familiarity with chemistry or cheminformatics concepts, or genuine willingness to learn the domain — you do not necessarily need a science background, but you will be coordinating work that involves chemical structure data, regulatory chemical classifications, and lab safety compliance.

- Experience tracking software vendor and licensing contracts and renewal cycles.

- Comfort working within a Markdown-based, Git-versioned documentation and knowledge-management system — familiarity with tools in this space is a plus, but a genuine willingness to learn and become expert in our documentation standards is what matters most.

- PMP or similar project management certification is a plus but not required.



A note on domain background



Deep cheminformatics or chemistry expertise is not necessarily required for this role — but the ability to bring genuine curiosity about scientific and laboratory software and quickly become comfortable with our domain's vocabulary will be most important for success and growth in this role.



IMPORTANT: Please provide your resume and response as a PDF attachment to your response.
