title: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT – RIDESHARE CAR RENTAL SALES
description:
: VIRTUAL ASSISTANT – RIDESHARE CAR RENTAL SALES 

Location: Remote

Industry: Rideshare Car Rental

Company: Houston Rideshare Car

Employment Type: Part-Time / Long-Term

ABOUT THE ROLE

Houston Rideshare Car is looking for a highly motivated, organized, and sales-focused Virtual Assistant to join our growing rideshare car rental business.

This is not just a customer service position. We need someone who knows how to find potential Uber/Lyft drivers, follow up consistently, convert leads into paying customers, keep our waiting list active, and make sure our vehicles stay rented.

If you are a natural salesperson, excellent communicator, organized, persistent, and comfortable working with CRM systems, we want to hear from you.

YOUR MAIN OBJECTIVE

Keep our cars rented and our pipeline full of qualified rideshare drivers.

You will be responsible for managing the entire customer journey—from the first inquiry to onboarding, rental payment, vehicle pickup, and ongoing customer follow-up.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Lead Generation

• Find qualified Uber, Lyft and other 
 drivers through
, Instagram, TikTok, Craigslist, Marketplace, WhatsApp and other platforms.

• Respond quickly to new inquiries.

• Proactively reach out to potential drivers.

• Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified prospects.

• Identify drivers who are ready to rent immediately.

• Maintain an active waiting list for drivers who are not yet ready.

• Re-engage old and inactive leads regularly.

2. Sales & Lead Conversion

You will be expected to sell the rental opportunity, not simply answer questions.

• Call new leads and qualify them.

• Explain rental rates, requirements, deposits, vehicle options and rental terms.

• Overcome common objections.

• Follow up with leads until they make a decision.

• Schedule vehicle viewings/pickups.

• Convert qualified prospects into paying renters.

• Track every lead and its status in the CRM.

• Follow up with prospects who say, "I'll think about it."

• Maintain a daily follow-up schedule so no qualified lead is forgotten.

3. CRM Management

You will use GoHighLevel CRM and RentCentric to maintain accurate customer records.

Every lead must have:

• Name

• Phone number

•

• Rideshare platform

• Driver status

• Vehicle preference

• Desired rental start date

• Lead source

• Current status

• Follow-up date

• Notes from conversations

No lead should disappear from the system.

4. Driver Onboarding

Once a driver is approved:

• Collect required documents.

• Verify that all required information has been received.

• Prepare and send rental agreements.

• Send payment/deposit requests.

• Confirm payment.

• Schedule vehicle pickup.

• Make sure the driver understands rental rules and responsibilities.

• Update the CRM and rental management system.

• Follow up after pickup to ensure a smooth start.

5. Customer Service & Driver Retention

Keeping a good driver is just as important as finding a new one.

You will:

• Check in with active drivers.

• Respond promptly to questions and concerns.

• Follow up when payments are approaching.

• Identify potential problems before they become serious.

• Help maintain positive driver relationships.

• Encourage qualified drivers to continue renting long-term.

• Identify drivers who may be considering leaving and escalate the issue to management.

6. Vehicle Utilization

A major part of this position is helping us reduce vehicle downtime.

If a vehicle becomes available, you should immediately:

1. Check the waiting list.

2. Contact qualified prospects.

3. Post the availability where appropriate.

4. Follow up with previous leads.

5. Schedule appointments.

6. Work toward getting the vehicle rented as quickly as possible.

An empty vehicle is lost revenue.

7. Social Media & Marketing

• Create simple
 and Instagram posts.

• Create short-form videos/reels.

• Repurpose existing marketing content.

• Post available vehicles.

• Promote weekly and long-term rental options.

• Respond to comments and direct messages.

• Identify social media groups where rideshare drivers are active.

• Generate new leads through organic outreach.

Basic Canva and CapCut/video-editing skills are preferred.

DAILY PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

The successful candidate should be prepared to work toward measurable daily targets, including:

• Responding to new leads promptly.

• Making outbound calls every day.

• Following up with existing prospects.

• Updating 100% of assigned leads in the CRM.

• Maintaining the driver waiting list.

• Scheduling qualified appointments.

• Re-engaging old leads.

• Promoting available vehicles.

• Reporting daily sales activity and results.

WE WILL MEASURE SUCCESS BY:

Leads ? Conversations ? Qualified Drivers ? Appointments ? Rentals ? Driver Retention

We are looking for someone who understands that activity must ultimately produce results.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Previous experience in sales, customer service, appointment setting or virtual assistance.

• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Strong telephone communication skills.

• Comfortable making outbound calls.

• Strong follow-up and persuasion skills.

• Experience with CRM systems.

• GoHighLevel experience is strongly preferred.

• RentCentric experience is a plus.

• Experience with
/Instagram lead generation.

• Basic Canva and/or CapCut skills.

• Excellent organizational skills.

• Ability to work independently.

• Reliable internet connection and computer.

• Quiet environment for professional phone calls.

• Strong attention to detail.

• Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines.

THE TYPE OF PERSON WE WANT

You should be:

Proactive – You don't wait to be told what to do.

Persistent – You follow up until the lead is converted or clearly disqualified.

Sales-minded – You understand how to turn conversations into customers.

Organized – You keep the CRM, waiting list and customer records updated.

Fast – You understand that responding quickly can mean the difference between getting the customer and losing them.

Accountable – You take ownership of your numbers and results.

Customer-focused – You treat every driver professionally.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE EXPERIENCE WITH:

• Uber/Lyft driver recruitment

• Car rental

• Rideshare operations

• GoHighLevel

• RentCentric

•
 Marketplace

 Groups

COMPENSATION

Performance Bonuses: Available for measurable results, including qualified driver conversions and successful vehicle rentals.

We believe the right person should have an opportunity to earn more by producing more.

HOW TO APPLY

2. A 2–3 minute video introduction

In your video, tell us:

• Who you are and where you are located.

IMPORTANT

If you are confident on the phone, love sales, enjoy working with people, and know how to turn leads into customers, we want to meet you.

Apply today and help us keep Houston's rideshare drivers moving!

Houston Rideshare Car

title: Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Google Ads, SEO & Growth)
description:
Cooper Roofing Inc.



Senior Digital Marketing Manager (Google Ads, SEO & Growth)







Location: Remote (Philippines preferred). Applicants must maintain at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours. Five to eight hours of overlap is ideal.







Lead the Marketing Growth of an Established Service Business

Cooper Roofing is an award-winning roofing company serving Greater Vancouver and the Lower Mainland. We are bringing our marketing operations in-house and looking for an experienced Digital Marketing Manager to lead measurable growth through Google Ads, SEO, conversion optimization, and marketing analytics.



This is not a Social Media Manager position. We already have one in place.



We need someone who can take ownership of our paid and organic search strategy, improve lead generation, strengthen attribution, and help build a scalable customer-acquisition system.



You will report directly to the Founder and CEO.



Key Responsibilities

Reactivate, manage, and optimize Google Ads using six years of historical campaign data.

Develop and lead technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO strategies.

Manage Google Local Services Ads and Meta Ads where appropriate.

Improve landing-page conversion rates through testing and optimization.

Manage GoHighLevel tracking, dynamic number insertion, number pools, UTMs, and nurture sequences.

Maintain accurate attribution between marketing spend, leads, sales, and closed revenue.

Own Google Business Profile optimization, review generation, and local reputation strategy.

Conduct competitor analysis across advertising, SEO, offers, and positioning.

Develop seasonal lead-generation campaigns for roofing demand cycles.

Provide clear SEO and development direction to our web developer.

Direct the Social Media Manager's output where it supports the wider marketing strategy.

Produce weekly reports connecting marketing performance to actual business results.

Present results, explain performance, and recommend next steps directly to the CEO.

What We're Looking For

Strong Google Ads and SEO experience is essential.



We are specifically looking for someone with:



Demonstrated experience independently managing and optimizing Google Ads.

Strong technical, on-page, local, and off-page SEO knowledge.

A proven track record of generating qualified leads and revenue for a service-based business.

Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, conversion rates, ROI, ROAS, and revenue attribution.

Experience with conversion tracking, call tracking, Google Analytics, Search Console, and Google Business Profile.

Experience developing SEO strategies and directing web developers.

Experience with GoHighLevel or a comparable CRM and marketing automation platform.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn campaign data into clear decisions.

Excellent written English and strong organizational skills.

Experience managing contractors, content creators, or other marketing team members.

Experience in roofing, construction, home services, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, remodeling, landscaping, or another local B2C service industry is highly valued.



Familiarity with JobNimbus, JustCall, Local Services Ads, structured data, AI-search optimization, or conversion-rate optimization is also an asset.



Who This Role Is Not For

This role is not primarily focused on:



Social media posting

Content scheduling

Graphic design

Influencer marketing

Community management

Brand-awareness campaigns without measurable lead-generation responsibility

We already have social media support.



We need someone whose strongest skills are Google Ads, SEO, analytics, attribution, and growing a service business through measurable digital marketing.



Pay and Benefits

Full-time independent contractor position.

Base salary: $1,000-$1,500 USD per month, paid bi-weekly, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.

Salary paid bi-weekly.

Thirteenth-month bonus for candidates based in the Philippines; an equivalent structure may be discussed for candidates located elsewhere.

Direct access to the Founder and CEO.

Access to six years of historical campaign data, an existing Social Media Manager, and a web developer.

Ongoing professional development and meaningful ownership of a major business function.

Final candidates may be invited to complete a paid skills assessment.

Applicants must consistently provide at least three hours of overlap with Vancouver business hours.

Candidates working from the Philippines should be comfortable maintaining the required evening or overnight schedule long term.

Why Cooper Roofing?

We are looking for someone who wants genuine responsibility for business growth.



Success in this role will be measured by qualified leads, customer acquisition cost, revenue, and growth, not social engagement metrics.



If you have strong Google Ads and SEO experience and can demonstrate how your marketing work has helped a service business generate leads and revenue, we want to hear from you.



Cooper Roofing encourages applications from qualified candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

title: Really Really Great Graphics & Social Media Manager
description:
Hi there! I'm Dr. Tomayia 
 on Instagram. 



READ THIS PART. Record a Loom Video with today's date and send when applying. 



Submissions without a loom video will not be considered. 



Instagram Reels Editor (Part-Time / Contract)



Hi there! I'm looking for a talented short-form video editor to join my world and help bring my Instagram content to life.



Here's how it works: I record my content on my iPhone and drop it into a shared iCloud folder. From there, you take the reins. You pull the footage together into polished, scroll-stopping Reels and deliver them back on a consistent weekly rhythm. I'll always give you what you need to succeed, and once we find our groove, this becomes a simple, repeatable system we both love.



I'll be honest about the kind of person I'm hoping to find. I'm looking for someone that is kind, a go-getter heart, and a smart, capable approach to their work. I don't have the capacity to micromanage, and truthfully, I don't want to. I want a partner I can trust to take the vision, run with it, and keep things moving. If you're someone who naturally sees what needs to happen and takes care of it, you're going to fit right in here.



The style I'm going for:

Think clean, bright, and polished, in the style of Amy Porterfield. Bold, easy-to-read captions, simple and smooth transitions, and a warm, professional feel. Educational and encouraging over trendy or flashy. The editing should feel current and intentional, never chaotic or gimmicky.



Your weekly deliverables:



3 to 4 Reels (10 to 15 seconds each) from my iPhone footage, complete with on-screen text, smooth transitions, and clean color grading

One sales post, edited and ready to go

One carousel post, created in Claude (don't worry, I'll walk you through my process)



The details/pay:

This is a part-time, ongoing contract role with a flat weekly rate of $40/week for the full package above. The workload is steady and predictable, so once we're in a rhythm you'll know exactly what to expect each week.



You'll thrive in this role if you:



Have strong short-form editing skills for Reels, TikTok, or Shorts, with a natural eye for pacing and hooks

Can add crisp on-screen captions and transitions that feel fresh and current

Know your way around color grading and can keep my content consistent and on-brand

Are self-directed and resourceful, the kind of person who solves problems and keeps things moving

Communicate clearly and honor your deadlines



Bonus points if you:



Have a feel for Instagram trends and trending audio

Love building beautiful carousels

Appreciate a bold, colorful personal brand



Ready to apply?

I'd love to see your work! Send me 2 to 3 examples of Reels you've edited (links are perfect), your typical turnaround time, and confirmation that the flat weekly rate works for you. I can't wait to meet you.

title: Sales & Marketing Specialist
description:
ABOUT STOCK2CASH



Stock2Cash is an Australian, technology-driven eCommerce business helping retailers, brands, wholesalers, and other businesses unlock value from inventory and connect their products with online customers.



We are growing our team and looking for a Sales & Marketing Specialist who can help us identify new business opportunities, start meaningful conversations with potential partners, and turn those opportunities into long-term relationships.



ABOUT THE ROLE



This is a hands-on sales and marketing role focused on identifying opportunities, developing relationships, and generating new business for Stock2Cash.



We will provide you with the business, objectives, information, and available resources. You will be expected to apply your existing sales and marketing knowledge to determine how best to approach the market and achieve the desired outcome.



The role involves understanding potential customers, identifying opportunities, initiating conversations, developing relationships, and moving qualified prospects through the sales process.



You should be comfortable working with business owners, decision-makers, and potential partners and communicating professionally across different types of conversations and situations.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



Your responsibilities will include:



- Identify and research potential business opportunities.

- Build and develop a qualified prospect pipeline.

- Identify the right people within target businesses and initiate conversations.

- Conduct outbound prospecting through appropriate channels, including phone,
, LinkedIn, and other relevant methods.

- Speak directly with business owners, decision-makers, and potential partners.

- Understand prospects' businesses, needs, challenges, and opportunities.

- Present Stock2Cash professionally and communicate its value clearly.

- Qualify opportunities and determine which prospects are worth pursuing.

- Follow up consistently and professionally throughout the sales process.

- Use available sales and marketing tools effectively.

- Research new markets, industries, and potential customer segments.

- Support marketing initiatives that contribute to lead generation and business development.

- Monitor results and identify opportunities to improve the sales approach.

- Take ownership of your pipeline and work toward measurable commercial outcomes.



MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of relevant experience in sales, business development, account management, marketing, or another customer-facing commercial role.

- Demonstrated understanding of fundamental sales and business development processes.

- Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

- Comfortable communicating with business owners, executives, and other decision-makers.

- Comfortable with outbound prospecting and initiating conversations.

- Able to work independently without requiring constant supervision.

- Comfortable learning and using CRM, prospecting, communication, and marketing tools.

- Strong organizational and follow-up skills.



EXPERIENCE THAT WOULD BE AN ADVANTAGE



The following are advantageous but not mandatory:



- B2B sales or business development experience.

- Experience with cold calling and outbound sales.

- Experience selling to business owners or senior decision-makers.

- eCommerce, retail, wholesale, inventory, or marketplace experience.

- Experience working with Australian businesses or customers.

- Experience independently developing or improving a sales process.

- Experience using CRM and sales prospecting platforms.

APPLY

- A snapshot of your qualification and relevant experience



Answer the following questions:

title: Long-Term YouTube Video Editor – History / Documentary Channel | 15–20 Min Videos
description:
I’m looking for a reliable and skilled video editor to join my faceless YouTube history/documentary channel for a long-term collaboration.



The channel focuses on fascinating historical stories about royal families, fallen empires, lost fortunes, dynasties, wealth, power, and what happened to powerful families after their empires disappeared.



Videos are generally 15–20 minutes long.



I am looking for someone who can take a script and turn it into an engaging, professional historical documentary.



This is NOT a basic stock-footage editing job.



The visuals need to closely match the narration and make the viewer feel immersed in the story.



Editing Style



The main visual foundation should be authentic historical and archival material, including:



* Historical photographs

* Archival footage

* Paintings and illustrations

* Historical maps

* Newspapers

* Documents and letters

* Palaces, estates and historical locations

* Portraits of the people being discussed

* Other relevant historical material



AI-generated visuals can be used only when necessary and as a supplement, not as the main visual source.



The overall style should feel like a cinematic historical documentary with strong storytelling and viewer retention.



I want clean, professional editing — not excessive effects.



Your Responsibilities



For each video, you should be able to handle the complete editing process, including:



* Finding and sourcing relevant historical/archival visuals

* Closely matching visuals to the script and narration

* Editing the complete 15–20 minute video

* Creating good pacing and visual variety

* Adding subtle zooms, pans and movement where appropriate

* Adding clean, professional static subtitles

* Adding background music and appropriate SFX

* Properly balancing voice-over, music and SFX

* Using professional transitions without over-editing

* Using copyright-safe/licensed visual and audio assets

* Providing source/license information when requested

* AI voice-over when required

* Delivering the final video in 1080p

* Completing 1–2 reasonable revision rounds



Experience with ElevenLabs or similar AI voice-over tools is a plus.



What I DON’T Want



Please do not apply if your editing mainly consists of:



* Random stock footage

* Unrelated visuals that don’t match the narration

* AI-generated images throughout the entire video

* Repetitive visuals

* Watermarked or low-quality footage

* Excessive transitions or effects

* Meme-style editing

* Karaoke/word-by-word animated subtitles



The viewer should feel like they are watching a real historical documentary, not a collection of random stock clips.



Budget



My current starting budget is:



$15–$20 USD fixed price per completed 15–20 minute video.



This should include the complete editing package described above.



I am looking for a long-term collaboration with regular work.



If the channel grows and the collaboration works well, there may be opportunities for more videos and increased rates over time.



What I’m Looking For



You should:



* Have experience editing YouTube videos

* Preferably have experience with history, documentary or faceless channels

* Have strong visual storytelling skills

* Understand YouTube viewer retention

* Be good at researching and sourcing historical material

* Have good English comprehension

* Be able to accurately follow a script

* Deliver consistent quality

* Meet agreed deadlines

* Communicate clearly and reliably

* Inform me early if there are delays or problems

* Be interested in working together long-term



Selection Process



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a short 60–90 second test edit based on a provided script, voice-over and reference style.



The purpose of the test is to evaluate:



* Visual sourcing

* Visual-to-narration matching

* Pacing

* Historical accuracy/relevance of visuals

* Subtitles

* Music and sound design

* Overall editing quality



Successful editors can move on to full-length projects and potentially regular ongoing work.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. Links to 2–3 of your best documentary, history or faceless YouTube edits.

3. Explain which parts of those videos you personally edited.

4. What editing software do you use?

5. How long do you normally need to complete one 15–20 minute video?

6. Can you handle the complete workflow described above?

7. Can you source copyright-safe historical/archival material?

8. Are you comfortable with the $15–$20 fixed starting budget per completed video?

9. Are you willing to complete a short 60–90 second test edit before being selected?

10. How many 15–20 minute videos could you realistically complete per week?



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the words “ZMB” so I know you have read the entire job post.



I’m looking for someone who is reliable, communicates well, cares about quality, and wants to grow with the channel long-term.

title: Amazon Paid Media & Growth Strategist
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking an experienced Amazon Paid Media & Growth Manager to lead paid media strategy, customer acquisition, and performance growth across a large portfolio of brands on Amazon.



This is not a traditional PPC campaign management role. Our campaigns are supported by an external advertising partner responsible for day-to-day campaign execution and optimization. This role will sit above campaign execution, using advertising, organic, competitive, and profitability data to determine where we should invest, where we should scale, where we should pull back, and where the greatest opportunities exist to acquire new customers and grow market share.



The ideal candidate combines deep Amazon advertising expertise with a broader growth marketing and customer acquisition mindset. This person should be able to turn complex performance data into actionable growth strategies and work cross-functionally with our analytics, brand, organic, content, and external advertising teams.



Key Responsibilities



Growth & Customer Acquisition Strategy



· Own the strategic direction of Amazon paid media with a primary focus on profitable customer acquisition, incremental growth, and market-share expansion.



· Identify opportunities to acquire new customers through non-branded, category, competitor, and discovery-focused advertising strategies.



· Evaluate where advertising is generating incremental business versus where spend may be subsidizing sales that would have occurred organically.



· Develop strategies for conquesting competitors, entering new keyword markets, defending market share, and accelerating priority products.



· Build paid media strategies for new product launches, hero products, seasonal opportunities, and high-velocity events including Prime events and Black Friday/Cyber Monday.



· Evaluate the customer journey and determine how paid media can support awareness, consideration, conversion, and repeat purchase.



Amazon Advertising Strategy



· Analyze performance across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, Sponsored Display, and other relevant Amazon advertising opportunities.



· Evaluate performance using TACOS, ACOS, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPC, organic rank, impression share, profitability, and customer acquisition metrics rather than optimizing toward a single advertising KPI.



· Identify opportunities to increase investment, reduce inefficient spend, test new strategies, and improve overall advertising efficiency.



· Analyze branded versus non-branded performance and determine the appropriate investment strategy for each.



· Evaluate keyword-level and ASIN-level performance to identify areas of opportunity and diminishing returns.



· Partner on DSP strategy and evaluate opportunities for upper-funnel and retargeting investment.



Organic + Paid Growth



· Work closely with the Marketplace/Brand and Analytics teams to understand how advertising impacts organic visibility and total business performance.



· Evaluate relationships between paid search activity, organic ranking, conversion, traffic, and total sales.



· Identify products where the primary issue is discoverability versus conversion and recommend the appropriate growth strategy.



· Use search-volume, keyword-ranking, competitive, and category data to identify whitespace opportunities.



· Ensure advertising strategy supports broader brand and marketplace objectives rather than operating independently from organic strategy.



Agency Partnership & Strategic Oversight



· Serve as the primary strategic counterpart to our external Amazon advertising partner.



· Review agency recommendations and performance and determine whether strategies align with company growth and profitability objectives.



· Challenge recommendations when appropriate and bring additional opportunities to the agency based on internal analytics and business priorities.



· Translate internal findings into clear advertising initiatives for agency execution.



· Establish testing strategies, success criteria, and measurement plans before significant investments are made.



· Hold external partners accountable for performance, execution, and agreed-upon strategic initiatives.









Analytics & Performance Insights



· Analyze advertising performance alongside total sales, profitability, organic performance, inventory, pricing, promotions, and competitive activity.



· Identify the “why” behind performance changes, not simply report what happened.



· Develop actionable recommendations from large datasets and communicate findings clearly to leadership.



· Conduct competitive advertising and keyword analyses to identify areas where competitors are gaining or losing share.



· Partner closely with internal analytics resources to identify trends and build growth opportunities.



· Create regular performance reporting that focuses on business outcomes, opportunities, risks, and recommended actions rather than campaign-level activity alone.



Cross-Functional Leadership



· Partner with Marketplace, Analytics, Content/SEO, Affiliate, Operations, and Brand teams to create integrated growth strategies.



· Provide paid-media insights that can influence PDP optimization, SEO strategy, promotions, pricing, inventory planning, and product launches.



· Collaborate with organic marketplace teams to ensure paid and organic strategies reinforce one another.



· Communicate priorities and recommendations clearly to internal stakeholders and executive leadership.



Qualifications



· 4–6+ years of Amazon advertising or Amazon growth marketing experience, preferably managing significant advertising budgets or multiple brands/categories.



· Deep understanding of Amazon Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and the Amazon advertising ecosystem.



· Demonstrated experience developing advertising strategy, not solely executing or optimizing campaigns.



· Strong understanding of customer acquisition, incremental growth, market share, competitive conquesting, and full-funnel marketing.



· Advanced understanding of TACOS, ACOS, ROAS, CPC, CTR, CVR, organic ranking, impression share, and profitability.



· Ability to analyze advertising performance in the context of total Amazon business performance.



· Experience working with or overseeing an Amazon advertising agency or external campaign-management partner strongly preferred.



· Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel/Google Sheets capabilities.



· Experience with Amazon analytics and research platforms such as Seller Central, Vendor Central, Helium 10, Data Dive, SmartScout, Keepa, or similar tools.



· Strong communication skills with the ability to turn complex data into concise recommendations for both internal teams and senior leadership.



· Experience managing a multi-brand or large-ASIN portfolio strongly preferred.

title: Freelance Social Video Editor
description:
Remote | Freelance | Paid per Reel | Ongoing work



Parenthood is an established Australian parenting podcast looking for a talented Freelance Social Video Editor to create engaging, dynamic Instagram Reels that promote our podcast episodes.



This is NOT simply an editing role.



We need someone with an excellent instinct for storytelling and hooks who can independently watch/listen to a long-form podcast episode and identify the moments that will make someone stop scrolling and think: “I need to hear the rest of this conversation.”



You’ll be responsible for taking an episode from long-form conversation to a polished, compelling social trailer.



What you'll do



For each episode, you will:



* Watch/listen to the podcast episode and independently identify the most compelling, funny, emotional, controversial or intriguing moments.

* Select a strong opening hook that immediately captures attention.

* Turn those moments into a dynamic 45–90 second Instagram Reel/episode trailer.

* Edit podcast studio footage alongside relevant photos and video sourced from the guest’s public social media channels.

* Creatively integrate B-roll and supporting visuals so the Reel feels dynamic rather than simply like clips from a podcast.

* Add engaging captions, text overlays, transitions and other creative elements where appropriate.

* Understand the context of the conversation and ensure clips accurately represent what the guest is saying.

* Edit content specifically for Instagram/social media retention and engagement.

* Incorporate feedback and reasonable revisions.

* Deliver final assets within agreed deadlines – this is very important



The most important part of this role



We can find people who know how to edit video.



What we're really looking for is someone who knows what to edit.



You need to be able to recognise the moments within a longer conversation that will resonate with our audience and make people want to watch or listen to the full episode.



You won't simply be given timestamps and asked to assemble them. We want someone who can bring their own editorial judgement, creativity and ideas to each episode.



Who we're looking for



Someone who:



* Has excellent storytelling instincts.

* Understands hooks, pacing and social media retention.

* Has strong English comprehension and can pick up on humour, emotion and nuance within conversations.

* Understands Instagram Reels and current short-form editing styles.

* Has experience turning long-form video, podcasts or interviews into short-form social content.

* Is creative and can make talking-head/podcast footage visually interesting.

* Has strong attention to detail, particularly around captions, names and audio.

* Is highly organised, reliable and consistently meets deadlines.

* Can work independently without needing highly prescriptive briefs.

* Communicates clearly and flags any issues early.

* Is open to feedback and able to make revisions efficiently.



Experience editing podcast, parenting, lifestyle, entertainment or interview content would be highly regarded.



Location



This role is **fully remote**, and we're open to working with talented editors anywhere in the world.



You will need reliable internet access and the ability to work within agreed deadlines aligned with our Australian production schedule.



Freelance arrangement



This is an ongoing freelance position and will be paid per completed Reel.



The volume of work will vary depending on our podcast production schedule, with the opportunity for regular ongoing work for the right person.



How to apply



Please send:



* A short introduction about yourself and your editing experience.

* Three examples of short-form social content you've edited, ideally where you personally selected the clips from longer-form content.

* Your rate per completed Reel.

* Your typical turnaround time.

* The editing software you use.

* Your location/time zone.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid trial.



For the trial, you'll receive the same podcast footage as other shortlisted applicants and be asked to independently identify the strongest content and turn it into an engaging episode trailer.



We're particularly interested in **why you chose the moments you selected** — not just how technically polished the final edit looks.

title: Google Ads Virtual Assistant
description:
We need a specialist to correctly set up conversion tracking on our website so our Google Ads campaigns can optimize properly. This is NOT a general admin VA role — we're specifically looking for someone with hands-on experience configuring Google Tag Manager (GTM), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Ads conversion actions. If tracking is set up wrong, our ad spend gets wasted on bad signals, so accuracy matters more than speed.



This could be a one-time project to start, with the possibility of ongoing hours for campaign optimization support if it goes well.



What You'll Be Doing

Auditing our current website and Google Ads account to identify what conversion tracking is missing or broken

Installing/configuring Google Tag Manager (or fixing an existing GTM container)

Setting up GA4 events and linking them as conversions

Creating and verifying Google Ads conversion actions (form submissions, purchases, calls, sign-ups — will confirm exact goals with you)

Setting up Enhanced Conversions for better match rates

Testing everything end-to-end (GTM Preview mode, GA4 DebugView, Google Ads "Diagnose" tab) before calling it done

Documenting what was set up so we understand our own tracking going forward

Flagging any tracking gaps or website issues (e.g., missing thank-you pages, broken redirects) that would prevent accurate tracking

Requirements

Demonstrated hands-on experience with Google Tag Manager, GA4, and Google Ads conversion setup (not just familiarity — actual project experience)

Comfortable working directly in a live website's code/tag manager without breaking things

Clear communication in English, written and spoken

Able to explain technical steps in plain language (we're not tracking experts, that's why we're hiring you)

Portfolio or examples of past conversion tracking setups (screenshots, case studies, or references are fine)



Nice to have:



Experience with server-side tagging / Conversions API

Experience with our website platform (let us know your platform experience — WordPress, Shopify, Webflow, custom, etc.)

Google Ads Measurement certification

Rate



We're paying based on skill level for this specialized work, not general VA rates. Please include your hourly rate (or flat project rate, if you prefer to quote it that way) in your application.



How to Apply



To confirm you've read this whole post, please start your application with the word "TRACKING" in the subject line.



In your application, please include:



A short summary of a conversion tracking project you've done (what platform, what you set up, and the outcome if known)

Your hourly rate or a flat rate quote for an initial setup/audit

Your availability (hours/week and time zone overlap)

Any questions you have about our setup before we hop on a call

Screening Questions to Ask Applicants (for your reference when posting)

"Walk me through how you'd verify that a GA4 conversion is actually being counted correctly in Google Ads — what tools/steps would you use?"

"Have you set up Enhanced Conversions before? What's the benefit over standard conversion tracking?"

"If a client's Google Ads account shows conversions but you suspect they're duplicated or inflated, how would you investigate?"

"What's the difference between a GA4 event and a GA4 conversion, and why does that distinction matter for Google Ads?"

Adding text, captions, graphics, zooms, cuts, memes, etc. when they improve a joke or moment

Basic audio cleanup/mixing

Color correcting and color grading footage

Working with high-resolution/high-bitrate camera footage

Creating multiple vertical YouTube Shorts/Reels/TikToks from each long-form video

Identifying the funniest/most interesting moments yourself for Shorts

Adding engaging captions/text to vertical content

Exporting finished videos at high quality

Requirements

Meet agreed deadlines



Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or similar professional editing software is preferred.



Editing style



Think:



Travel vlog + personality + comedy + storytelling



I don't want every second covered in giant subtitles, explosions and meme sound effects. ????



The personality and story should be the focus. Editing should enhance funny moments rather than overwhelm them.



Some sections may be cinematic and beautiful; others should be quick, chaotic and comedic. You should be comfortable switching between both styles.



IMPORTANT — How to apply



Please send:



2–3 examples of YouTube videos YOU personally edited. Please do not send a general portfolio with work you didn't edit.

Examples of vertical Shorts/Reels you've edited.

What editing software you use.

Your computer specifications (processor, RAM, GPU and storage).

Your internet download/upload speed if you know it.

How long you typically need to edit a 10–20 minute vlog from raw footage.

Your expected hourly rate OR price per finished YouTube video.

Your availability each week.



And answer this question:



What's your favorite YouTube channel from an EDITING perspective, and why?



Please start your application with the word PENGUIN so I know you actually read the entire job description. ????



I'm looking for someone I can work with long-term, so if we're a good fit, there will be consistent work.

title: Client Success & Operations Specialist — College Admissions (AI Tools + CRM)
description:
About us



INSPIRATE Consulting is a US-based college admissions consulting company. We help high school students get into their dream schools in the United States — through school list strategy, essay coaching, and full application support. We've been doing this for three and a half years and currently have a full roster of students and families who depend on us. Our advising philosophy is fit-first, not prestige-chasing: we tell families the truth about where a student stands and build a realistic plan from there.



We're a small team, so what you do will be visible and will matter.



The role



You are the person who makes sure our families always know exactly what's going on. Two buckets:



Bucket 1 — Client communication (about 70% of your time)

Answer questions from students and parents over
, using the tools and templates we provide, within 4 business hours

After every counselor meeting: pull the transcript, build a parent-facing recap presentation from our locked template, generate an AI voiceover video from it, and send it to the parent within 24 hours

Keep CRM records clean and current — contact info, meeting notes, pipeline stages, task follow-ups

Flag anything that needs a real admissions judgment call to the founder or a counselor instead of guessing



Bucket 2 — Social media data tracking (about 30% of your time)

Pull performance data from our social channels into a tracking workbook on a set weekly cadence

Keep it accurate and on time so we can make decisions from it

Surface patterns you notice — we'd rather hear your read on the numbers than just receive the numbers



Priority rule: client work always comes first. If a recap video is due and the social workbook isn't finished, the recap ships and the workbook waits. We will never be upset with you for making that call.



Schedule

Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Philippine Time, one hour paid lunch = 9 hours paid per day

This is a day shift in the Philippines. No graveyard, no night work.

It happens to overlap with US evening hours, which is when most family questions arrive and when the founder is available to you directly

Philippine regular holidays off

Pay and terms



Trial period: 2 weeks / 80 hours at $8.00 USD per hour. This is paid real work, not an unpaid audition. You'll receive the exact pass criteria in writing on your first day, so there's no guessing about what you're being measured on.



On passing the trial: $10.00 USD per hour, effective immediately. 30 hours/week.



Paid every other Tuesday via Payoneer

13th-month pay, paid in December (prorated in your first year)

Independent contractor. No paid leave — unpaid leave available with two weeks' notice

Philippine regular holidays off

Formal review at 12 months with room to move up again

Hours tracked through TimeProof during the trial and your first few months. Once we've built trust, we drop the tracking and manage by deliverables instead.



Required

2+ years in customer support, customer success, or a client-facing VA role

Excellent written English. You will be writing directly to anxious parents who are paying us a lot of money. Warm, clear, professional, no fluff.

Comfortable and current with AI tools. Not "I've used ChatGPT" — you should be able to tell us about a workflow you actually built or improved with AI and what came out of it.

Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail)

Genuinely organized. You track many moving pieces across many students without dropping any.

Independent. When you hit something you don't know, your instinct is to figure it out and then tell us what you found — not to wait.

Reliable internet (25 Mbps+), your own computer, a decent headset, a quiet place to work, and a backup plan for power and internet outages

Available for the full shift above



Nice to have

GoHighLevel experience — this is a strong plus and will move you up our list significantly

Experience with AI voiceover or video tools 

Presentation building

Any exposure to US college admissions, education, or working with American clients

Social media analytics

Confidentiality



This role involves sensitive information about minors: academic records, test scores, family financial context, and personal essays about difficult experiences. Discretion is not negotiable. A signed confidentiality agreement is part of onboarding, and access to student materials is scoped to what the role requires.



If that sounds like a lot of responsibility, it is. It's also why this role is paid above the typical support rate.



Growth



We're small and getting bigger, and we'd rather promote than hire. As you prove yourself, this role can expand into owning client success outright, training the next hire, or taking on more of our operations.



Who this is not for

Anyone looking for part-time or side work, or who is juggling multiple clients

Anyone who needs every task spelled out before they can start

Anyone uncomfortable writing directly to demanding, worried parents



How to apply



Read this part carefully. Applications that skip a step are not reviewed.



Put the words techno-caliber in your subject line. This is how we know you read the post.

Answer these two questions in your application — short and specific beats long and general:

Tell us about a time you had to figure something out at work with no one available to ask. What did you do?

Which AI tools do you actually use, and what have you used them for? Give one concrete example.

Take a free Big Five personality test (search "free Big Five personality test") and paste your five scores into your application. There are no wrong answers and we do not screen anyone out on this — we use it to have a better conversation with you.

Tell us your internet speed and what your backup plan is when the power goes out.



Shortlisted candidates do a 20-minute video call, then a short paid test task using real (anonymized) work — you'll draft a reply to an actual student question. You are expected to use AI for it. We want to see how you use it, how you verify what it tells you, and whether you can make the result sound like a real person wrote it. Nothing about the task is a trap; we just need to see the skill before we hire.



We reply to everyone who follows the instructions above.

title: Short-Form Video Editor + Creative Assistant
description:
I'm the founder of ICHOR Performance, a new premium performance brand being built around training, athletics, adventure, and high-performance lifestyle.



We're preparing for launch, and I'm looking for one creative person to grow with the brand long-term.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Turn raw talking-head footage into compelling 20 to 60 second stories.



Identify strong hooks and moments without needing exact instructions.



Color correct and grade footage.



Clean and improve audio.



Add captions, music, sound design, B-roll, and tasteful graphics.



Create premium fitness and lifestyle edits.



Help brainstorm content ideas and hooks.



Study successful fitness, lifestyle, founder, and performance brands.



Help develop a recognizable visual style for ICHOR.



Organize completed content and raw footage.



THE STYLE



I'm not looking for overly edited videos filled with emojis, crazy transitions, constant zooms, or giant captions.



The ICHOR aesthetic should feel premium, athletic, cinematic, modern, dark, energetic, and aspirational.



The content should make a young startup feel like a much larger brand.



WHO I'M LOOKING FOR



You genuinely understand TikTok and Reels pacing.



You have excellent visual taste.



You understand fitness and lifestyle content.



You can take messy raw footage and find the story inside it.



You don't need every cut explained to you.



You're willing to suggest better ideas when you see them.



You're reliable and communicate well.



You want a long-term role rather than random freelance projects.



Experience with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or CapCut Desktop is fine.



Your portfolio matters much more to me than your resume.



COMPENSATION



$400 USD per month to start.



Approximately 12 to 15 flexible hours per week.



This is intended to become a long-term position. As ICHOR grows and you prove yourself, there will be opportunities for increased compensation, responsibility, and potentially a larger creative role within the brand.

Please send links to the three short-form videos you're most proud of editing.

Tell me what editing software you primarily use.



Finally, based on the description of ICHOR above, give me one short-form content idea you think the brand should make.



Please do not send a long generic cover letter.



I'm primarily evaluating taste, creativity, storytelling, and whether you actually read this posting.

What We’re Looking For

* Strong Instagram and
 experience

* Good written English and copywriting ability

* Strong organisation and communication

* An understanding of UGC and creator/influencer content

description:
We are seeking a reliable, confident Real Estate ISA to contact U.S. property owners, identify motivated sellers, follow up with leads, and schedule qualified seller appointments.



This is NOT a general virtual assistant position. We are specifically looking for someone with strong communication skills who is comfortable speaking with U.S. homeowners and handling real estate seller conversations.



## Responsibilities



* Make outbound calls to property owners from provided lead lists

* Contact motivated seller leads generated through PropStream

* Ask qualifying questions to determine seller motivation, timeline, property condition, and price expectations

* Identify property decision-makers

* Follow up consistently with potential sellers

* Schedule qualified seller appointments

* Maintain detailed notes and lead statuses in our CRM

* Complete all assigned follow-up tasks

* Provide a simple daily performance report



## Required Experience & Skills



* Excellent spoken and written English

* Confident, friendly, conversational phone presence

* Previous cold-calling or appointment-setting experience

* U.S. real estate/motivated seller experience strongly preferred

* Strong objection-handling skills

* CRM experience

* PropStream experience is a plus

* Reliable high-speed internet, professional headset, and quiet workspace

* Ability to work independently and consistently



## Required Schedule — U.S. Eastern Time



Monday–Friday:



* 10:00 AM–12:00 PM ET — Outbound calls and follow-up

* 4:00 PM–6:00 PM ET — Outbound calls and follow-up



Approximately 4 hours per day / 20 hours per week.



You must be available to consistently work these U.S. Eastern Time hours regardless of your local time zone.



## Compensation



Base Pay: $5 USD/hour

Performance bonuses are available in addition to hourly compensation:



* $10 for each qualified seller appointment that is actually held

* $50 when an ISA-generated lead results in a successful closing

* Opportunity for increased hourly pay and additional hours based on consistent performance



A qualified appointment must meet our seller qualification standards. Simply placing an appointment on the calendar does not automatically qualify for the appointment bonus.



The first 30 days will be a paid trial period with a maximum of approximately 20 hours per week.



## How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following:



1. How much U.S. real estate cold-calling experience do you have?

2. Have you called motivated homeowners or property sellers before?

3. Have you worked for a real estate agent, investor, wholesaler, or acquisitions company?

4. Which CRMs and dialing systems have you used?

5. Have you used PropStream?

6. Approximately how many meaningful seller conversations did you have per day in your previous position?

7. Approximately how many qualified appointments did you schedule per week?

8. Can you consistently work the required Eastern Time schedule?

9. What is your requested hourly rate?



Please also submit a 60–90 second audio or video recording introducing yourself and responding to this homeowner objection:



“I’m not really interested in selling. I was just curious what you would offer.”



Generic applications that do not answer the questions above will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position and can grow with our real estate operation. Strong performance will be rewarded.

title: Autodesk Inventor / CAD Specialist for Parametric Weld Geometries and Welding Sequences — 300 to 400 Technical Images
description:
PROJECT TITLE



Autodesk Inventor / CAD Specialist for Parametric Weld Geometries and Welding Sequences — 300 to 400 Technical Images



PROJECT OVERVIEW



We are creating a consistent library of technical welding illustrations for a digital welding application.



An Excel combination matrix will be provided. It defines the product form, weld type, welding position, weld details and joint preparation for every required image.



The current matrix contains 150 valid combinations. At least two separate images are required for each combination:



1. Weld joint geometry

2. Welding sequence with realistically arranged and numbered weld beads



The basic scope is therefore 300 images. Additional step-by-step welding-sequence images may increase the final scope to approximately 300–400 images.



REQUIRED SPECIALIST



We are looking for an experienced CAD designer or mechanical design engineer with:



- Advanced Autodesk Inventor skills

- Experience with parametric 3D models

- Experience creating technical drawings and cross-sections

- Knowledge of welding joint preparations and multi-pass welding

- Experience with iLogic, macros or automated variant generation

- Ability to work systematically from an Excel combination matrix

- Experience with technical rendering

- Good written English

- Willingness to provide all editable CAD source files



A general graphic designer without CAD and welding knowledge is not suitable for this project.



COMBINATION MATRIX



Each row of the supplied Excel matrix must be treated as a separate production item.



The matrix contains the following fields:



- ID

- Product form

- Weld type

- Welding position

- Weld details

- Joint preparation

- Geometry filename

- Geometry status

- Welding-sequence filename

- Welding-sequence status

- Notes and validation



Product forms:



- PP = Plate to plate

- TP = Tube to plate

- TT = Tube to tube



Weld types:



- BW = Butt weld

- FW = Fillet weld



Weld details:



- ss = Single-pass or single-sided version, as defined in the matrix

- ml = Multi-pass or multi-layer version, as defined in the matrix



The welding position must not appear only in the filename. The spatial orientation of the workpiece and weld must correspond to the specified welding position.



WELDING POSITIONS



Depending on the matrix, the library may include:



- PA

- PB

- PC

- PD

- PE

- PF

- PG

- H-L045

- J-L045

- PH

- PJ



The workpiece orientation, weld direction and bead arrangement must be technically consistent with the specified position.



JOINT PREPARATIONS



The library shall cover the following joint preparations where technically compatible with the selected product form and weld type:



- Square butt joint / I-groove

- Single-V groove

- Double-V groove / X-groove

- Single-Y groove

- Double-Y groove

- Single-bevel groove / HV groove

- Single-bevel groove with root face / HY groove

- Single-HU groove

- Double-bevel groove / K-groove

- Double-HY groove

- Double-HU groove

- Double-V bevel / DV or K joint

- U-groove

- Double-U groove

- J-groove

- Double-J groove

- Flanged-edge weld

- Fillet weld

- Single-sided fillet weld

- Double-sided fillet weld

- Plug weld

- Slot weld

- Spot weld

- Seam weld / roller seam weld



Not every joint preparation may be combined automatically with every product form, weld type and welding position.



The contractor must identify and report technically invalid or unclear combinations before producing the corresponding images.



GEOMETRY IMAGE REQUIREMENTS



Each geometry image must contain two technically identical representations:



- Top: perspective 3D representation of the components

- Bottom: technical cross-section of the same component geometry



The upper 3D geometry must be generated from the same parametric cross-section shown below it.



If the lower cross-section is extruded, it must produce exactly the geometry shown in the upper 3D view.



The following are not acceptable:



- Different bevels in the 3D view and cross-section

- Missing root faces

- Different radii

- Mirrored or exchanged components

- Incorrect groove depth

- Incorrect root opening

- Approximate geometry created only for visual appearance

- A 3D representation that cannot be derived from the shown cross-section



GEOMETRY IMAGE STYLE



All geometry images must use the same visual style:



- White or very light grey background

- Neutral grey metallic component surfaces

- Consistent material appearance

- Consistent lighting

- Identical camera perspective

- Identical layout and scale

- No title or text heading at the top of the image

- No numerical dimensions

- Parametric dimension symbols only

- Clean black dimension lines, extension lines and arrows

- Subtle technical cross-section hatching

- No logos

- No watermarks

- No decorative elements



Possible parametric symbols include:



- t = Workpiece thickness

- b = Root opening

- c = Root-face height

- ? = Groove or bevel angle

- r = Radius

- a = Fillet-weld throat thickness

- d = Diameter

- l = Length

- e = Weld width

- p = Pitch



Only parameters that are relevant to the displayed geometry shall be shown.



WELDING-SEQUENCE IMAGE REQUIREMENTS



The welding-sequence image must use exactly the same workpiece and joint geometry as the corresponding geometry image.



Each welding-sequence image must show:



- Realistic individual weld beads

- Clearly visible boundaries between beads

- Complete and technically plausible groove filling

- Consecutive bead numbers

- Thin leader lines connecting each number to the correct bead

- A physically reasonable welding sequence

- Root pass, hot pass, filling passes and capping passes where applicable

- Correct adaptation to the groove geometry

- Correct adaptation to the welding position

- A realistic weld surface and weld-bead appearance



The weld metal must not be shown as one large, undefined coloured area. Individual weld beads must be modelled or clearly separated.



CRITICAL RULE FOR WELD-BEAD ARRANGEMENT



For V-, U-, J- and K-grooves, the weld beads must not simply be stacked vertically on top of one another in the centre of the groove.



The bead arrangement must follow the widening shape of the joint:



- Bead 1 forms the root pass.

- The next bead or beads fill the lower groove area.

- As the groove becomes wider, multiple beads must be arranged side by side.

- The filling layers must expand towards both groove faces.

- In a V-groove, the complete bead arrangement must form a widening V-shaped or triangular filling pattern.

- The capping layer may consist of several side-by-side beads.

- U-, J-, X-, double-U- and K-grooves must be filled according to their actual contours.

- Beads must not overlap in a physically impossible way.

- Unrealistic voids must not remain between the beads.

- Every bead must have proper contact with the previous layer, the root or a groove face.

- Bead placement must correspond to a plausible welding order.



For multi-pass welds, the growing weld cross-section should generally become wider from the root towards the cap.



NUMBERING AND LEADER LINES



Every visible weld bead must have:



- One unique consecutive number

- One thin leader line

- A leader line ending clearly inside or directly at the associated bead

- Sufficient spacing so numbers cannot be confused

- No duplicated or missing pass numbers



The number does not indicate an entire layer unless that layer was deposited as one pass. One deposited weld pass must receive one number.



WELDING-SEQUENCE VERSIONS



The final welding-sequence image must show all required weld beads and the complete numbering.



If additional progressive images are ordered, they shall show the cumulative welding process:



- PASS-01: Bead 1 only

- PASS-02: Beads 1–2

- PASS-03: Beads 1–3

- Continue until the joint is completely filled



Each PASS image therefore represents the completed condition after the specified bead.



These progressive images may later be used to create a step-by-step welding animation.



FILENAME CONVENTION



All filenames must follow this exact structure:



[WeldType]__[ProductForm]_[Position]_[Execution]_[JointPreparation]_[ImageType].png



There must be two underscores between the weld type and product form.



Examples:



BW__PP_PA_ml_V-Groove_GEOMETRY.png



BW__PP_PA_ml_V-Groove_WELD-SEQUENCE.png



FW__TP_PB_ss_Single-Sided-Fillet-Weld_GEOMETRY.png



FW__TP_PB_ss_Single-Sided-Fillet-Weld_WELD-SEQUENCE.png



For progressive welding-sequence images:



BW__PP_PA_ml_V-Groove_WELD-SEQUENCE_PASS-01.png



BW__PP_PA_ml_V-Groove_WELD-SEQUENCE_PASS-02.png



Filename rules:



- Always retain the BW__PP prefix or the corresponding matrix combination

- Use exactly two underscores between weld type and product form

- Do not use spaces

- Replace slashes with hyphens

- Do not use umlauts or special language-specific characters

- Do not add automatic version numbers

- Maintain consistent capitalisation

- Every filename must be unique

- Every file must be clearly linked to one matrix row

- The approved naming dictionary must be used consistently across the whole project



IMAGE SIZE AND FILE FORMATS



For every image, provide:



- Master image: 1536 × 1024 pixels

- Production image: 512 × 341 pixels

- PNG format

- sRGB colour profile

- White background

- High edge sharpness

- No visible compression artefacts



The smaller image is approximately one-third of the master image dimensions.



SOURCE FILES



The final delivery must also include:



- Autodesk Inventor source files

- All IPT component files

- All IAM assembly files

- All IDW or DWG drawing files

- Parametric sketches

- Drawing templates

- Material settings

- Lighting and rendering settings

- iLogic rules

- Macros or automation scripts

- Export presets

- Used fonts

- Updated Excel combination matrix

- A clear folder structure

- A short workflow description



If external software is used for rendering, all associated editable source files and settings must also be delivered.



CONSISTENCY REQUIREMENTS



All images must appear as parts of one visual system.



The following must remain consistent:



- Camera angle

- Perspective

- Component scale

- Material appearance

- Lighting direction

- Shadow intensity

- Background colour

- Cross-section hatching

- Line thickness

- Arrow style

- Font

- Parameter size

- Image margins

- Position of the 3D view

- Position of the cross-section

- Weld-metal appearance

- Number and leader-line style



A master template must be approved before series production begins.



QUALITY CONTROL



For every matrix row, the contractor must verify:



1. Correct product form

2. Correct weld type

3. Correct welding position

4. Correct joint preparation

5. Correct ss or ml execution

6. Exact match between 3D model and cross-section

7. Correct parametric symbols without numerical values

8. Technically plausible weld-bead arrangement

9. Complete bead numbering

10. Correct leader-line assignment

11. Exact filename

12. Correct image dimensions

13. No title, logo or watermark

14. Updated production status in the Excel matrix

15. No duplicated image or filename

16. All required source files are included



ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA



An image pair will only be accepted when:



- The 3D model and cross-section match exactly.

- The welding-sequence image uses the same base geometry.

- The joint preparation is technically correct.

- All required weld beads are visible.

- The welding sequence is technically plausible.

- The beads fill the joint laterally and vertically.

- Multi-pass beads are arranged side by side where required.

- The bead arrangement follows the V-, U-, J-, X- or K-groove shape.

- All beads are numbered correctly.

- The filename follows the required convention.

- The image style matches the approved reference template.

- All editable source files have been provided.



PAID TEST PROJECT



Before awarding the full project, a paid test project shall be completed.



The test should include four complete image pairs:



1. PP / BW / PA / ml / V-groove

2. PP / BW / PA / ml / X-groove

3. PP / BW / PA / ml / double-HU groove

4. PP or TP / FW / PB / double-sided fillet weld



The test therefore includes at least eight final images:



- Four geometry images

- Four welding-sequence images



At least one test joint must also include progressive PASS images.



The full project will only begin after the test images and master template have been approved in writing.



PROJECT MILESTONES



Milestone 1 — Paid test:



- Four image pairs

- One progressive welding sequence

- Confirmation of technical capability

- Agreement on the final visual standard



Milestone 2 — Master system:



- Parametric CAD master models

- Master drawing template

- Rendering template

- Filename automation

- Excel workflow

- Approval before series production



Milestone 3 — First production batch:



- 25 complete matrix combinations

- 50 final images

- Quality review and corrections



Milestone 4 — Remaining production batches:



- Production in clearly defined batches

- Review and approval after each batch

- No production of the entire library before the first batch is approved



Milestone 5 — Final delivery:



- All approved PNG files

- All high-resolution and production-size images

- All CAD source files

- All automation files

- Completed Excel matrix

- Final corrections

- Organised delivery archive



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Please include the following information in your application:



- Examples of technical CAD illustrations

- Examples of welded assemblies or welding drawings

- Examples of parametric CAD models

- Software and software versions used

- Experience with Autodesk Inventor

- Experience with iLogic

- Experience with welding joint design

- Description of the proposed automated workflow

- Fixed price for the paid test

- Price per approved geometry and welding-sequence pair

- Price for additional PASS images

- Estimated production time for 300 images

- Estimated production time for up to 400 images

- Confirmation that all editable source files will be delivered

- Confirmation that full commercial usage rights will be transferred



INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND CONFIDENTIALITY



After full payment, all models, drawings, images, templates, scripts, automation rules and source files created for this project shall become the exclusive property of the client.



The contractor may not:



- Resell the files

- Upload them to stock-image libraries

- Reuse them as part of another commercial product

- Transfer them to third parties

- Publish them as portfolio work without written permission

IMPORTANT NOTE FOR APPLICANTS

We are a creative media company producing photography, videography, aerial media, and measurement services for real estate agents, builders, and brands across Calgary. We're looking for an experienced, senior-level video editor to join our team full-time and become the go-to editor for our real estate listing videos, agent branding content, and social media reels.

The Role



Must be able to match this style exactly! 







Any videos not similar to this style will be ignored.



You'll take raw footage from our shooters — property walkthroughs, drone/aerial clips, agent-to-camera pieces, and voiceovers — and turn it into polished, cinematic listing videos and social content that reflect our brand: clean, intentional, and human. You'll work from a shared Dropbox footage library and a Monday.com production board, collaborating closely with our photographers, videographers, and social team.



This is a senior role. We need someone who can take a folder of raw clips and a short brief and deliver a client-ready cut with minimal back-and-forth — not someone who needs a shot-by-shot storyboard.



Responsibilities

Edit full-length real estate listing videos (typically 60–120 seconds) from raw property footage, drone clips, and agent voiceovers/on-camera pieces

Cut down long-form footage into short-form content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

Color grade and color correct footage shot in S-Log3 to match CREP's house look

Sync and mix audio (lav mic voiceovers, ambient sound, licensed music) to a clean, broadcast-ready standard

Add light motion graphics, lower thirds, and text overlays consistent with brand guidelines

Manage multiple projects at once via Monday.com, hitting daily/weekly turnaround deadlines

Organize and archive raw footage and project files in Dropbox following our folder naming conventions

Flag footage or audio issues back to the shoot team so we can improve at the source

Occasionally edit content for builders, interior designers, and commercial clients as CREP's secondary lines of business grow

Requirements

5+ years of professional video editing experience, with real estate, property, or lifestyle/brand video in your portfolio

Strong reel/portfolio required — please do not apply without one

Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci Resolve

Comfortable color grading S-Log/flat-profile footage

Working knowledge of After Effects for basic motion graphics and titles

Strong sense of pacing, music selection, and storytelling for both long-form listing videos and short-form social cuts

Reliable high-speed internet, a capable editing workstation, and a stable power setup

Strong written English and responsiveness on Slack/Monday.com during agreed working hours

Able to work a schedule with meaningful overlap with Calgary business hours (Mountain Time) — please confirm your available hours when you apply

Self-directed: comfortable interpreting a short brief and raw footage without heavy hand-holding

title: Real Estate Wholesaling Cold Caller – Experienced Lead Generation Specialist
description:
Job Type: Part-Time / Full-Time

Pay: $5/hour + potential performance bonuses

Start: ASAP

Calling Volume: Approximately 1,500 dials/day using an auto-dialer



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced real estate wholesaling cold caller who understands how off-market real estate deals work and knows how to identify motivated property owners.



This is not a basic cold-calling position. We want someone who has real experience calling homeowners for real estate investors/wholesalers and understands what makes a lead worth passing to an acquisitions manager.



You will be calling a targeted homeowner list that we pull from BatchLeads using an auto-dialer. Your primary responsibility is to have quality conversations, identify motivated sellers, and pass qualified/interested leads directly to our Acquisitions Manager.



What You’ll Be Doing



* Make approximately 1,500 dials per day using our auto-dialer.

* Call homeowner/property-owner lists provided through BatchLeads.

* Speak with homeowners professionally and confidently.

* Identify sellers who may have a legitimate reason or motivation to sell.

* Ask the right questions to uncover motivation, timeline, property condition, price expectations, and other important details.

* Build rapport instead of simply reading a script.

* Recognize the difference between a curious homeowner and a genuinely interested seller.

* Qualify leads according to our criteria.

* Immediately pass qualified/interested leads to our Acquisitions Manager.

* Accurately record notes and important information about each conversation.

* Consistently follow up when necessary.



What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate has:



* Previous experience cold calling for real estate wholesalers/investors.

* A strong understanding of real estate wholesaling and motivated-seller leads.

* Excellent, fluent English with clear pronunciation.

* Strong communication and rapport-building skills.

* The ability to handle objections without becoming pushy.

* Experience using an auto-dialer/CRM.

* A strong work ethic and reliable attendance.

* The ability to follow a proven process while still having natural conversations.

* A proven track record of generating qualified seller leads, not just making a high number of calls.



Performance Expectations



Our initial target is for you to consistently generate approximately 2–4 qualified/interested seller leads that can be handed off to our Acquisitions Manager.



Quality matters more than simply hitting a dial count. We are looking for someone who can actually find people who are open to having a conversation about selling their property.



Compensation



$5/hour, with opportunities for additional performance-based bonuses as you prove your ability to consistently generate quality leads.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term position and the opportunity to grow with the company. Strong performers will have opportunities for increased compensation and responsibility.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. How many years of real estate cold-calling experience you have.

2. How long you’ve worked specifically with wholesalers or real estate investors.

3. Your experience with BatchLeads, auto-dialers, CRMs, or similar systems.

4. Your average daily call volume on previous campaigns.

5. How many qualified leads you typically generated per day/week.

6. A brief explanation of how you determine whether a homeowner is actually motivated to sell.

7. Any previous results, metrics, or references you’re able to provide.

8. Include a short voice recording introducing yourself and explaining your real estate cold-calling experience.



We are looking to hire immediately, so please only apply if you are available to start as soon as possible.



If you are confident speaking with U.S. homeowners, understand real estate wholesaling, and have a proven ability to generate motivated-seller leads, we want to hear from you.
