title: Construction Project Manager, Short-Term Rental Upgrades (Remote, US Hours)
description:
**Please read this whole post before applying. There are instructions at the bottom, and how

you follow them is the first thing we look at.**



## About us



We run full-service, hands-off management for short-term rental owners across the US. When an

owner wants to add something to their property, a hot tub, a sprinkler system, a new deck, a

full backyard, we scope it, price it, build it, and stand behind the result. We work with a

small bench of licensed contractors.



We automate everything software can do. What software cannot do is talk an owner through a

five-figure decision, push a contractor who is three days late, or tell the difference between

a job that is finished and a job that is almost finished.



## What this role really is



**You are the lead on these projects, start to finish.** Not an assistant to the lead. The lead.



An owner says they want something done. You take it from that sentence all the way to a signed

completion report, and you are the person both the owner and the contractor deal with the whole

way. We are handing this function to one person because right now it is spread across three and

things fall through the cracks.



This is a real project management job. If you are looking for task-based VA work where someone

tells you what to do each morning, this will not suit you. Nobody is going to tell you what to

do each morning. You are going to know.



## What you will own



**You grow into this in two phases.** Phase one is everything from "the contractor is booked"

to "the project is closed." Phase two adds the front half, scoping and pricing and owner

approval, once you have proven phase one. Both are described below so you know where this goes.



**Phase two: scoping and pricing**

- Build the scope of work: what actually needs to happen, in what order, and what it includes.

- Get the quote from our contractor and pressure-test it. Does it cover everything? What is

  missing that will turn into a change order later?

- Set the owner-facing price by applying our pricing rule. Anything that falls outside the rule

  comes to us.



**Phase two: getting to yes**

- Draft the scope of work document the owner signs.

- Send it, answer their questions, handle their objections, and get it signed. You are the

  person the owner talks to.

- Know the difference between a verbal yes and a signature, and never let work start on the

  first one.



**Phase one: running the build**

- Book the contractor and schedule the work between guest bookings, never during a stay.

- Confirm starts, get ETAs, follow up when a crew does not show. Politely, persistently, in

  writing.

- Keep every project's status current: what stage, what it is waiting on, what the next date is,

  which deadlines are closing in.

- Update the owner on a set cadence whether the news is good or not. Especially when it is not.

- Catch scope changes early and get them in writing with photos before anyone proceeds.



**Phase one: closing it out**

- Reconcile the finished work against the punch list, item by item, using photo evidence.

- **You make the call that a project is complete and you sign the completion report.** That

  authority is real and so is the responsibility.

- Write the completion report for the owner, log the project, and close the file.



## What you will NOT do



- **You never move money.** No invoicing, no collecting, no releasing payment to a contractor,

  no changing anyone's bank details. Ever. You recommend, we execute. This protects you as much

  as it protects the owner.

- You do not approve change orders or extra spend. You package the decision fast and hand it up.

- You do not set our pricing policy. You apply it.



## A word about confidentiality



You will see what our contractors charge us and what we charge the owner. That information does

not leave the company, ever, for any reason, including to an owner who asks you directly. If

that is not a line you can hold comfortably, please do not apply. It is written into the

agreement and we take it seriously.



## Must-haves



- **2+ years coordinating construction, renovation, property maintenance, or real estate

  projects.** You have worked alongside contractors on real jobs with real deadlines.

- You can read an estimate and tell what is missing from it.

- You write clearly enough that a US property owner would take you seriously.

- Genuinely organized. You keep your own system and you do not need reminding twice.

- Comfortable being firm on the phone with a contractor who is behind, without making it

  personal, and comfortable holding a price with an owner who is pushing back.

- Clear, warm, professional written English. You will write directly to US property owners

  about money.

- Honest. If you have not confirmed something, you say so. You never report a status you did

  not verify. This is the single most important item on this list.

- Able to work US Pacific business hours. **Please read the hours section carefully.**

- Stable power and internet, plus a backup for outages.



## Nice-to-haves



- You can look at a photo of finished work and tell whether it is actually finished.

- Short-term rental or property management background.

- Experience with e-signature tools, project boards, and shared drives.

- You have been the person an unhappy client called.



## Hours and timezone



- **Your availability window is 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM US Pacific, Monday through Friday.** That is

  when US contractors and US property owners answer the phone, so that is when this job happens.

- **Projects do not always fit neatly in a window.** Some mornings a crew calls early. Some

  evenings a contractor is closing out a job and needs an answer. We will ask you to start a

  little earlier or stay a little later when a project genuinely needs it. Not every day, and

  not as a habit, but it comes with the work and you should expect it.

- **Be honest with yourself about this.** If you are in the Philippines, 8am to 6pm Pacific is

  roughly 11pm to 9am your time. That is a full overnight shift. If that does not fit your life,

  please do not apply, and there is no hard feeling in that.

- No weekends. No overnight emergencies outside the window. Those stay with us.



## Compensation



- **$750 per month** to start, for the availability window above.

- **This role grows and so does the pay.** You start by running projects that are already

  scoped and approved: scheduling the contractor, keeping the work on track, verifying it was

  done right, and closing it out. Once you have proven that out, you take on the front half

  too, building the scope, pricing it, and getting the owner to sign, and your rate moves up

  with it. We will name that number in your offer, not leave it vague.

- Merit review at 90 days after conversion, then annually.

- We honor 13th month pay. We offer flexible coordinated time off and we cover your equipment.

  We treat our people well and the good ones grow with us.

- **Paid trial first.** Before any ongoing offer there is a short paid project, a couple of

  hours of real work, and we pay you for it.

- The first four weeks are an Initial Evaluation Term at close to full rate, so both sides get

  a real look before anyone commits.



## How we hire



We use a multi-step process and it is deliberately demanding. Every stage is something you do

on your own time, and we do not schedule a single call until you have already shown us how you

work. In order: a short application form, a 2-minute video and a 1-minute voice recording, a

written scenario exercise, a personality assessment, then an interview and a paid trial.



We move fast. Applications close in one week and we expect to make an offer within three.



**Deadlines are real at every stage. If you miss one, you are out. Please do not ask for an

extension.**



## How to apply



Fill out the form linked at the very bottom of this post.



**Applications sent any other way will not be reviewed.** Please do not message us on this

platform, do not
 us, and do not send a resume in a reply. Only form submissions are

looked at. We know that is strict. It is the first filter and it is working as intended.



Read the form carefully. One of the questions is there to check that you read this post.



**Apply here:

title: Short-Form Video Editor (TikTok/Reels/Shorts) — Faceless Product Content
description:
APPLY HERE: 



Satyaboard is a visual AI board for marketers. We are pre-launch and building an audience from zero.



THE WORK

Two to Three short-form videos a day across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Faceless product content: screen recordings of the software, AI voiceover, fast pacing. No talking heads.



THE ROLE

You receive a script, raw screen-recording footage and a finished voiceover track. You deliver a video that is ready to post - the cut, the captions, the sound design, the motion, the timing.



You will not write scripts, invent concepts, appear on camera or handle posting. We own the copy. You own the craft.



THE BAR

An eye for visual hierarchy. This matters more than everything else in this ad combined. Our footage is screen recordings of a busy interface - text competing with text, captions fighting a UI that is already full. Making that legible AND fast at the same time is the whole job. We cannot teach it, so we are only hiring people who already have it.



REQUIRED

- You have edited video before. Paid, client or personal work. This should not be your first edit.

- Real short-form pacing. Cuts that hold attention without feeling frantic.

- Fluent in a real editor: CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, Premiere Pro or After Effects. We do not care which.

- You edit on a computer, not a phone.

- English strong enough for precise feedback. You will get notes like "that cut lands two frames late".

- Reliable internet, no trouble moving large files.

- Available full-time, eight hours a day, weekdays.



NICE TO HAVE

Software demos, app promos or screen-recording work. Sound design. Motion graphics. Growing a social account from zero.



PAY

- Paid trial task (the test edit): $30 USD, paid whether or not we move forward

- Full-time rate: $250 USD / 2 weeks ($500 USD / month)

- Generous bonus program on top of base, tied to how the videos perform rather than how many you deliver. Full structure is presented when the contract is signed.



This is a long-term role. We are hiring 2-3 editors and keeping the ones who fit.



PROCESS - three steps, everyone completes all three

1. Fill out the form (five minutes).

2. Complete the paid trial task. Same script and footage as everyone else, free hand on the cut. We pay $30 either way.

3. Short interview, after we have seen your work.



We do not skip steps, and we do not hire anyone who has not done the trial task.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply at 



Send a portfolio link with at least three videos you have edited. Short-form work first. If you have edited screen recordings or software interfaces, put those first of all. Do not send a cover letter, a CV, or wedding and travel work.



We read every application with a portfolio link and reply to all of them, either way.

title: Creative Marketing Lead – Brand & Campaign Design | Full-Time | Remote
description:
Creative Marketing Lead – Brand & Campaign Design | Full-Time | Remote

Location: Remote, Philippines-based preferred

Schedule: Full-Time

Work Hours: U.S. business hours

Compensation: $7–$9 USD/hour based on experience and portfolio

Type: Long-Term | Full-Time



About the Role

We're looking for a Creative Marketing Lead to own creative production and direction across our marketing efforts — not just executing what's handed to you, but shaping how campaigns look, feel, and come together. This role is for someone with strong design instincts, real ownership of brand identity work, and the judgment to make creative calls with minimal hand-holding. You'll be the go-to person for creative output: setting the standard, keeping quality and consistency high, and — as the team grows — guiding other designers or freelancers on projects you lead.



This isn't a pure production role. We want someone who can take a rough idea or a marketing goal and turn it into a finished, on-brand campaign — and who's comfortable being the person who says "here's the better way to do this."



What You'll Do

Creative Direction & Production

Own the creative execution of marketing campaigns from concept to finished asset — social,
, web, ads, presentations, event materials

Set and maintain visual/brand standards across all creative output

Make creative decisions independently once given a goal or brief, rather than waiting for detailed direction

Build and evolve brand guidelines, templates, and systems that keep future production fast and consistent

Adapt and extend existing designs across formats without losing brand integrity



Leadership & Collaboration

Act as the point person for creative quality — review work (your own and, over time, any contributors' or freelancers' work) before it goes out

Translate marketing goals into a creative plan, then delegate or execute accordingly

Communicate proactively on status, blockers, and creative recommendations rather than just waiting for feedback

Partner directly with the marketing/leadership team on campaign strategy from the creative side



Project & Systems Ownership

Track and prioritize creative requests and deadlines across multiple concurrent projects

Keep design files, templates, and brand assets organized and easy for the team to use

Build repeatable systems/processes that reduce turnaround time as volume grows



Required Experience



Proven experience owning creative output for a brand or agency — not just producing individual assets, but shaping how they look and work together

Demonstrated experience building brand identity/guidelines from scratch (not only working from existing brand kits)

Strong eye for layout, typography, branding, and visual consistency

Fluency with: Figma, Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign), Canva

Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) as part of the creative workflow

Experience managing or mentoring other designers, or clearly demonstrated readiness to (e.g., led QA/review of others' work, ran a small design team, trained others)

Strong written and spoken English

Highly organized, deadline-driven, comfortable managing multiple projects at once

Comfortable working remotely with a U.S.-based team, full graveyard/US-hours overlap



What Success Looks Like

Creative output is consistently on-brand, polished, and requires minimal revision cycles

You're proactively flagging better creative approaches, not just executing requests as given

Templates, systems, and brand assets are organized and scalable

The team trusts you to make creative calls without close supervision

As the team grows, you're able to review and guide other designers' work



To Apply

Please submit:

1. A viewable link to your updated resume

2. A portfolio showing brand identity/guideline work you built from scratch (not just individual asset production) — plus social,
, web, and campaign samples

3. A short paragraph on: a project where you led creative direction (not just execution), and any experience reviewing or guiding other designers' work

4. A list of design, project management, and AI tools you use

title: Behavioral Health Documentation Specialist
description:
About the Role



EconoSourcing is recruiting on behalf of a behavioral health client seeking a highly organized and clinically knowledgeable Documentation Specialist to support their clinical team remotely. This role is ideal for a mental health professional who excels at the administrative and documentation side of care delivery and wants to contribute meaningfully to a client-centered practice without carrying a direct caseload.



You will work closely with licensed clinicians to ensure that client records are accurate, compliant, and completed on time. Attention to detail, discretion, and a deep respect for clinical and ethical standards are essential. Every document you touch represents a real person receiving care — precision and confidentiality are non-negotiable.



What You Will Do



Clinical Documentation Support



Draft, enter, and format progress notes under direct clinician supervision, ensuring accuracy and alignment with clinical intent.

Support clinicians in completing session documentation within required timeframes to maintain compliance and continuity of care.

Assist in addressing documentation backlogs promptly and systematically without compromising quality or compliance.

Review documentation for completeness, consistency, and adherence to applicable standards before submission.

Client Records & Consent Management



Assist with the preparation, completion, and tracking of client consents and intake documentation.

Maintain organized, up-to-date, and fully compliant client records across all active and archived files.

Ensure all documentation is stored, labeled, and accessible in accordance with HIPAA and applicable confidentiality standards.

Flag missing, expired, or incomplete consents and coordinate resolution with the clinical team.

Clinical Team Coordination



Coordinate with clinicians, supervisors, and administrative staff to ensure documentation deadlines are consistently met.

Serve as a reliable point of contact for documentation-related questions and workflow issues.

Support cross-functional documentation tasks as directed, ensuring all work streams remain connected and cohesive.

Communicate proactively when documentation gaps, errors, or compliance risks are identified.

Compliance & Confidentiality



Handle all client information with the highest standards of confidentiality and professionalism.

Apply working knowledge of HIPAA regulations and clinical documentation best practices in every task.

Maintain awareness of state and federal requirements governing behavioral health records.

Never access, share, or use client information outside the scope of assigned duties.

What We Are Looking For



Clinical Knowledge



You hold a Master’s degree or higher in a mental health-related field and understand how clinical documentation functions within a behavioral health practice. You know what a progress note should contain, why accuracy matters clinically and legally, and how to support a licensed clinician without overstepping scope.



Discretion & Confidentiality



You treat every piece of client information as sacred. You understand HIPAA not as a checkbox but as a professional obligation. You do not need to be reminded to protect privacy; it is instinctive.



Organization & Reliability



You thrive in detail-heavy environments. You manage multiple documentation tasks simultaneously without letting deadlines slip or records fall out of order. When a backlog exists, you approach it methodically and communicate your progress clearly.



Communication & Collaboration



You work well within a clinical team structure, following direction from licensed supervisors while contributing your expertise in documentation management. You ask clarifying questions when needed and flag issues before they become problems.



Required Qualifications



Master’s degree or higher in a mental health-related field (Psychology, Counseling, Social Work, or related discipline).

Working knowledge of HIPAA and behavioral health confidentiality standards.

Strong written English — clinical documentation requires precision and clarity.

Ability to work independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision.

Proficiency with standard productivity tools (Google Workspace or Microsoft Office).

Stable, secure remote workspace appropriate for handling confidential health information.

Preferred Qualifications



Prior experience with clinical documentation in a behavioral health or healthcare setting.

Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems.

Experience supporting licensed clinicians in a supervisory or administrative capacity.

Background in progress note writing, treatment planning, or clinical intake documentation.

Any experience in the medical field?

title: Commercial Insurance Cold Caller
description:
About the Role



Econosurance is an independent commercial insurance agency based in Cambridge, Massachusetts, specializing in helping small and mid-sized businesses protect their operations with smart, affordable coverage. We are looking for a sharp, confident, and well-prepared Cold Caller to join our outbound team and serve as the first voice prospects hear when they interact with Econosurance.



This is not a passive role. You will be navigating gatekeepers, earning access to decision-makers, and representing Econosurance with the polish and professionalism of someone who genuinely understands the commercial insurance world. Every call you make either opens a door or closes one, your preparation, communication, and resilience determine which.



What You Will Do



Outbound Prospecting



Make 100+ outbound dials per day to small and mid-sized business owners across Massachusetts, targeting industries such as contractors, restaurants, retail, and professional services.

Navigate gatekeepers confidently and professionally to reach the decision-maker, business owners, operations managers, or CFOs.

Open conversations with a compelling, natural hook that earns attention within the first 15 seconds.

Identify prospects approaching policy renewal and position Econosurance as a credible alternative worth considering.

Qualifying Decision-Makers



Use a structured needs analysis to uncover the prospect’s current carrier, renewal date, coverage types, number of employees, and pain points.

Apply the BANT framework (Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline) to assess fit before requesting a transfer.

Ask sharp, industry-specific questions that demonstrate preparation and earn the prospect’s respect.

Distinguish between a genuinely interested prospect and a polite brush-off, and know how to handle both.

Gatekeeper Navigation



Build brief rapport with receptionists and assistants to earn a warm pass-through.

Use professional, non-aggressive language that positions the call as valuable rather than intrusive.

Prepare and use multiple gatekeeper rebuttals confidently and without sounding scripted.

Never deceive or misrepresent the purpose of the call, credibility is non-negotiable.

Warm Transfers



Execute smooth, live warm transfers to licensed producers using RingCentral.

Provide a clean handoff that includes the prospect’s name, business type, coverage interest, and renewal timeline.

Stay on the line during introduction to maintain continuity and professionalism.

Ensure the producer has everything they need to pick up the conversation seamlessly.

CRM & Compliance



Log every call, outcome, and transfer in GoHighLevel CRM accurately and in real time.

Verify all prospect numbers against the DNC registry before dialing- zero tolerance for violations.

Tag every disposition correctly: Interested, Transferred, Callback, Not Interested, DNC Request.

Maintain a DNC violation rate of 0% and script adherence score of 85% or higher at all times.

What We Are Looking For



Communication - This Is Non-Negotiable



You speak clearly, confidently, and in a manner that commands attention without being pushy. Your English is strong, your tone is professional, and you can adapt your delivery from a receptionist to a business owner without missing a beat. You understand that in commercial insurance, you are not just selling coverage, you are earning trust on behalf of a licensed advisor.



Preparation



You show up to every call knowing the industry you are dialing into. You understand what a general contractor, restaurant owner, or retail shop operator cares about when it comes to insurance. You can speak intelligently about COIs, Workers’ Compensation, General Liability, and BOP policies - not as an expert, but as someone prepared enough to have a credible conversation and earn the transfer.



Resilience



You hear “no” dozens of times a day and it does not slow you down. You reset between calls, maintain energy throughout your shift, and treat every dial as a fresh opportunity. You track your own metrics and know exactly where you stand against your targets at any point in the day.



Discipline & Accountability



You log in on time, hit your dial targets, and maintain clean CRM records without being reminded. You follow compliance rules without shortcuts. You are honest about your numbers and proactive when something is not working.



Required Qualifications



Minimum 2 years of outbound calling experience in a BPO, telemarketing, or sales development role.

Prior experience supporting U.S.-based clients or campaigns, specifically in EST hours.

Strong spoken and written English — clear, professional, and confident.

Experience with CRM tools (GoHighLevel preferred).

Demonstrated ability to reach decision-makers and navigate gatekeepers.

Stable, quiet remote workspace with reliable high-speed internet and a quality headset.

Preferred Qualifications



Prior experience in insurance, financial services, or B2B commercial campaigns.

Familiarity with commercial insurance terminology (BOP, GL, WC, COI, renewal cycles).

Experience with RingCentral or similar VoIP/dialer platforms.

Knowledge of TCPA and DNC compliance requirements

Schedule



Monday to Friday - 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST, with a one-hour lunch break (12:00 – 1:00 PM).



How to Apply



Send your resume and a 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself and explaining why you are a strong fit for this role to 
 without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Dispatch Manager
description:
Job Title: Dispatch Manager

Employment terms: Full Time – Exempt

Reports to: Director of Supply Chain



Role & Responsibilities:

• The Dispatch Manager is a key operational leadership role responsible for coordinating with Sales Reps, the Director of Supply Chain, Customer Success Leads, the Chief Marketing Officer, Fulfillment, and Drivers to facilitate and oversee the completion of all tasks needed to deliver orders for in-house brands and to support other delivery needs of the company. The Dispatch Manager owns the end-to-end delivery process — from route planning and staging through dispatch, transit, and confirmed delivery — and is accountable for ensuring orders are delivered accurately, on time, and at the lowest reasonable cost. The role is also responsible for maintaining accurate and congruent records across internal systems, driving continuous process improvement, managing risk, and ensuring that DOT, DCC, and all regulatory requirements are followed within the Distribution area and distribution vehicles while off premises. The successful candidate must have strong organizational and communication skills, a proactive and detail-oriented approach, sound cost judgment, and the ability to lead and develop a team of drivers.



Primary Duties (including, but not limited to):

• Coordinating with Stakeholders: Collaborate with the Director of Supply Chain, Sales Reps, Customer Success Leads, the Chief Marketing Officer, Fulfillment, and Drivers to schedule daily deliveries and pickups that meet sales demand while minimizing distribution cost and overtime.

• KPI Establishment and Monitoring: Work with the Director of Supply Chain to establish daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly/annual dispatch KPIs (e.g., on-time delivery rate, cost per delivery, stops per route, and route efficiency). Continually monitor performance against these KPIs and report progress frequently.

• Route Planning and Optimization: Utilize Samsara and ClickUp to build, finalize, and manage all driver routes in advance of dispatch. Align routes to defined service areas, sequence stops to minimize drive time and cost, and time the first stop at or near each location’s open. Routes are to be built and finalized before dispatch, not after.

• Dispatch Data Reporting and Analysis: Monitor, maintain, and report all dispatch data generated within distribution during daily operation. Work with Sales Reps and the Director of Supply Chain on any observed data errors, outliers, or shifts in trends to preempt potential issues, and ensure dispatch and delivery times recorded in internal systems reflect actual, expected times.

• System Integrity (Samsara & ClickUp): Maintain accurate, congruent, and current records across Samsara and ClickUp at all times, ensuring vehicle assignments, task statuses, delivery dates, and route information reflect real-world operations.

• Stakeholder Communication and Follow-Up: Maintain constant, proactive communication with internal and external stakeholders including retail locations, sales reps, customers, and internal teams. Provide accurate ETAs, complete any required pre-arrival confirmation calls, follow up promptly on scheduling changes and confirmed dates, and ensure all relevant parties remain included in communication threads — re-adding anyone who drops off so no one is lost in the chain.

• Order and Manifest Management: Track orders accurately from placement through confirmed delivery. Ensure manifests are current and correct, order statuses are updated appropriately, and any delays or discrepancies are promptly investigated, corrected, and communicated to the relevant sales rep.

• Load Verification and Delivery Assurance: Verify that every item scheduled for delivery is correctly staged and loaded prior to dispatch. Use consolidated delivery lists to confirm completeness against what is loaded, taking ownership of ensuring all items requiring delivery are in fact delivered.

• Vehicle and Fleet Management: Monitor, maintain, and report vehicle status, issues, and metrics for all vehicles within the fleet. Utilize Samsara to schedule, log, and track vehicle service and preventative maintenance.

• Cost Analysis and Budget Management: Utilize Samsara to evaluate routing options and make cost-conscious, data-driven decisions. Monitor distribution costs against order value and delivery budgets to ensure fiscal responsibility, flagging routes where distribution cost is disproportionate to order value.

• Driver Leadership and Development: Direct, train, mentor, and evaluate drivers. Collaborate with HR for performance management and to address interpersonal issues. Oversee driver training programs, ensuring proper documentation and recurrence as needed by task.

• Regulatory Compliance: Maintain compliance with DCC and DOT requirements within the Distribution area and distribution vehicles while off premises. Monitor applicable regulations, facilitate the implementation and maintenance of compliant procedures, and inspect forms completed by drivers.

• Quality Auditing and Verification: Audit, inspect, and verify the quality of work completed within the dispatch areas, including driver-completed documentation and delivery execution.

• SOP and Continuous Improvement: Coordinate to establish new dispatch SOPs and update existing ones as needed. Facilitate RCA/CAPA exercises to remedy issues that occur within the dispatch areas.

• Risk Management: Identify potential risks in the dispatch and delivery process — including route disruptions, delays, and capacity constraints — and implement strategies to mitigate those risks.

• Interdepartmental Collaboration: Foster effective collaboration with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Fulfillment, and Supply Chain to support product launches, delivery execution, and other cross-functional projects.

• Technology Adoption: Explore and implement new technologies or automation to improve efficiency, routing, tracking, and accuracy within dispatch operations.

• Teamwork: Work well and effectively with fellow co-workers.

• Other Duties: Perform other duties as assigned by senior management.



Supervision & Evaluation:

Supervision received: Director of Supply Chain

Supervision given: Drivers

Evaluation process: 30, 60, & 90-day evaluations, as well as annual reviews following this initial evaluation period.



Qualifications:

Minimum qualifications for education, training, and prior experience:

• A High School Diploma or GED is required.

• Must be at least 21 years of age.



Preferred skills & knowledge:

• 2+ years of hands-on experience with dispatch or logistics.

• 1+ year of experience working within a warehouse environment.

• 1+ year in a leadership or supervisory-level position in any industry.

• Experience with route-management and fleet-telematics systems (e.g., Samsara) and task-management systems (e.g., ClickUp).

Attendance & General Performance Expectations:

title: Senior Financial Accountant/Revenue Controller
description:
About the Company



We are a growing U.S.-based music school generating approximately $1M in annual revenue with a team of roughly 30 employees.



Our core financial and operational systems include Opus1, Clover Connect, and QuickBooks Online. We are looking for an experienced accounting professional who can help us strengthen financial controls, reconcile revenue accurately, identify discrepancies, and improve the quality of our monthly financial reporting.



About the Role



We are seeking a detail-oriented Senior Financial Accountant / Revenue Controller to oversee revenue reconciliation, investigate discrepancies between billing systems and bank deposits, maintain clean and accurate books, and provide reliable financial reporting.



This role requires someone who is comfortable digging into complicated transactions, tracing missing or misapplied funds, identifying patterns, and explaining findings clearly.



The right person will be highly analytical, organized, dependable, and comfortable working independently.



Key Responsibilities



Revenue Reconciliation & Bookkeeping



Perform monthly three-way reconciliations comparing:

Opus1 invoices and billing activity

Clover Connect merchant payouts

QuickBooks Online bank deposits

Identify and investigate missing funds, unapplied credits, merchant processing fees, refunds, payment discrepancies, and software rollovers.

Properly categorize software billing and merchant-processing fees within QuickBooks Online.

Maintain accurate and fully reconciled accounts month over month.



Financial Reporting & Analysis



Prepare draft monthly Profit & Loss statements by the 10th of each month.

Track month-over-month revenue trends.

Analyze changes in fixed and variable expenses.

Monitor net profit margins.

Prepare payroll-to-revenue reporting.

Monitor teacher compensation ratios against company targets.



Financial Investigation



Research discrepancies between customer invoices, merchant transactions, deposits, credits, refunds, and recorded revenue.

Trace transactions across multiple systems to determine where inconsistencies originate.

Clearly document findings and recommend corrective action when needed.



Tax & Year-End Support



Maintain clean, reconciled books throughout the year.

Organize financial records for year-end tax preparation.

Coordinate with the company’s U.S.-based tax CPA as needed to support timely filings.



Operational Financial Support



Identify recurring cost anomalies or unexpected expense increases.

Monitor software fees and merchant-processing expenses.

Identify patterns involving uncollected revenue, refunds, credits, or billing inconsistencies.

Provide useful financial information to support pricing, compensation, and operational decisions.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

CPA designation preferred, but not required

Minimum 3 years of accounting experience

Experience working with U.S. accounting practices

Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

Experience with merchant-payment processing and bank reconciliation

Advanced Microsoft Excel and/or Google Sheets skills

Strong proficiency with Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, formulas, and complex data matching

Demonstrated experience auditing or reconciling subscription billing, practice-management, CRM, or similar software platforms

Strong written and spoken English

Exceptional attention to detail

Ability to independently investigate financial discrepancies and explain findings clearly

Preferred Qualifications

Experience reconciling transactions across multiple financial platforms

Experience working with recurring billing or subscription-based businesses

Experience with merchant processors or payment gateways

Experience supporting U.S.-based small or mid-sized businesses

Experience identifying revenue leakage or payment-processing discrepancies

Experience preparing management-level financial reports

What Success Looks Like



The person in this role should be able to answer questions like:



What was billed?

What was actually collected?

What reached the bank?

Where did the difference go?



We are looking for someone who does more than maintain the books. We want someone who can find the story behind the numbers and identify when something does not add up.



How to Apply



Begin your application with:



Opus1 Reconciliation Found



In 2–3 sentences, describe a situation where you reconciled information between a billing system, payment gateway, accounting system, and/or bank account and discovered a financial discrepancy.



Please include:



Your resume

Your hourly rate

Your availability

Your experience with QuickBooks Online

Your experience with revenue reconciliation or payment-processing audits



We look forward to receiving your resume!

title: Overnight Meta Ads Monitor (Shopify DTC Brand) — Daytime PH Hours
description:
Overview



I run a Shopify fashion brand selling to Australia, with Meta ads running 24/7. I'm based in Europe and asleep during a critical spending window. I need one person to watch my ad account during those hours and pull the plug on campaigns that breach clearly defined rules.



This is a monitoring and execution role, not a strategy role. You will not be asked to write ads, build audiences, or decide what to scale. You will be given a written SOP with exact thresholds, and your job is to follow it precisely and log what you did.



What You'll Actually Do

Log into Meta Ads Manager and Shopify at the start of your shift and check both every 30 minutes for the duration

Compare live ad spend against Shopify orders and revenue for the day

Pause any campaign, ad set, or ad that hits the kill thresholds in the SOP (spend without conversions, CPA above ceiling, ROAS below floor — exact numbers provided)

Record every action in a shared Google Sheet: timestamp, what you paused, spend at time of pause, which rule triggered it

Flag anything unusual immediately via WhatsApp/Slack — site down, checkout errors, sudden spend spike, ad account disabled, payment failure

Send a short end-of-shift summary: total spend, orders, what was paused and why

What You Will NOT Do

Turn campaigns back on (I do that)

Change budgets, bids, audiences, or creative

Make judgment calls outside the SOP — if it's not covered, you message me and wait

Requirements

Hands-on experience inside Meta Ads Manager (you must be able to navigate campaign/ad set/ad levels without hand-holding)

Familiarity with Shopify admin, at minimum the Orders and Analytics sections

Understanding of ROAS, CPA, CPM, CTR — I'll test this

Reliable internet plus a backup connection (mobile data is fine), and a smartphone for alerts

Disciplined and literal. I want someone who follows the rule exactly, not someone who improvises because they had a hunch

Clear written English

Available consistently at the same hours — reliability matters more than experience here

Nice to Have

Experience with DTC / dropshipping brands

Familiarity with Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar

Experience monitoring accounts spending $500+/day

How to Apply



Please don't send a generic application. Include:



The word "Whitecap" in your first line so I know you read this

A short description of the largest ad account you've worked in and what your role was

Your answer to this: A campaign has spent $80 today with 1 sale at $65 AOV. The SOP says pause at $60 spend with fewer than 2 sales. What do you do, and what do you write in the log?

title: Translator / Localization Specialist – Freelance / Remote
description:
**Peak Media World** is looking for a reliable and detail-oriented **Translator / Localization Specialist** to support us in expanding our digital content into additional international markets.



We are not looking for someone who simply translates word for word. We are looking for someone who understands **localization**: adapting content so that it feels natural, clear, culturally appropriate, and professionally written for the target audience.



## About the Role



Our content is currently produced primarily in **German and English**.



We are now expanding into four additional languages:



* **Spanish**

* **Portuguese**

* **Italian**

* **French**



The role will initially focus on translating and localizing existing and newly created content, including digital guides, books, articles, website content, product descriptions, and other digital materials.



Our content portfolio will continue to grow, so this can develop into an ongoing collaboration.



## What You Will Do



* Translate and localize German and/or English content into your native or near-native language

* Adapt wording, expressions, tone, and examples to the target market where appropriate

* Ensure that translated content sounds natural rather than machine-translated

* Review and correct AI-assisted translations

* Check grammar, spelling, terminology, consistency, and readability

* Maintain consistent terminology across larger projects

* Identify cultural or linguistic issues that should be adapted rather than translated literally

* Follow provided style guides, terminology lists, and formatting requirements

* Perform quality checks before content is published

* Communicate clearly when something in the source content is unclear or requires a decision



## AI-Assisted Workflow



We use **AI wherever it can make our processes faster and more efficient**.



This means you may receive AI-assisted translations or drafts as a starting point.



Your role is **not to compete with AI on word-for-word translation**, but to provide the human expertise that AI cannot reliably provide:



**accuracy · natural language · cultural understanding · consistency · quality control**



You should therefore be comfortable working with AI tools and reviewing AI-generated content critically.



## What We Are Looking For



You should have:



* Native-level or excellent professional command of at least **one** of the target languages

* Very good English and/or German

* Excellent written language skills

* A strong feeling for language, tone, and context

* Excellent attention to detail

* A structured and reliable working style

* Experience with translation, localization, content editing, proofreading, or similar work

* The ability to follow detailed instructions and style guidelines

* Good communication skills

* The ability to work independently and meet agreed deadlines



Experience with **digital products, publishing, e-commerce, websites, SEO content, or online content** is an advantage.



## Important



You do **not** need to speak all four languages.



We are interested in specialists who can contribute to one or more of the following language markets:



**Spanish · Portuguese · Italian · French**



Please indicate clearly in your application:



1. Which language(s) you can work in

2. Your level in each language

3. Your experience with translation/localization

4. Which tools you normally use

5. Whether you have experience reviewing or improving AI-generated translations



## Working Arrangement



* **Remote**

* **Freelance / part-time collaboration**

* Flexible working hours

* Project-based work with the potential for ongoing collaboration

* Workload will grow according to our content production and localization needs



## About Peak Media World



Peak Media World is building a portfolio of digital content, knowledge products, and international online projects.



We value:



**quality · reliability · clear processes · careful work · continuous improvement**



We are building our workflows with a strong focus on **automation and AI-supported processes**, while keeping human expertise where it creates real value.



If you enjoy language, precision, and making content feel genuinely native to its audience, we would love to hear from you.



## How to Apply



Please include **“LOCALIZATION”** in your application.



Tell us briefly:



* Which language(s) you specialize in

* Your relevant experience

* Your availability

* Your expected hourly rate

* A short example of previous translation/localization work, if available



**Please make sure that “LOCALIZATION” appears in your application.**

title: Bookkeeper/Client Accounting Associate
description:
About Caliber Consultants Corp.



Caliber Consultants Corp is a growing Canadian bookkeeping and financial advisory firm based in Alberta.



We help small-business owners gain clarity, control and confidence in their finances through accurate bookkeeping, reliable monthly reporting and practical financial guidance.



We are building a modern, process-driven accounting firm and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us over the long term.



About the Role



We are looking for an experienced, dependable and detail-oriented QuickBooks Online bookkeeper to join us as our first Client Accounting Associate.



You will support the recurring bookkeeping and month-end processes for multiple Canadian small-business clients. You will work directly with the firm’s founder and follow established procedures, checklists and review controls.



This is not a generic virtual-assistant position. It is an accounting-focused role for someone who enjoys clean books, balanced reconciliations and well-organized working papers.



You will not be expected to make unsupported accounting decisions. When something is unclear, we expect you to investigate, document the issue and flag it for review rather than guess.



Your Responsibilities



Client bookkeeping



Maintain accurate client records in QuickBooks Online



Review and categorize bank-feed transactions using established rules



Reconcile bank, credit-card, loan and clearing accounts



Match receipts, invoices and other supporting documents



Identify missing, duplicated or unusual transactions



Assist with accounts payable and accounts receivable tracking



Prepare supporting schedules and organized working papers



Support bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up projects



Month-end support



Complete monthly-close checklists



Confirm that required accounts have been reconciled



Prepare draft Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet reports



Identify unexpected balances or changes requiring review



Maintain lists of outstanding questions and missing information



Prepare client files for final review by the firm’s founder



Canadian compliance support



Assist with GST/HST working-paper preparation



Track input tax credits and sales-tax balances



Support payroll and source-remittance reconciliations



Organize year-end information for the client’s accountant or tax preparer



You will not initially file tax returns, submit government remittances, make payments or post significant adjusting entries without approval.



Client and practice operations



Maintain client document-request lists



Draft professional follow-up messages for missing information



Keep client folders and supporting documents organized



Update task deadlines and workflow status



Follow and help improve standard operating procedures



Communicate completed work, questions and potential problems clearly



Required Qualifications



At least two years of hands-on bookkeeping experience



Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online



Experience reconciling bank and credit-card accounts



Good understanding of debits, credits and basic financial statements



Strong Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets skills



Excellent written and spoken English



Reliable computer, internet connection and backup plan



Ability to protect confidential client and financial information



Ability to meet recurring weekly and monthly deadlines



Experience working independently in a remote environment



Preferred Qualifications



QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification



Experience supporting Canadian businesses



Experience with GST/HST and input tax credits



Experience with Canadian payroll or source deductions



Experience working for an accounting or bookkeeping firm



Familiarity with month-end working papers and review processes



Experience supporting multiple client files simultaneously



Canadian experience is preferred, but a highly capable candidate with strong accounting fundamentals and a willingness to learn Canadian requirements is encouraged to apply.



The Person We Are Looking For



You may be a strong fit if you:



Take pride in accurate and organized work



Enjoy following checklists and completing recurring processes



Investigate discrepancies instead of forcing balances



Flag issues early rather than waiting until a deadline



Ask thoughtful and specific questions



Communicate reliably without needing repeated follow-up



Are comfortable receiving review notes and improving your work



Want a stable, respectful and long-term working relationship



Are interested in growing into greater responsibility as the firm expands



This position may not be a good fit if you frequently miss deadlines, guess when accounting treatment is unclear, resist documented procedures or are looking only for a short-term project.



Schedule and Communication



Most work can be completed according to a flexible Philippine schedule, provided deadlines are met.



You must be available for:



One scheduled video check-in each week



Occasional training or review meetings during early Alberta business hours



Written communication during each working day



A response to normal messages within one business day



The position will begin at approximately 8–10 hours per week. Hours may increase as you successfully take responsibility for more client files.



Compensation and Development



$7–$10 USD per hour, based on relevant experience



Paid skills assessment for shortlisted candidates



Paid onboarding and training



Flexible remote schedule



Compensation review after the initial 90-day period



Opportunity for increased hours and responsibility



Long-term opportunity within a growing Canadian firm



How to Apply



Begin your application with the word CLARITY so we know you read the complete posting.



Please include:



A brief introduction and explanation of why this role interests you.



Your number of years using QuickBooks Online.



The number and types of businesses you have supported.



Any experience you have with Canadian bookkeeping, GST/HST or payroll.



A copy or link to your QuickBooks Online certification, if applicable.



Your current weekly availability and other ongoing employment commitments.



Your requested hourly rate.



A description of your computer, internet connection and backup arrangements.



A link to a short video introduction of no more than two minutes.



Please also answer these questions:



What steps would you take if a QuickBooks bank reconciliation did not balance?



What is an input tax credit in the Canadian GST/HST system?



What would you do if you were unsure how to categorize a client transaction?



Describe an accounting error you identified in a previous role and how you handled it.



Shortlisted applicants will receive a small paid bookkeeping assessment involving an anonymized QuickBooks-style reconciliation, error identification and a written client question.



We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted, long-term member of Caliber Consultants. If you value accuracy, clear communication and continuous improvement, we would be pleased to hear from you.

Remote | Full-Time 



About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented, experienced bookkeeper with expertise in AppFolio and QuickBooks. This role supports the day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping operations for both a property management and investment rental portfolio. You must be confident working independently and communicating clearly in a remote setting.



Responsibilities



AppFolio

-Run and interpret financial reports (P&L, balance sheet, cash flow)

-Manage trust accounts in compliance with applicable regulations

-Have a complete understanding to fully handle bank reconciliations from start to finish

-Post rent payments, late fees, and other tenant charges 

-Process and manage accounts payable and vendor invoices

-Build and manage maintenance work orders

-Perform monthly bank reconciliations within AppFolio

-Review and ensure accurate accounting on owner statements

-Manage tenant and owner ledgers

-Handle security deposit tracking and dispositions

-Maintain tenant and owner portal data accuracy



QuickBooks

-Export and transfer financial data from AppFolio into QuickBooks for company financials

-Maintain accurate books in QuickBooks alongside AppFolio records

-Reconcile accounts in QuickBooks

-Assist with 1099 preparation for vendors at year-end

-Generate financial reports and budget variance analysis in QuickBooks



General Bookkeeping

-Track and manage accounts receivable and payable

-Support monthly and year-end close processes

-Maintain organized financial records and documentation

-Communicate professionally with property owners and vendors regarding financial matters

-Assist with utility billing and reconciliation



Required Skills & Experience

-Bachelors in Accounting or Bookkeeping

-Minimum of 3 years of bookkeeping experience in Quickbooks and Appfolio

-Proficient in AppFolio Property Manager — this is a hard requirement; please do not apply if you do not have AppFolio experience

-Proficient in QuickBooks for use of a property management company and residential real estate inventments

-Experience transferring or syncing data between AppFolio and QuickBooks (no API option; we have Appfolio Basic)

-Strong understanding of real estate or property management accounting

-High attention to detail and accuracy

-Able to work independently with minimal supervision

-Strong written English communication skills



Preferred Qualifications

-Familiarity with owner reporting and trust accounting

-Accounting degree or certification (not required but a plus)



HOW TO APPLY



To be considered, please include the following in your application:

- A 1-minute voice sample (Vocaroo is an option to submit this)

- Your WPM score with the 3 Minute Test:

      

- A summary of your AppFolio experience — specific tasks you have performed

- Your QuickBooks experience — Online vs. Desktop, and how long

- The Phrase Appaloosa1 in the Subject Line

- Any examples of how you have moved data between AppFolio and QuickBooks

***Applications missing any of the above will not be reviewed.

title: Bookkeeper – AppFolio & QuickBooks Operator
description:

* Ability to accurately transfer and reconcile AppFolio reporting into QuickBooks

* Trust accounts handled correctly and confidently

* Seamless systems between AppFolio and QuickBooks

title: Business Development Representative (Part-Time Contract) —  Partnerships with Running Event Organizers
Growth Strategist - Meta Ads + Copywriting (Full Time, EST Hours)
description:
Perfect Growth Agency is a digital marketing agency running paid

acquisition for service businesses in North America. We are hiring ONE

full-time Growth Strategist to take ownership of ad performance across

our existing client accounts.



This is a thinking role, not a button-pushing role. You will not be

handed a complete brief and told what to build. You will be given a

client, an account, and a goal, and we expect you to dig in, ask sharp

questions, and come back with a plan.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Learn our existing client accounts deeply: their customers, their

  offers, what has been tested, what is working and what is fading

- Report weekly per client. Not a numbers dump, a clear story: what we

  tested, what we learned, what is next

- Propose and run the next moves: new angles, new hooks, new creative,

  budget and structure changes

- Write ad copy and concept the creative, then brief our video editors

  and AI design tools clearly enough that they get it right first time

- Write and build landing pages using AI tools, and diagnose why a page

  is not converting

- Make the daily Meta ads calls: kill, scale, or iterate



YOU ARE A FIT IF



- You have 2+ years hands-on Meta ads experience with real budget, and

  can walk through an account you personally ran and defend every

  decision you made

- You have direct response copy instincts. You can explain WHY a hook

  works, not just that it did

- You have written and built landing pages and understand what makes

  them convert

- You use AI daily as a real part of how you work, not as a novelty

- You ask WHY before HOW. The how you can research and figure out. The

  why you push on

- You communicate clearly in writing and on video

- You can work EST hours (US Eastern Time), full time, long term



NOT IN THIS ROLE



GoHighLevel builds, video editing, sales calls, client account

management. We have people for those. Your job is thinking, testing,

and performance.



SALARY AND GROWTH



USD 800 to 1000 per month to start, depending on experience. Reviewed

at 3 months with a clear path to USD 1400+ based on results. We are

hiring someone to grow into a lead seat as we scale, not a short term

contractor.



HOW TO APPLY



Then answer these three, briefly:



1. One Meta account you personally ran: the niche, roughly the monthly

   budget, and your best result

2. The best performing hook you ever wrote, and why you think it worked

3. Confirm you can work EST hours, full time, long term



Shortlisted applicants will be asked to record a short Loom video

walking through one real campaign they ran.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:

We partner with skilled nursing facilities, assisted living communities, and home health agencies to ensure patients receive high-quality, compassionate care without unnecessary hospital visits.



Job Description



We are looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Administrative Assistant to join our growing remote healthcare team. This role will provide administrative and patient coordination support to our providers and internal team.



The ideal candidate is comfortable communicating with patients, healthcare providers, home health agencies, and skilled nursing facilities. You should be organized, responsive, able to manage multiple tasks, and comfortable learning and working with electronic health record (EHR) systems and other business applications.

- Enter, update, and maintain accurate patient information and documentation in the EHR system.

- Assist patients and providers with appointment-related questions, scheduling, and technical or administrative needs when necessary.

- Coordinate with home health agencies and skilled nursing facilities regarding patient updates, appointments, and other required information.

- Monitor new patient referrals and patient admissions to ensure they are properly received and processed.

- Follow up on laboratory results, medical records, and other documents needed for patient care.

- Communicate with healthcare providers and facilities to obtain missing information or documentation.

- Monitor patient-related tasks and follow up as needed to ensure timely completion.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Comfortable communicating with patients, healthcare providers, and healthcare facilities by phone, text, and
.

- Ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.

- Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred:

How to Apply

- A link to your resume

- Your
 address



Applications without a resume link and

We're looking for someone who is dependable, organized, compassionate, and comfortable working in a fast-paced healthcare environment. If you're interested in a long-term opportunity and enjoy helping patients and supporting a healthcare team, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Head of Operations - Short-Term Rental Property Management (Remote, EU Hours)
description:
HEAD OF OPERATIONS - SHORT-TERM RENTAL PROPERTY MANAGEMENT



Remote - Philippines

Full-Time - European Hours

Long-Term Growth Opportunity



ABOUT LANDO PARIS



Lando Paris is an established short-term rental and property management company managing a growing portfolio of apartments in Paris and the surrounding area.



We coordinate guest communication, housekeeping, maintenance, property owners, Airbnb listings, emergencies, onboarding, quality control and business development.



We are now looking for a highly capable Head of Operations who can progressively take full ownership of the company’s daily operations.



This is not a basic Virtual Assistant role.



We are looking for someone who can think, organize, make decisions, improve systems, create clear SOPs, manage people and eventually run the entire operational side of the company with minimal involvement from the founder.



YOUR MAIN OBJECTIVE



Your objective will be to make Lando operate smoothly, professionally and independently without the founder being involved in daily operations.



You will initially handle many tasks yourself. As the portfolio grows, you will recruit, train and manage additional Virtual Assistants and specialists.



You will be responsible for the system, even when individual tasks are later delegated to other team members.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



Daily operations:



* Manage guest messages across Airbnb and other communication channels

* Coordinate housekeepers and confirm every cleaning

* Coordinate maintenance workers and local service providers

* Manage check-in, check-out and access issues

* Handle guest complaints, emergencies and service recovery

* Track every incident until it is completely resolved

* Request and verify photos after cleaning or maintenance

* Maintain accurate property information, instructions and checklists

* Make sure no task, arrival, issue or owner request is forgotten



Property and owner management:



* Communicate professionally with property owners by
 and messaging

* Collect missing property information, documents, photos and equipment details

* Coordinate new property onboarding

* Create and update Airbnb listings

* Keep property accounts, calendars and settings accurate

* Organize photographers, maintenance, supplies and property improvements

* Prepare clear updates and reports for owners

* Identify risks before they become complaints



Systems and process improvement:



* Document all recurring processes as clear SOPs

* Build checklists, decision trees and escalation procedures

* Audit our current processes and recommend improvements

* Automate repetitive tasks using AI, Make, Zapier or similar tools

* Organize tasks and information using Google Workspace and project management software

* Create weekly operational dashboards

* Maintain a structured database of properties, owners and service providers

* Continuously look for ways to improve quality, speed and efficiency



Team management:



* Help recruit future Guest Communication VAs and operational assistants

* Train new team members using SOPs and recorded processes

* Review their work and provide feedback

* Build schedules and backup coverage

* Monitor performance and accountability

* Make sure the team maintains Lando’s service standards



Lead management:



* Make sure every new lead from Airbnb or our website enters the CRM

* Collect and organize the information needed by the French-speaking salesperson

* Assign leads immediately and notify the salesperson

* Monitor response times and follow-up status

* Maintain an accurate sales pipeline



You will not be responsible for closing French sales calls. A French-speaking salesperson will handle them.



LANGUAGE AND COMMUNICATION



Excellent written and spoken English is required.



French is not required.



Most French communication will be completed using AI translation, approved templates and clear internal guidelines. French voice messages can be transcribed and translated using AI.



You must be extremely careful when checking:



* Names

* Dates and times

* Addresses

* Prices and refunds

* Instructions

* Promises made to guests or owners



We expect you to use AI intelligently, but never send unverified AI output.



French phone calls will be handled separately.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You may be a strong fit if you:



* Have at least three years of experience in operations, project management, property management or hospitality

* Ideally have previous Airbnb or short-term rental experience

* Have coordinated guests, housekeepers, maintenance workers or vendors

* Have created SOPs, checklists or operational systems

* Have managed or trained other team members

* Are exceptionally organized and detail-oriented

* Learn new software quickly

* Are comfortable using ChatGPT, Claude or similar AI tools

* Can solve problems without waiting for constant instructions

* Take responsibility when something goes wrong

* Communicate clearly and professionally

* Know when to make a decision and when to escalate

* Have a reliable computer, Internet connection and backup Internet

* Are looking for a serious, long-term position



Experience with any of the following is a strong advantage:



* Airbnb

* Guesty, Hostaway, Hospitable or another PMS

* Google Workspace

* GoHighLevel

* ClickUp, Asana or Notion

* Make or Zapier

* ChatGPT or Claude

* WhatsApp Business

* Short-term rental operations



HOW WE EXPECT YOU TO ESCALATE PROBLEMS



We do not want messages that simply say:



“What should I do?”



Before escalating, you should provide:



1. What happened

2. The potential impact

3. What you already checked

4. The possible solutions

5. Your recommended solution

6. The deadline for making the decision



Critical safety, security, legal or access issues must always be escalated immediately.



WORKING HOURS



This is a full-time position of approximately 40 hours per week.



Your regular schedule must overlap with Paris business and guest-arrival hours. A likely schedule would be approximately 4:00 PM to 1:00 AM Philippine time, adjusted when European daylight-saving time changes.



The agreed schedule may include one weekend day.



The company serves guests seven days per week. You will own the coverage system, but you will not be expected to personally work 13 hours per day, seven days per week.



During the initial transition, occasional critical monitoring outside core hours may be required. AI, automation and backup coverage will progressively handle the remaining periods.



COMPENSATION AND PROGRESSION



Starting compensation:



USD $500 per month during the initial 90-day probationary and training period.



After successfully completing the 90-day scorecard:



USD $1,000 per month.



There is a path to USD $1,800 or more as:



* The portfolio grows

* You take full ownership of operations

* The founder is removed from daily operations

* You successfully recruit and manage additional VAs

* You consistently improve service quality and efficiency



Performance bonuses may also be introduced based on operational quality, reliability, process improvements and company performance.



FIRST 90-DAY OUTCOMES



By the end of your first 90 days, we expect:



* Daily operations to run without constant founder involvement

* Every recurring task to be documented and tracked

* Cleaning, maintenance and arrival workflows to be reliable

* A structured SOP library to be established

* A weekly operational dashboard to be delivered

* New leads to be routed and tracked correctly

* Escalations to include research, options and recommendations

* The founder’s operational involvement to be reduced to fewer than four hours per week

* Guest and owner service quality to remain consistently high



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the exact words:



BONJOUR LANDO



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered.



Then answer the following questions:



1. How many years of operations, property management or short-term rental experience do you have?

2. How many properties or client accounts have you managed at the same time?

3. Describe the most difficult operational incident you personally handled. What happened and what did you do?

4. Describe one SOP, system or automation you created. What problem did it solve?

5. Which project management, property management and AI tools have you used?

6. Have you ever recruited, trained or managed other team members?

7. Are you available to work European hours, including one weekend day?

8. What backup Internet or power solution do you have?

9. Why are you interested in taking ownership of an entire operation rather than working as a task-based VA?



Please include your CV and any relevant examples of SOPs, dashboards or systems you have previously created.



You may use AI to help structure your application, but every claim must be truthful and based on your real experience.



Generic cover letters will not be considered.



Shortlisted candidates will complete a paid practical operations test and a final video interview.

 and SMS nurture sequences

title: Out Reach Specialist / Link Builder
description:
Location

Remote



Job Type

Full-Time / Long-term Contractor



About iTishniki:

iTishniki is a fast-growing digital agency delivering results-driven SEO and digital marketing solutions. We focus on building authentic, high-impact online authority for our clients—no cheap shortcuts, no spam networks, and no low-quality guest posts.



Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Off-Page SEO & Backlink Specialist to manage and execute local backlink acquisition and link profile maintenance across our client portfolio.



You will be responsible for researching hyper-local link opportunities, executing outreach campaigns, monitoring domain authority, and actively managing backlink toxicity. This is not an entry-level role. We are looking for someone who understands modern search algorithms (Google SpamBrain, Link Spam updates) and knows how to build real authority for local businesses.



Responsibilities

Local Link Acquisition: Execute manual, high-ROI outreach campaigns to acquire hyper-local and niche-relevant backlinks (e.g., local press, community partnerships, sponsorships, unlinked brand mentions, local resource pages, and regional business directories).



Competitor Backlink Analysis: Use Ahrefs and Semrush to analyze competitor link profiles, identify link gaps, and reverse-engineer successful local strategies.



Link Health & Toxicity Monitoring: Audit backlink profiles regularly using Semrush Backlink Audit and Ahrefs to identify spammy, toxic, or low-quality links, preparing disavow files when necessary.



Prospecting & Outreach Management: Build clean prospect lists, find verified contact details, and craft personalized, high-converting outreach
 sequences.



Anchor Text & Velocity Strategy: Plan and track anchor text diversity and link velocity to ensure natural, penalty-proof profile growth.



Reporting & Tracking: Maintain transparent monthly backlink logs and provide clear reporting on acquired links, active pipeline, and overall link profile health.



Requirements

Experience: Minimum 2–3 years of hands-on experience in off-page SEO, digital PR, or local link building.



Tool Proficiency: Advanced expertise with Ahrefs and Semrush (specifically Backlink Analytics, Link Intersect, and Backlink Audit tools).



Local SEO Knowledge: Clear understanding of how local backlinks impact Map Pack (GMB/GBP) rankings and localized organic search.



White-Hat Philosophy: Strict reliance on manual outreach and genuine relationship-building. Zero tolerance for PBNs, automated spam blasts, or cheap link seller lists.



Communication: Excellent written English skills for crafting persuasive outreach
s and communicating with site editors/business owners.



Self-Motivated: Strong organizational skills to independently manage multiple client campaigns in a remote environment.



Compensation

100% remote working environment.



Stable, long-term position with a growing agency team.



Access to premium SEO tool stacks and automation resources.



Competitive salary based on experience and performance.



Join our talented team at iTishniki and be part of our exciting journey. Apply now and contribute to the success of our clients’ businesses through the creation of innovative and customer-centric services.

title: Publishing Assistant Intern / Publishing Operations Assistant
