title: Grant Writer & Funding Research Assistant
description:
Location: Remote

Schedule: Flexible part-time; approximately 10–20 hours per week

Position Type: Internship, part-time, project-based, or contract opportunity depending on candidate experience and organizational needs

Compensation: Unpaid/academic credit where applicable for qualifying internship arrangements. Limited paid opportunities, stipends, project-based compensation, or transition to paid contract work may be available based on experience, funding, performance, business need, and role scope.



About the Opportunity

We are seeking a talented, detail-oriented, and mission-driven Grant Writer & Funding Research Assistant to help identify, research, develop, and support competitive funding opportunities across a diverse portfolio of high-impact initiatives.

Our work spans education, artificial intelligence, healthcare, accessibility, special education, housing, real estate and community development, youth and family services, economic mobility, workforce development, media, technology, and social impact.

The ideal candidate is both a strong researcher and a persuasive writer who can connect community needs, organizational strategy, measurable outcomes, evidence, and compelling storytelling to the priorities of funders.

This role may support nonprofit, philanthropic, corporate, foundation, local, state, and federal funding opportunities. Depending on experience, the selected candidate may contribute to grants ranging from smaller foundation requests to complex public-sector and innovation-focused opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

• Research foundation, corporate, local, state, federal, and other funding opportunities

• Identify grants aligned with organizational mission, programs, geography, eligibility, and strategic priorities

• Review Requests for Proposals, Notices of Funding Opportunities, grant guidelines, and funder requirements

• Evaluate grant opportunities for eligibility, competitiveness, strategic fit, capacity, and return on effort

• Maintain grant prospect databases, funding calendars, and deadline trackers

• Draft and edit grant proposals, letters of inquiry, concept papers, executive summaries, and application responses

• Support development of compelling needs statements, program descriptions, organizational narratives, and sustainability plans

• Research credible statistics, community needs, demographic data, industry trends, and evidence-based practices

• Help develop goals, objectives, outputs, outcomes, logic models, and evaluation narratives

• Support budget narratives and alignment between program activities, outcomes, and proposed expenses

• Organize standard grant attachments, institutional documents, biographies, letters of support, and reusable content

• Coordinate information needed from leadership, program teams, finance professionals, partners, and external stakeholders

• Track submitted, pending, awarded, declined, and upcoming opportunities

• Support grant reporting and post-award documentation where appropriate

• Research prospective foundations, corporate partners, government agencies, and philanthropic relationships

• Use AI tools responsibly for research support, drafting assistance, editing, and workflow efficiency while independently verifying facts, citations, eligibility requirements, and source data

Preferred Qualifications

• Strong persuasive and professional writing skills

• Excellent research and analytical skills

• Exceptional attention to detail

• Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, compelling narratives

• Strong written English

• Ability to manage multiple deadlines and application requirements

• Familiarity with nonprofit, foundation, corporate, or government grants is preferred

• Experience with grant databases, prospect research, public funding portals, or funding research tools is a plus

• Familiarity with logic models, program evaluation, outcomes measurement, or evidence-based practices is a plus

• Experience in education, healthcare, technology, housing, community development, youth services, workforce development, or social impact is highly valued

• Familiarity with Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, project-management tools, and AI-assisted research tools is preferred

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate understands that successful grant writing is not simply good writing.

Strong grant development requires strategic alignment, careful reading, eligibility analysis, credible research, measurable outcomes, persuasive storytelling, deadline management, compliance, and the judgment to know when an organization should—or should not—pursue an opportunity.

You may thrive in this role if you enjoy:

• Finding opportunities others overlook

• Turning complex programs into compelling narratives

• Researching credible data and evidence

• Connecting funder priorities to measurable community impact

• Managing detailed requirements and deadlines

• Asking thoughtful questions before drafting

• Helping mission-driven organizations secure resources to scale their impact

What You Will Gain

• Hands-on experience with real-world grant development and funding strategy

• Exposure to nonprofit, startup, education, healthcare, technology, housing, and community-development initiatives

• Experience researching diverse public and private funding sources

• Opportunities to strengthen grant writing, research, evaluation, and strategic-development skills

• Portfolio-building opportunities where confidentiality permits

• Mentorship and professional development

• Potential academic credit where approved by the student’s institution

• Potential consideration for future paid project, contract, or employment opportunities based on funding, performance, business need, and role availability

How to Apply

Please submit:

Resume or LinkedIn profile

One writing sample

Weekly availability

Desired hourly or project rate, if applying for paid contract consideration

List of grant databases, research tools, AI tools, or productivity platforms you have used

Brief description of any grant writing, fundraising, nonprofit, academic research, government funding, or proposal-development experience

A short response to the following question:

“What factors would you evaluate before recommending that an organization invest significant time and resources into applying for a grant?”

Additional Screening Question

Please answer:

“You discover a $500,000 grant that appears strongly aligned with an organization’s mission, but the eligibility language is unclear and the application is due in 12 days. What would you do before recommending that leadership pursue it?”

title: Affiliate Manager – Remote / Part-time
description:
**Peak Media World** is looking for a proactive, organized, and commercially minded **Affiliate Manager** to help us build and develop our international recommendation and distribution network.



This is not simply an administrative affiliate role.



Our main goal is to find and develop **partners who can recommend, promote, or distribute Peak Media World products and content to their own audiences.**



At the same time, we will also identify suitable affiliate products and programs that we can recommend through projects such as **MovePERMA**.



About the Role



Peak Media World is building a portfolio of digital content, books, guides, knowledge products, websites, and thematic projects for international audiences.



We want to build a strong network of people and organizations that can help us reach relevant audiences.



Potential partners may include:



* Influencers and content creators

* Bloggers and publishers

* Media companies

* Thematic websites

* Newsletter publishers

* Online communities

* Affiliate websites and platforms

* Content platforms

* Other relevant recommendation or distribution partners



The primary focus of this role is therefore:



**Finding partners who can recommend or distribute our products and content.**



Your Main Responsibilities



1. Build Our Partner Network



You will research and identify potential partners who could be a good fit for Peak Media World.



This includes:



* Finding relevant websites, publishers, creators, influencers, media companies, newsletters, communities, and platforms

* Building and maintaining structured partner lists

* Researching audience, content, reach, relevance, and business model

* Identifying suitable partnership and affiliate opportunities

* Prioritizing the most promising prospects

* Finding the correct contact person or partnership channel

* Preparing and sending professional outreach messages

* Following up with potential partners

* Maintaining communication and developing long-term relationships

* Keeping partner information organized and up to date



The goal is not to collect as many contacts as possible.



**We want relevant partners who can genuinely help us reach the right audiences.**



2. Partner Outreach



Our outreach will primarily be digital.



You will mainly work with:



*

* Affiliate platform messaging

* Website contact forms

* Professional social or creator platforms

* Other appropriate digital communication channels



Traditional cold calling is **not the main focus of this position**.



You should, however, be comfortable communicating professionally with potential partners when a conversation or call is appropriate.



Outreach should be personalized rather than mass-spam.



You will use prepared information, templates, AI-assisted research, and structured processes, while applying your own judgment to make communication relevant to each potential partner.



3. AI-Assisted Partner Research



Peak Media World uses AI to make repetitive research and administrative work more efficient.



AI may help us with:



* Finding potential partner websites and companies

* Creating initial prospect lists

* Researching companies and audiences

* Organizing contact information

* Identifying relevant affiliate programs

* Preparing outreach drafts

* Categorizing and prioritizing prospects

* Maintaining structured databases

* Supporting reporting and analysis



Your job is to **review, verify, prioritize, and act on the information**.



You should therefore be comfortable using AI tools and interested in learning how to use them effectively.



You do not need to be an AI or automation specialist.



 4. Affiliate Opportunities for MovePERMA



A second important part of the role is identifying **products, services, companies, and affiliate programs that are relevant to MovePERMA**.



MovePERMA is a knowledge brand covering topics related to sustainable systems, personal, professional, and economic development, and practical knowledge.



You will help us find suitable products and services that we may recommend through:



* Websites

* Articles

* Guides

* Books

* Other digital content

* Future MovePERMA projects



You will research:



* Suitable products and providers

* Affiliate programs

* Commission structures

* Program requirements

* Product quality and relevance

* Potential commercial value



**Quality, relevance, and trust are more important than simply finding products with high commissions.**



5. Affiliate Administration



Once partnerships are established, you will also help maintain the system.



This may include:



* Affiliate program information

* Partner records

* Affiliate links

* Commission information

* Tracking information

* Product and offer information

* Application status

* Partner communication

* Basic performance reporting

* Checking whether links, products, and programs are still active



We want these processes to become increasingly structured and automated over time.



What We Are Looking For



You should have:



* Experience in affiliate marketing, partnerships, online marketing, business development, sales, or a related area

* Strong research skills

* Good written English

* Strong organizational skills

* Good attention to detail

* The ability to identify commercially relevant opportunities

* Good communication and outreach skills

* The ability to work independently

* A structured and reliable working style

* A commercial mindset combined with good judgment



Experience with affiliate platforms, digital products, e-commerce, publishing, content marketing, influencer marketing, or online partnerships is an advantage.



Experience with AI tools is also an advantage.



What We Value



We are looking for someone who enjoys:



* Finding opportunities

* Researching companies and people

* Discovering potential partners

* Building professional relationships

* Organizing information

* Following up consistently

* Turning promising contacts into real partnerships



You should be comfortable working independently and taking ownership of your tasks.



We do not expect you to simply wait for a list of contacts and send hundreds of identical messages.



We want someone who can gradually learn to **identify good opportunities independently and build a systematic partner-acquisition process.**



Working Arrangement



* **Remote**

* **Part-time**

* Initially approximately **20 hours per week**

* Potential to increase to approximately **30 hours per week** as our partner network grows

* Flexible working hours

* Long-term collaboration possible

* **Planned start: October 2026**



Compensation



**$5–7 USD per hour**, depending on experience and qualifications.



About Peak Media World



Peak Media World is building a portfolio of digital content, knowledge products, websites, and thematic projects for international audiences.



We value:



**quality · reliability · clear processes · sustainable growth · long-term relationships**



We are building our business with a strong focus on **AI-supported workflows and automation**, while keeping human expertise where it creates real value.



How to Apply



Please include **“AFFILIATE”** in your application.



Please tell us briefly:



1. Your relevant experience

2. Your experience with affiliate marketing, partnerships, sales, or business development

3. Which affiliate platforms or tools you have worked with

4. Your experience with online research and partner outreach

5. Your experience using AI tools

6. Your availability

7. Your expected hourly rate

8. When you would be available to start



We are particularly interested in people who enjoy **research, finding opportunities, building relationships, and developing structured partnerships.**

title: L2 Technician – Microsoft 365 Focused

-Communicate with buyers, sellers, real estate agents, title/escrow companies, attorneys, lenders, vendors, and other parties as needed.

-Follow up consistently to ensure required documents and action items are completed on time.

-Assist with scheduling inspections, appointments, closings, and other transaction-related activities.

-Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, reminders, and follow-ups.

-Organize
s, documents, files, and company information.

-Assist with phone calls, correspondence, data entry, and administrative tasks.

-Keep track of priorities and outstanding action items.

-Anticipate needs and proactively follow up rather than waiting to be asked.

-Help improve administrative systems and processes as the company grows.

-Handle sensitive business and client information with professionalism and confidentiality.



What We're Looking For. The ideal candidate is:



Highly organized — you can manage multiple transactions, deadlines, and priorities without losing track of details.

title: Lead Generator – Real Estate Wholesaling (Remote)
description:
***Lead Generator – Real Estate Wholesaling (Remote)***



**Compensation:** $2 USD/hour starting base + commission + performance-based growth

 **Part-Time:** 4 hours/day · Monday–Friday · 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM U.S. Eastern (? 9:00 PM – 1:00 AM Manila)



 **Openings:** 2



We're a small, early-stage real estate wholesaling company building our team from the ground up, and we're looking for 2 Lead Generators to grow with us.



Our current focus is primarily vacant land in Massachusetts. Your role is to turn cold leads into real conversations, identify seller interest and motivation, gather key information, and hand qualified opportunities to our Acquisition Manager.



We're looking for people who communicate naturally, listen well, ask the right questions, and handle rejection professionally — not just read from a script.





**What You'll Do**



- Make outbound calls to property owners from provided lead lists

- Start natural conversations and identify seller interest and motivation

- Ask basic qualifying questions about the property and seller situation

- Handle common objections professionally

- Follow up with interested or potentially interested leads

- Send SMS or
 outreach when assigned

- Keep accurate notes, lead statuses, and follow-up dates

- Hand qualified opportunities to the Acquisition Manager / Closer

- Follow our calling process and do-not-contact requirements



**What We're Looking For**



- Strong spoken and written English

- Comfortable speaking with U.S. property owners

- Previous outbound calling, lead generation, appointment setting, or sales experience preferred

- Able to carry a natural conversation instead of relying completely on a script

- Comfortable handling objections and rejection professionally

- Able to recognize when a seller may still be open to conversation after an initial objection

- Consistent with follow-up

- Organized with lead notes and updates

- Reliable, accountable, and able to work independently

- Comfortable learning and using a dialer and lead tracking system/CRM

- Comfortable working with a small and growing team

- Stable internet connection, computer, and headset



**Compensation & Growth**



Starting base rate: $2 USD/hour for scheduled working hours. 

We’re a small, early-stage company, and we want to be transparent about the starting compensation. The $2/hour rate is the guaranteed starting base, with the opportunity to earn additional income through commission on eligible successfully closed deals and to qualify for performance-based hourly increases as the company grows.





**Commission:**



- 4% of the defined eligible wholesale fee/commission from successfully closed deals generated from your leads

- 4.5% at 3–4 qualifying closed deals per month

- 5% at 5+ qualifying closed deals per month



This example is for illustration only and does not guarantee any specific earnings: 

If an eligible closed deal produces a $10,000 wholesale fee, a 4% commission would equal $400. Specific lead attribution, deal eligibility, and commission payment rules will be outlined in the compensation plan.



Strong performers who consistently generate qualified opportunities and demonstrate reliability may be considered for higher pay and advancement into Senior Lead Generator, Team Lead, or Acquisitions roles. We want early team members to grow with the company as we expand.



**How to Apply**



Please send:

1. Your updated résumé  (A link to your updated résumé (please make sure viewing access is enabled)

2. The CRMs, dialers, or lead-generation tools you've used

3. Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time (and your local time zone)

4. A link to a  60–90 second voice recording introducing yourself, your relevant calling / sales / real estate experience, and why you'd be comfortable speaking with U.S. property owners



Please also answer this one question in writing:



*A property owner tells you, "I'm not interested," but keeps talking with you. What would you do next, and why?*



We're interested in how you communicate, listen, and think — not just what's written on your résumé.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
About Us

At ProfitWorks, we genuinely believe that our people are the heart of everything we do. We’ve focused on building a workplace that feels less like a corporate machine and more like a community, creating a space where you’re supported, heard, and actually excited to grow. We aren't big on empty promises and prefer to let our history speak for itself. We’re incredibly proud that two of our tea
mbers have been with our founder for 13 years, while many others are nearing their 6th anniversary. It’s a steady, welcoming environment where people don’t just pass through, they stay and thrive.



At ProfitWorks, we make sure our contractors can focus on what they do best by providing the security, support, and balance you deserve. To back that up, we offer a generous package including 80–120 hours of PTO, 7 paid holidays, 13th-month payroll, and life insurance up to ?100,000. Your well-being is a top priority, so we cover a paid Philippine HMO & Dental plan, your Annual Physical Exam (APE), mental health consultation reimbursements (up to ?20,000/year), and SSS, PhilHealth, or Pag-IBIG reimbursements.



Beyond financial and health security, we invest directly in your career through a comprehensive, fully compensated onboarding program, clear performance goals with advancement compensation, and opportunities for advancement after proof of mastery. If you’re looking for a team that prioritizes real connections, long-term stability, and continuous support, we’d love to hear from you. Come say hi and see if ProfitWorks is the right fit for you!



Role Overview



The Client Success Manager (CSM) serves as a vital strategic pillar bridging client relationship management, end-to-end talent acquisition, and operational service delivery. Working in close alignment with the CEO, the CSM translates company vision into actionable operational and growth strategies. The CSM takes full accountability for managing the entire client lifecycle—from identifying high-value prospects, conducting initial discovery calls, and crafting tailored proposals, to overseeing offshore candidate screening, recruitment, and seamless onboarding.  



Beyond initial integration, the CSM acts as the primary client liaison, proactively managing client concerns, leading cross-functional teams (including Recruitment, HR, and Operations), and enforcing service quality through continuous performance monitoring, daily End-of-Shift reporting, and KPI tracking. By combining strategic workforce planning with hands-on process optimization, the CSM ensures exceptional service delivery, drives long-term client retention, and unlocks sustainable account growth across ProfitWorks' accounting and staffing solutions. 





Key Responsibilities



1. Client Engagement, Relationship & Account Growth

Lead discovery calls and business development conversations with prospects to understand hiring, accounting, and operational requirements.

Manage the full client journey, acting as the primary point of contact for all client inquiries, feedback, and strategic account planning.

Foster long-term relationships and drive client retention through proactive communication, regular workforce alignment, and exceptional service delivery.

Support proposal development, agreement management, and account expansion opportunities with existing U.S. clients.



2. End-to-End Talent Acquisition & Onboarding

Partner directly with clients to define staffing needs, draft custom job profiles, and establish recruitment timelines.

Oversee recruitment and candidate screening workflows alongside internal sourcing teams to match top-tier offshore talent to client requirements.

Facilitate seamless onboarding, system integration, and task handoffs between clients and placed offshore contractors.



3. Performance Monitoring, Quality Assurance & Operations

Establish, track, and analyze client and team KPIs, daily reports, and End-of-Shift summaries to evaluate performance.

Proactively identify operational bottlenecks, performance gaps, or service friction points, delivering data-driven solutions and process improvements.

Utilize project management tools (e.g., ClickUp, HubStaff, Time Doctor) to manage workload distribution, task execution, and team productivity.



4. Cross-Functional Team Leadership & Coordination

Collaborate closely across internal units—including Recruitment, HR, Operations, and Virtual Support teams—to ensure complete alignment with client expectations.

Lead internal syncs and alignment meetings to streamline communication, share feedback, and resolve challenges.

Provide coaching, support, and guidance to tea
mbers to maintain high service quality and continuous professional growth.





What We’re Looking For



Experience & Expertise

Experience: 3–5+ years in Account Management, Client Success, Operations Management, or offshore talent delivery.

U.S. Market Experience: Demonstrated background working directly with U.S.-based business owners, executives, or offshore staffing models.

Domain Context: Prior exposure to accounting/finance, construction, home services, mortgage, or non-tech client services is a strong advantage.



Skills & Tool Proficiency



Project & Ops Management: Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Time Doctor, Google Workspace, and MS Office.

Recruitment & Sourcing: Solid grasp of end-to-end recruitment pipelines, candidate screening, and workforce planning.

Communication: Superior written and verbal English communication skills, with confidence leading client presentations and discovery calls.

Strategic & Critical Thinking: Able to analyze complex client requirements, design scalable operational frameworks, and resolve problems independently.



Why You Will Love Working Here

Supportive Team & Mentorship: Work alongside a collaborative, growth-oriented team with clear guidance from implementation leadership.

Continuous Learning: Deepen your expertise daily with cutting-edge AI tools, automation platforms, and complex integration projects.

Career Growth: Real opportunity to progressively step into larger implementation, governance, and systems responsibilities over time.

Flexible Remote Work: 100% remote setup within a highly collaborative US-Philippines hybrid working environment.

Real Impact: Your work directly dictates how efficiently and successfully our business scales.



Perks: 

80-120 Hours of PTO 

 7 Paid Holidays 

 13th Month Payroll 

 Life insurance of up to Php100,000

 Paid Philippine HMO & Dental plan 

 Paid Annual Physical Exam (APE)

 Mental Health Consultation Reimbursement up to ?20,000/year (capped at ?2,000 per session for up to 10 sessions)

 Social Security System Reimbursement

 PhilHealth or PagIbig Reimbursement

Comprehensive, fully compensated onboarding program 

Advancement after Proof of Mastery 

Performance Goals with advancement compensation 





We can’t wait to meet you and discover the value you’ll bring to our team! If this sounds like a role you’re excited about, apply now and help us continue building a workplace we all love.

title: Bookkeeper
description:
About SPS West



SPS West is a Calgary-based industrial manufacturing and engineered solutions company serving energy, industrial, utility, and infrastructure customers across Western Canada.



Operating from our approximately 45,000 sq. ft. ISO 9001 and ISO 14001-certified facility, we bring together technical product expertise, advanced manufacturing, fabrication, assembly, project support, and field services under one roof.



Our capabilities include custom metal fabrication, CNC laser cutting and forming, welding, powder coating, engineered process equipment and skids, Enviro-Box® containment systems, plastic-lined piping, industrial safety systems, instrumentation, and specialized technical services. Through FlowTech Meter Services, we also provide meter proving, calibration, repair, and preventative maintenance services.



We continue to invest in automation, technology, proprietary products, and talented people as we grow. Our goal is straightforward: reduce complexity for our customers, improve quality, shorten lead times, and build practical solutions that perform in the field.



At SPS West, we do things differently.



The Opportunity



We are looking for a detail-oriented and organized Part-Time Bookkeeper to support the day-to-day accounting activities of our business.



The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, supporting Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable activities, performing reconciliations, and helping ensure our accounting information accurately reflects business activity.



This role is well suited to someone who is proactive, dependable, comfortable working independently, and takes ownership of getting the details right.



Key Responsibilities

Record and maintain daily financial transactions.

Manage Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) processes.

Process vendor invoices, ensuring accuracy, appropriate approvals, and proper coding.

Prepare vendor payments and maintain accurate expense records.

Assist with cash flow tracking and payment planning.

Reconcile vendor statements and promptly investigate and resolve discrepancies.

Perform monthly reconciliations of bank accounts, credit cards, and other financial accounts.

Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies to ensure financial records accurately reflect business activity.

Assist with month-end and year-end closing activities.

Maintain organized financial records and supporting documentation.

Support continuous improvement of bookkeeping and accounting processes.

Communicate clearly and proactively when issues, discrepancies, or questions arise, rather than allowing items to remain unresolved.

Qualifications

Diploma or certificate in Bookkeeping, Accounting, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Candidates working toward a professional accounting designation are encouraged to apply.

Strong understanding of bookkeeping principles and general accounting practices.

Experience with Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, account reconciliations, and financial recordkeeping.

Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to manage priorities and work independently in a remote environment.

High level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential financial information.

Technology



Experience with, or a willingness to learn:



Zoho Books

Microsoft Excel

Microsoft Office / Microsoft 365



Experience with other accounting, ERP, or business management systems would be considered an asset.



What We’re Looking For



The ideal candidate is someone who:



Takes ownership of their work and follows through on commitments.

Is highly organized, dependable, and consistent.

Enjoys identifying discrepancies and solving problems.

Looks for practical ways to improve processes.

Works effectively with limited supervision.

Communicates clearly and proactively when issues or questions arise.

Understands the importance of accuracy, confidentiality, and professionalism.



Qualities Needed To Be Successful



Skills are something that can be learned and perfected over time. There are 3 key qualities that we are looking for:

Integrity, Commitment and Desire to Learn.



Integrity. You are a good fit if you can be honest with your fellow team members. Open communication and honesty are paramount to everyone on the team. If you aren't able to hit a deadline or made a mistake, be upfront about it, we are all human after all and we have a very supportive environment.



Commitment. We are looking for someone who is looking for a long term relationship. If you're just looking for a few months of work, this is definitely not for you.



Desire to Learn. We are a small team, but growing fast. We want people who are open to learning new skills and taking on new projects. If you're not excited about improving your skills and trying new things; again, this is likely not for you.



However, if this does sounds like you, please apply below and I will personally read your application, samples of any work you would like to submit and answer any questions you may have (seriously, the more questions the better!). In your proposal please start the first line with ‘Focused’ so that I know you actually read the complete job description.



We offer a competitive salary as well as opportunities for growth within the company. If you are a self-starter with a passion for accounting/bookkeeping and a desire to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment that values integrity, appreciation, communication, positivity, and brightness, please apply with your resume and cover letter. We look forward to hearing from you!



Thank you for your time!

title: Short-Form Sports Video Editor — Remote, Seasonal
description:
September 2026 – Early February 2027 | Part-Time | Remote



I am looking for a fast, reliable video editor to join me for the upcoming American football season and edit short-form sports content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and other social platforms.



This is a seasonal position running from September through early February with the potential for future work.



What You'll Be Editing:



The majority of the content will be relatively straightforward talking-head sports videos.



I will film and provide the raw footage. Your responsibility will be to turn that footage into polished, engaging short-form content that is ready to post.



Typical edits may include:



* Cutting pauses, mistakes, and unnecessary footage

* Adding dynamic captions/subtitles

* Adding relevant photos, graphics, screenshots, statistics, scores, headlines, or other supporting visuals

* Adding zooms, transitions, and other simple effects where appropriate

* Adding background music or sound effects when appropriate

* Formatting videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

* Maintaining a consistent editing style across my content

* Exporting and returning final videos quickly



The goal is clean, fast-paced sports content — not excessive or distracting editing.



Turnaround Time Is Extremely Important:



This position requires someone who can work quickly.



For most assignments, I need completed edits returned within approximately 2 hours of receiving the raw footage.



Because much of my content covers current sports news and events, videos often lose value if they are not posted quickly.



Please do not apply if you regularly need 24–48 hours to complete short-form edits.



Required Availability



I am located in the Eastern Time Zone in the United States.



You must generally be available for a minimum 4-hour editing window during my evening hours, particularly approximately:



**Weekdays: 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM Eastern Time**



BUT, if you are able to finish videos faster than 4 hours, then you are done as soon as you finish. 4 hours is the maximum time per day, realistically it is around 2 hours. 



There will also be an important Sunday requirement during football season.



**Sundays: Availability beginning around 1:00 PM Eastern Time**



Sunday availability is particularly important because content may need to be produced quickly while NFL games are taking place.



Your schedule does not need to consist of constant editing for the entire availability window. However, I need you to be reachable and prepared to begin an edit quickly when footage is sent.



Ideal Candidate:



You are a strong fit if you:



* Have experience editing TikTok, Reels, Shorts, or similar vertical content

* Are extremely reliable

* Can consistently meet 1–2 hour turnaround requirements

* Have excellent written English

* Understand American social media styles and trends

* Have a strong internet connection

* Communicate quickly and clearly

* Are comfortable working independently

* Pay close attention to spelling, names, statistics, and captions

* Can follow an established editing style instead of reinventing the format for every video

* Are comfortable with recurring work over an entire sports season



**Knowledge of American football/NFL is a major advantage.**



You do not need to be an NFL expert, but understanding teams, players, scores, terminology, and basic football concepts will make this job significantly easier.



Software



Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut Desktop, DaVinci Resolve, or similar professional editing software is acceptable.



Please tell me which editing software you use in your application.



To Apply:



Please include:



1. A brief introduction

2. Your location and time zone

3. Your hourly rate

4. The editing software you use

5. 2–4 examples of short-form videos you have personally edited

6. Whether you follow or understand the NFL/American football

7. Confirmation that you can regularly meet a **2-hour turnaround time**

8. Confirmation that you can accommodate the weekday and Sunday availability requirements listed above



**Please begin your application with the word "TOUCHDOWN" so I know you read the entire job description.**



Applicants who do not include relevant short-form editing examples will not be considered.

title: 3D Rendering / SketchUp Designer for Custom Sauna Company
description:
Hours:

Part-time, project-based to start. Likely 5 to 10 hours per week initially, with room to grow.



About us:

Swedberg Sauna Co. is a custom sauna design and construction company based in Atlanta, Georgia. We design premium indoor and outdoor saunas for residential and commercial clients.



We are looking for a reliable 3D designer who can take measurements, photos, sketches, and written specifications from our client consultations and turn them into attractive, accurate renderings that help clients visualize their future sauna.



This is not primarily an architecture or engineering role. These renderings will be used during the sales and design process, so accuracy, speed, and visual presentation are more important than producing construction documents.



What you will do

Build simple, accurate sauna models from dimensions and written instructions

Create attractive exterior and interior renderings

Create simple top-down or 2D layouts when requested

Accurately represent:

room dimensions

doors

windows

glass walls

benches

heaters

lighting

roof shape

interior and exterior wood finishes

Make revisions based on feedback

Eventually maintain a library of reusable Swedberg Sauna Co. components to make future projects faster

Typical project



You may receive something like:



Outdoor sauna. 90 inches wide x 84 inches deep x 96 inches tall. Full glass front with door on right. Upper bench along rear and left wall. Lower bench below. Heater front left. Horizontal cypress exterior. Cypress interior. Black trim and black shed roof. Photos of the client's yard attached.



You would turn that into a clean visualization that we can send to the customer with their proposal.



Software



Experience with SketchUp is strongly preferred.



Rendering software could include:



Enscape

D5 Render

Twinmotion

Lumion

V-Ray

similar software



Experience with AI rendering tools is a plus, but we do not want someone relying solely on generative AI. Dimensions and layout must remain accurate.



What we're looking for



The ideal person:



follows detailed instructions carefully

understands measurements and spatial relationships

notices when something doesn't make sense

communicates clearly in English

can usually turn around a project within 24 hours

is comfortable receiving revisions

works independently

has strong attention to detail



Experience with saunas is not required. We can teach you our sauna design standards.



Very important



Accuracy matters more than artistic creativity.



For example, if our instructions say:



window is 6 feet wide

door is on the right

heater is on the left

bench is 24 inches deep



those elements cannot move or change simply because another arrangement looks better.



To apply



Please send:



A short introduction

Your hourly rate

Your availability and usual working hours

Examples of SketchUp or architectural rendering work

Which modeling/rendering programs you use

Approximately how long you think a simple room like the example above would take you to model and render



Please include the words “SAUNA DESIGN” at the beginning of your application so I know you read the entire posting.



Selected applicants will be offered a paid test project before we choose someone for ongoing work.

title: GoHighLevel Expert — Lead Source Attribution, Pipelines & Zapier Automations (Project to Start)
description:
We are a fast-growing education/coaching company generating leads from three separate channels — YouTube, organic short-form content, and paid ads — all funneling into ONE GoHighLevel account.



Right now, everything lands in the same place and we cannot tell where a lead actually came from. That is costing us money. We do not know which channel is producing booked calls, and we cannot make confident decisions on where to spend.



We need a GoHighLevel expert to fix that.



This is a build-and-fix project. If you do great work, we will move you to a consistent weekly retainer for ongoing management.



What You Will Actually Do

Lead Source Attribution (the main job)

Set up clean, reliable tracking so every single lead entering GHL is tagged with its true source: YouTube, organic content, or paid ads — and ideally down to the specific video, post, or ad campaign/ad set/ad.

Implement UTM parameter capture, custom fields, hidden form fields, and source tags that actually persist through the funnel.

Make sure attribution survives across opt-in ? booking ? show ? close, not just at the point of opt-in.

Pipeline Organization

Audit and rebuild our pipelines and stages so they reflect how the business actually runs.

Make sure stage movement is automated where it should be, and clean where it should be manual.

Set up filtering and views so we can look at any pipeline stage and instantly see the source breakdown.

Automation Audit & Repair

Review every existing workflow, trigger, and automation in the account.

Find what is broken, duplicated, misfiring, or double-sending. Fix it.

Build or repair automations for follow-up, booking reminders, no-show recovery, and tagging.

Zapier / Integrations

Audit existing Zaps, clean up what is redundant, and build what is missing.

Connect GHL cleanly with our other tools so data flows correctly and nothing gets lost or duplicated.

Reporting & Documentation

Deliver a simple dashboard or reporting view where we can see leads, bookings, and closes by source.

Document what you built in plain English so our team can maintain it.

Who We Are Looking For

A real GHL expert. Not someone learning on our account. You have built attribution and pipeline systems inside GoHighLevel before, more than once.

Someone who does not need to be told what to do. We will give you access and context. You should be able to audit the account, identify the problems, propose the fix, and execute it. If you need step-by-step instructions for everything, this is not the role.

Strong Zapier skills. Multi-step Zaps, filters, formatters, webhooks, error handling.

Excellent spoken and written English. You will be on calls with us. You need to explain technical things clearly and quickly.

Someone who takes ownership. If something is broken, you flag it. If you are stuck, you say so early. You do not disappear.

Hard workers only. We move fast and we pay well for people who deliver. We have no patience for missed deadlines, ghosting, or work that has to be redone.

Required Experience

Minimum 2 years hands-on inside GoHighLevel (agency, sub-account, or SaaS mode)

Proven experience setting up lead source attribution and UTM tracking

Zapier (or 
) at an advanced level

Experience with paid ad tracking — Meta Pixel/CAPI, Google/YouTube tracking, conversion events

Familiarity with calendars, forms, surveys, funnels, and workflows inside GHL

Comfortable with webhooks, custom values, and custom fields

Nice To Have

Experience in the coaching / info-product / high-ticket space

Experience with call booking funnels and setter/closer pipelines

Basic reporting or dashboard build experience (GHL dashboards, Looker Studio, Sheets)

Compensation

One-time setup fee for this initial project — competitive, based on experience. Tell us your number and why.

If standards are met, we move to a consistent weekly rate for ongoing work. This is a real long-term opportunity, not a one-off.

HOW TO APPLY — READ CAREFULLY



Applications that do not follow these instructions will be deleted without review. This is our first test.



1. Put "GHL ATTRIBUTION — [YOUR FIRST NAME]" in the subject line.



2. Record a Loom video (3–5 minutes max) where you:



Introduce yourself

Screen-share an actual GoHighLevel account you have built or managed (blur/hide client info if needed)

Walk us through a lead source attribution setup you personally built and explain how it works



3. Answer these four questions in writing:



How would you set up GHL so we can tell the difference between a lead from a specific YouTube video vs. a specific Meta ad? Be specific about the mechanics.

What is the most common reason lead source attribution breaks inside GoHighLevel, and how do you prevent it?

Describe the messiest GHL account you have ever inherited and what you did to fix it.

What is your one-time fee for the project described above, and roughly how long will it take you?



4. Include your available start date and your working hours in EST.



We review applications daily and will reply to serious candidates within 48 hours.

title: META CAMPAIGN SETUP SPECIALIST – DROPSHIPPING
description:
# META CAMPAIGN SETUP SPECIALIST – DROPSHIPPING



**Starting Salary: $600 USD/month**

**Salary Increase After 3 Months Based on Performance**

**Full-Time | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM**



## ABOUT US



We are a fast-growing **pure dropshipping company** specializing in men's products.



Our Product Team creates approximately **40 new product pages every week**. Once a product is ready, it is sent to our Meta Ads team.



Your job is to take those products and turn them into **complete Meta advertising campaigns ready to launch.**



You will work with approximately **40 products every week.**



---



# YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



For each product, you will:



* Open and understand the Shopify product page.

* Download the product images.

* Understand the product and its potential customer.

* Research relevant Meta interests and audiences.

* Build the campaign according to our SOPs.

* Set up the campaign, ad set, targeting, budget, creatives, URL, Pixel, and other required settings.

* Double-check everything before submitting the campaign.

* Keep your work organized and completed on time.

* Communicate quickly if you find a problem or something that needs attention.



The goal is simple:



**Build approximately 40 accurate Meta campaigns every week.**



---



# YOU NEED TO UNDERSTAND META ADS



This is not a beginner position.



You should already be comfortable using:



* Meta Ads Manager

* Meta Business Manager

* Campaigns, Ad Sets, and Ads

* ABO and CBO

* Meta Pixel

*
 Pages

* Instagram accounts

* Audiences and interests

* Budgets and placements

* Ad creatives

* Basic campaign structures



You should also understand that **Meta changes constantly** and be willing to keep learning.



---



# INTEREST & AUDIENCE RESEARCH



You will not simply copy the first interest you find.



For every product, you should think about:



**What is the product?**

**Who would buy it?**

**What interests would that person have?**

**What audiences could we test?**



You will follow our SOPs, but we also want someone who can think independently and bring new ideas when they find better targeting opportunities.



---



# REQUIREMENTS



* **2+ years of hands-on Meta Ads experience** (3+ preferred)

* Experience creating Meta campaigns yourself

* Experience with Meta Ads Manager

* Experience with Meta Business Manager

* Experience with e-commerce or dropshipping

* Understanding of Meta targeting and interests

* Understanding of ABO and CBO

* Basic understanding of Meta Pixel and tracking

* Strong attention to detail

* Excellent English

* Good organizational skills

* Ability to work quickly and accurately

* Ability to follow SOPs

* Willingness to learn and adapt



**If you have never personally created Meta campaigns, please do not apply.**



---



# WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We want someone who is:



**Fast** – You can handle high-volume work.



**Accurate** – You check your work before submitting it.



**Proactive** – You don't wait for someone to tell you everything.



**Organized** – You can manage approximately 40 products every week.



**Curious** – You want to understand why things work.



**Ambitious** – You want to improve your skills and earn more over time.



**Reliable** – We can trust you with important work and real advertising budgets.



---



# GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



The starting salary is **$600 USD/month**.



After 3 months, your performance will be reviewed and your salary can be increased.



Future increases can depend on:



* Accuracy

* Speed

* Reliability

* Initiative

* Knowledge

* Improvement

* Additional responsibilities

* Contribution to the team



We want people who grow with the company.



If you become more skilled and more valuable, **your compensation can grow with you.**



This is a **long-term position**.



---



# EQUIPMENT



You must have:



* Reliable computer (**MacBook strongly preferred**)

* Smartphone

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Quiet workspace

* Ability to work Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM



---



# PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



* You have never created Meta campaigns.

* You have no real Meta Ads experience.

* You are looking for beginner training.

* You don't understand Meta Ads Manager.

* You don't know how to research audiences and interests.

* You are not comfortable with repetitive, high-volume work.

* You regularly make avoidable mistakes.

* You need someone to guide you through every step.

* You are not interested in learning.

* You are looking for a short-term job.



---



# HOW TO APPLY



Use the subject:



**META CAMPAIGN SETUP – [Your Name]**



Please answer all questions.



### 1. EXPERIENCE



How many years of hands-on Meta Ads experience do you have?



Approximately how many campaigns have you personally created?



What types of products or businesses have you worked with?



### 2. YOUR PROCESS



You receive a Shopify product link.



Explain the steps you would take from opening the product page until the Meta campaign is completely ready to launch.



### 3. AUDIENCE RESEARCH



We give you a men's clothing product.



How would you d
 which Meta interests and audiences to test?



### 4. QUALITY CONTROL



Before submitting a campaign, what are the most important things you check?



### 5. HIGH-VOLUME WORK



You receive **40 products for the week**.



How would you organize your work to finish all 40 campaigns on time while avoiding mistakes?



### 6. EXPERIENCE



Tell us about one time you found a better targeting idea, workflow, or solution without being asked to do it.

What is one recent Meta Ads change or update that you know about?



### 8. FUTURE



Where do you see yourself in the next 3–5 years?



What do you want to become better at, and what would make you want to stay with a company long-term?



---



## THE RIGHT PERSON CAN GROW WITH US



You may start by building campaigns.



But if you become excellent at your job, you can take on more responsibility, help improve our systems, help train others, and continue growing within the company.



**If you already know Meta Ads, work quickly, pay close attention to details, and want to build a long-term career with a growing company, we want to hear from you.**

title: Technical Director - Scientific/Chemical Software
description:
About Our Company



We are a life-sciences software company, founded in 2000, that builds and supports chemical inventory, laboratory safety, and R&D-workflow applications for global pharmaceutical and biotech customers. Our flagship platforms and companion products work together to give bench scientists and lab operations teams fast, compliant access to chemical inventory. Adjacent products that manage synthesis outsourcing workflow and instrument tracking extend our footprint deeper into pharma R&D operations.



We are in the middle of modernizing our technology: moving from Oracle, IIS, 
 Framework/WebForms and onto PostgreSQL, Node.js (Fastify), React, React Native, and Linux (RHEL) — while continuing to support mission-critical legacy installations our customers depend on today. All of our development, production, and customer-hosted environments run in our own AWS virtual private cloud, including a single-tenant hosted (SaaS) offering for customers who access our products remotely rather than on-premises, some using their own Okta identity provider for single sign-on. Our applications' chemistry capabilities currently run on the Chemaxon (now Certara) JChem cartridge and Marvin/ChemDraw editors; we are actively working to both migrate to Chemaxon's newer Choral platform and open up a path to open-source cheminformatics (such as RDKit) and open-source molecular editors.



The Role



The Technical Director will directly manage our engineering team's day-to-day development work — d
 what gets built and how, reviewing and guiding the team's technical output, and ensuring engineering effort stays aligned with architecture strategy and business priority.



Presently, our founders and a small group of senior engineers share responsibility for architecture decisions, vendor and licensing management, and senior technical relationships with our largest customers — alongside a small team that is simultaneously maintaining a large, mission-critical legacy 
 estate and building out our open-source stack. We are looking for a Technical Director to take direct, consolidated ownership of the entire technical landscape: setting and executing architecture strategy, leading our stack modernization and cheminformatics transition, growing and mentoring the engineering team, and representing the company credibly in technical conversations with large enterprise customers and their IT organizations.



Titles can be a little misleading at a company our size: this is a deeply hands-on, technical role. Initially, you will personally perform a myriad of technical work — troubleshooting production issues, running builds, and executing deployments — while building genuine expertise across as much of our technical landscape as possible, quickly coming up to speed in areas outside your current experience, and working alongside the team with genuine enthusiasm. As the team and company grow, this role will naturally evolve toward a more traditional director-level scope, but the immediate need is for a hands-on technical owner.



This role reports directly to the founders and will be the senior-most technical authority in the company. You will inherit a real, partially-executed modernization strategy — including a working reference architecture (a Fastify/PostgreSQL/React/RHEL pattern already proven on an existing product) — and a mandate to extend it deliberately across the rest of the portfolio rather than one-off improvisation.



This role is empowered to bring in, where needed, specialized contractor support — whether in-house or external — for specific, highly technical needs you are not yet able to handle independently. You are not expected to initially be the expert in everything, but any outside expertise you engage must be closely managed, with the resulting procedures and protocols thoroughly documented and internalized by the team. The goal is always to add lasting value to the company's internal expertise and remove ongoing dependency on external resources.



Ownership



Architecture & modernization strategy



- Own the technical roadmap for migrating our applications from Oracle, IIS, 
 Framework onto PostgreSQL, Node.js/Fastify, React, React Native, and Linux (RHEL) — extending the pattern already established on one application to our flagship product lines.

- D
, case by case, when a product should be rebuilt vs. incrementally modernized vs. maintained as-is, and make that case to the founders and, where relevant, to customers.

- Establish and enforce formalized technical leadership and engineering standards (code review, testing, deployment, documentation) across the team.



Team leadership



- Directly manage and direct the engineering team's day-to-day development work — assigning and prioritizing technical tasks, reviewing code and technical output, and unblocking technical problems as they arise.

- Grow engineering capability and reduce single-point-of-failure risk.

- Mentor and manage a distributed team spanning 
/Oracle maintenance and open-source full-stack platform development; hire as the team grows.

- Work closely with the Senior Project Manager to translate technical priorities into a tracked delivery plan, providing the technical judgment needed for realistic sequencing and timeline commitments.

- Engage specialty contractors or consultants — in-house or external — for specific, highly technical needs, and ensure the resulting procedures and protocols are internalized and documented by the core team.



Cloud infrastructure management



- Own our AWS-hosted infrastructure end to end — virtual private cloud and network design, compute and database provisioning, security groups, backup and disaster-recovery policy, and cost management — across development, production, and customer-hosted environments.

- Manage our single-tenant, hosted (SaaS) deployment model for customers who access our products remotely rather than on-premises, including provisioning, certificate and DNS lifecycle management, identity-provider (e.g., Okta SAML) integration, and u
 commitments.

- Modernize infrastructure operations that are currently manual and concentrated in a single administrator — moving toward infrastructure-as-code, automated certificate and secrets management, and clearer environment isolation and access control.



Cheminformatics technology strategy



- Lead migration from Chemaxon's legacy JChem Oracle cartridge and MarvinJS editor to the newer Choral cartridge and next-generation Marvin — including any associated backend rendering-logic, not just the front-end editor updates.

- Design and deliver a supported open-source cheminformatics alternative built on chosen and identified open-source platforms, for example, RDKit, and extend our applications' existing pluggable structure-editor architecture to a fully open-source alternative for customers.

- Coordinate Chemaxon/Certara vendor management as needed, with the goal of owning the technical and commercial aspects of this relationship.



Customer & vendor technical engagement



- Serve as the company's senior technical point of contact for enterprise customers' IT and security organizations — including navigating large-company processes like ServiceNow, Jira, and API-gateway governance (e.g., integrating with customer procurement platforms via exposed APIs or managed gateways such as MuleSoft) — where progress often depends more on stakeholder navigation than raw engineering effort.

- Represent the company in technical evaluations with prospective new teams inside existing accounts (e.g., an active evaluation by a customer's European R&D group considering one of our products as a replacement for an in-house procurement/inventory system).



Security & documentation governance



- Establish credential-management and secrets-handling practices across the company's technical estate, and drive remediation of any outstanding cloud security findings (e.g., unresolved monitoring alerts, overly broad network access).

- Bring rigorous, reproducible engineering and architecture documentation practices — our enterprise customers require vendor continuity and documentation sufficiency for a successor team, and this should be treated as a competitive and contractual asset, not overhead.



Legacy system stewardship



- Ensure our large legacy 
 Framework/WebForms codebases remain stable, secure, and supportable for customers who are not yet ready to move to the new open-source stack.



What We Are Looking For



Required



- Significant professional software engineering experience — 10+ years is typical, but exceptional candidates with less experience who demonstrate strong architecture and technical leadership ability are encouraged to apply — including experience in a technical leadership, architecture, or engineering-management role.

- Genuine enthusiasm for hands-on execution — writing code, troubleshooting production issues, running builds, and executing deployments — not just directing others. At our current size, this is much of the job day to day; the role is expected to evolve toward a more traditional director scope as the team grows.

- Direct, hands-on experience leading a legacy-to-open-source technology migration — ideally something structurally similar to ours: Oracle ? PostgreSQL, .NET Framework ? Node.js/React, and/or Windows/IIS ? Linux.

- Working proficiency with our target stack: Node.js/TypeScript, an open-source web framework (Fastify or similar), React, PostgreSQL, and Linux server administration (RHEL or another enterprise Linux distribution).

- Experience configuring nginx (or equivalent) as a reverse proxy for Node.js APIs, and running Node services in production with a process manager such as pm2 (cluster mode, log management, zero-downtime deploys).

- Hands-on experience managing AWS (or comparable cloud provider) infrastructure — VPC and network design, compute and database provisioning, security groups, backup/DR, and cost management — including experience modernizing manually-provisioned environments toward infrastructure-as-code and automated certificate/secrets management.

- Experience with enterprise authentication and identity patterns — LDAP/Active Directory integration, SAML-based SSO (e.g., Okta) — and, ideally, integrating with large-enterprise API platforms (API gateways such as MuleSoft, or comparable).

- Familiarity with zero-trust or identity-based access architectures (e.g., Cloudflare Access, Citrix Secure Private Access, or comparable) as an alternative to traditional VPN access — an active area of technical investigation for us today.

- A track record of introducing and maintaining engineering discipline — documentation, code review, secure credential handling.

- Strong stakeholder-management instincts: comfortable being the technical face of a small vendor inside a large enterprise customer's IT organization, including working through formal ticketing/security-review processes.



Strongly preferred — cheminformatics / chemistry domain background



- Direct experience with cheminformatics toolkits or platforms — RDKit, ChemAxon/JChem/Marvin, Open Babel, or similar — including molecular structure representation (SMILES, MolBlock/SDF) and structure/substructure search.

- A background in chemistry, chemical engineering, or a related scientific discipline, or substantial hands-on experience building software for pharmaceutical/biotech R&D, laboratory operations, or EH&S compliance.



For exceptional candidates without a chemistry background



We will consider candidates without direct cheminformatics or chemistry experience if they bring exceptionally strong architecture and technical leadership credentials, a genuine, demonstrable interest in scientific and laboratory software, and a clear willingness to build deep domain expertise on the job. This is a real trade-off we are open to making for the right person.



Nice to have



- Familiarity with legacy ASP.NET WebForms / IIS / .NET Framework environments, useful for the legacy-stewardship portion of this role.

- React Native or other mobile app development experience.

- AWS certification (e.g., Solutions Architect) or equivalent demonstrated cloud infrastructure expertise.

- Comfort working with vendor hardware SDKs and support escalations (e.g., barcode/RFID scanners, label printers) — relevant to our mobile inventory-scanning products, though not a specialized requirement.

- Experience with Apple's enterprise app-distribution stack (Apple Developer Enterprise/Business Manager, Volume Purchase Program, code signing) and mobile device management platforms (Microsoft Intune or comparable) — we actively manage several iOS applications through a large enterprise customer's MDM environment.

- Experience serving regulated life-sciences or other compliance-heavy enterprise customers (e.g., EH&S, DEA-controlled-substance handling, GxP-adjacent environments).

- Prior experience at a small (sub-20-person) software company, comfortable wearing multiple hats and operating with limited dedicated support functions.



IMPORTANT: Please provide your resume and response as a PDF attachment to your response.

title: Client Success Manager – $2,000 p/m + Uncapped Commission
description:

This is a client leadership role, not just support.

This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.

title: Architectural Designer
description:
A boutique United States architecture firm specializing in high end custom homes, commercial development, adaptive reuse, and interior projects is seeking an experienced Architectural Designer based in the Philippines.

The firm’s approach emphasizes thoughtful design, contextual sensitivity, material quality, sustainability, and the careful integration of design with construction.

The company’s identity and project information will be disclosed to qualified candidates during the interview process.



Position Summary

The Architectural Designer will work remotely with the Principal Architect and project consultants to develop design concepts, prepare architectural drawings, produce construction documents, coordinate project information, and support projects from initial design through construction.

This position requires more than software proficiency. The successful candidate must understand architectural documentation, recognize coordination issues, follow design direction accurately, manage deadlines, and communicate proactively. Candidates must be comfortable working independently in a remote environment without requiring constant supervision.



Primary Responsibilities

Develop architectural plans, elevations, sections, details, diagrams, and presentation materials.

Prepare drawing sets for schematic design, design development, permit submission, bidding, and construction.

Translate sketches, markups, reference materials, and verbal direction from the Principal Architect into accurate architectural documents.

Create three dimensional models, renderings, material studies, and client presentation materials.

Review drawings for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and constructability before submission.

Research applicable building codes, zoning requirements, planning restrictions, materials, products, and construction methods.

Coordinate architectural drawings with structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, interior design, landscape, and other consultant documents.

Identify drawing conflicts, missing information, and potential construction issues before they affect a project.

Revise documents based on internal reviews, consultant coordination, agency comments, and construction related questions.

Assist with finish selections, material schedules, door and window schedules, product research, and specification information.

Prepare existing condition drawings from photographs, field measurements, surveys, and reference documents.

Support construction administration by organizing submittals, requests for information, meeting notes, drawing revisions, and project records.

Maintain organized digital project files, drawing standards, model standards, and document naming conventions.

Track assigned tasks and deadlines and provide regular progress updates.

Communicate immediately when instructions are unclear, information is missing, or a deadline may be affected.



Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.

At least three years of professional experience with an architectural firm or design practice.

Experience preparing architectural drawings and coordinated construction document sets.

Strong understanding of architectural design, detailing, materials, dimensions, and building systems.

Ability to read and coordinate architectural, structural, civil, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing drawings.

Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, and Adobe Creative Cloud, or closely comparable architectural software.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Excellent attention to detail, organization, and time management.

Ability to interpret sketches, redlines, design direction, and technical comments accurately.

Ability to manage multiple assignments without losing track of revisions, deadlines, or unresolved questions.

Reliable computer equipment and a stable, high speed internet connection suitable for large architectural files and remote meetings.

Availability during the agreed working schedule aligned with Pacific Time.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience with high end residential, hospitality, commercial interior, adaptive reuse, or tenant improvement projects.

Experience working remotely with United States architecture, engineering, or construction firms.

Familiarity with United States building codes, zoning requirements, permitting processes, and architectural drawing standards.

Experience coordinating directly with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and other consultants.

Experience with visualization, rendering, and presentation software.

Familiarity with sustainable design principles and modern building technologies.

Experience supporting projects during permitting and construction.

Familiarity with Bluebeam Revu and cloud based project collaboration platforms.



Professional Expectations

The selected contractor must demonstrate accountability, initiative, accuracy, and consistent follow through.

This role requires someone who can recognize problems instead of simply completing assigned drafting. The contractor must ask informed questions, confirm priorities, maintain organized documentation, and communicate progress without waiting to be contacted.

All project drawings, designs, models, documents, client information, and company information must be treated as confidential. All work produced under this engagement will remain the property of the company.



Application Requirements

Please submit the following:

Current resume

Architectural portfolio

Samples of construction documents or technical drawings

Brief explanation of your specific contribution to each portfolio project

List of software programs and proficiency level

Current location in the Philippines

Available working hours in Pacific Time

Internet speed and computer specifications

Expected monthly contractor rate in Philippine pesos

Earliest available starting date

Candidates whose portfolios only contain academic projects, renderings, or work without a clear explanation of their responsibilities may not be considered.

title: Appointment Setter – Fintology (B2B Fintech, US Hours, Full-Time)
description:
Fintology is hiring a full-time Appointment Setter to work US business hours (9 AM–5 PM, Monday–Friday, Eastern Time / Atlanta GA HQ). You'll call and qualify inbound business leads and book them onto our closers' calendars. Pay is $5.00/hour PLUS 10% commission on every deal that closes from your appointments — and that 10% doesn't stop after one payout. It's a flat rate that compounds every month the client stays active, so the longer you stay and the more you close, the higher your monthly floor climbs. Leads come to us — this isn't cold-calling strangers.



About Fintology: We are a B2B Lending Operating System — a business-in-a-box for companies that need access to funding. We connect business owners to our network of 4,500+ lenders so they can get approved for financing regardless of credit score or industry. The people you'll be calling came to us asking for help.



What You'll Do:

- Call and follow up with inbound leads (business owners interested in funding) via phone, text, and

- Qualify leads and book them onto a closer's calendar

- Keep the CRM clean and current

- Hit daily/weekly activity targets (calls made, appointments set, show-up rate)

- Follow a proven script and objection-handling framework — we'll train you on it



What We're Looking For:

- Excellent spoken and written English — non-negotiable

- A reliable, distraction-free home setup (stable internet, headset, quiet space) for your full shift

- Someone who wants to build a career here, not cash one paycheck and coast

- Nice to have: prior SDR/appointment-setting experience, and/or experience with a CRM or auto-dialer (e.g., GoHighLevel, Close, HubSpot)



Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time. Consistent attendance is required.



Compensation: $5.00 USD/hour base (~$866/month at 40 hrs/week) PLUS 10% flat commission on every deal that closes from your booked appointments — paid monthly, for as long as that client stays active. Realistic OTE grows from ~$1,500/month in month 1 toward ~$3,500+/month at steady state as your book of active clients compounds.



Why This Role Pays Differently: We've hired great people for this type of role before, and the ones who struggle are the ones who go quiet right after a strong paycheck. This role rewards the opposite — because commission compounds monthly instead of paying out once, coasting costs you next month's floor too.



How to Apply — please include:

1. A 60–90 second voice or video recording introducing yourself in English

2. Your resume/CV

3. Confirmation you can work 9 AM–5 PM ET, Monday–Friday

4. Any CRM/dialer tools you've used before (if any)

5. Start your application with the word COMPOUND so we know you read the full post

title: Credit Repair Back Office Disputer
description:
We are looking for two more disputers to handle back office dispute for my company.

I am also looking for two customer service reps as well. (Customer service must do voice calls to current clients for updates and consultations.) If applying as a customer service rep make sure to explain your experience in the application.

We have additional education and training for you but we need someone who already has experience. 



When applying, write "I am a credit repair beast" at the top of your application.



We need someone who can pay good attention to details on our client's credit reports.



If you have any sales skills, that will help as well. We are looking for someone who can also find us more leads and clients. 

You will pay an extra commission for new clients as well as the regular hourly pay.



Must be fluent in English.

DO NOT use AI to answer these questions!

In your application, please add in:

1) How long have you been doing credit repair?

2) How many clients have you worked on at one time?

3) What credit repair strategies are you familiar with?

4) What's the fastest you have been able to remove items from client's reports?

5) How do you handle inquiry removal?

6) Do you know a 4-day collection removal method?



Add anything else that you are proud of and that would be good for this position.
